jobs.title: Controls Engineer
jobs.description: As a Controls Engineer at Automation Solutions, you will help design, program, commission, integrate, and support custom automated and robotic systems. This is a hands\-on engineering position involving both hardware and software, with responsibility for supporting projects from initial concept through installation and post\-delivery support. The Controls Engineer will work with PLCs, HMIs, variable frequency drives, servo systems, robots, vision systems, and other industrial automation technologies. The position includes work at our Birmingham facility and at customer locations, with approximately 25% travel required as necessary to support system commissioning, installation, troubleshooting, and service. Successful candidates will demonstrate strong technical aptitude, practical industrial controls experience, and a commitment to delivering innovative, reliable, and high\-quality automation solutions. The ideal candidate is organized, self\-motivated, comfortable working both independently and collaboratively, and capable of managing multiple assignments simultaneously. **Primary Responsibilities** ---------------------------- ### **Collaboration and Project Support** * Report to the Controls Engineering Manager regarding daily priorities, assignments, and technical direction. * Receive project\-specific direction from members of the Automation Solutions management and engineering teams as needed. * Coordinate with sales, project management, controls engineering, mechanical engineering, fabrication, and installation teams to design and implement automation projects. * Communicate directly with customers to understand requirements, address technical concerns, solve problems, and provide high\-quality service. * Provide technical guidance and oversight during control\-panel fabrication, system wiring, equipment assembly, and installation. * Maintain clear communication regarding project progress, technical concerns, schedule risks, and required customer support. ### **Controls Engineering and Integration** * Design, develop, program, integrate, and troubleshoot automated electromechanical control systems. * Develop, modify, and troubleshoot PLC and HMI programs, including ladder logic and related industrial control programming. * Program and troubleshoot PLCs, HMIs, VFDs, servo systems, robots, vision systems, and other automated control equipment. * Review and interpret electrical drawings, specifications, sequences of operation, and other project documentation. * Support the development and revision of electrical drawings and control\-system documentation. * Perform hands\-on integration, modification, troubleshooting, and repair of robotic, mechanical, electrical, and controls equipment. * Participate in system testing and runoffs to verify that equipment functionality meets contractual and customer requirements. * Conduct quality\-control inspections and help ensure compliance with applicable company safety requirements and electrical codes. * Identify technical issues, determine root causes, and implement practical corrective actions. ### **Commissioning, Installation, and Customer Support** * Provide hands\-on support for the assembly, testing, commissioning, and installation of automated manufacturing equipment. * Travel to customer facilities as necessary, approximately 25%, to support installation, commissioning, startup, troubleshooting, training, and post\-delivery service. * Use electrical test equipment, hand tools, power tools, and other equipment required to complete assigned work. * Troubleshoot, diagnose, modify, and repair electromechanical control systems at Automation Solutions and customer facilities. * Support customer production startup and resolve controls\-related issues that arise during commissioning. * Maintain accurate and up\-to\-date records of programming changes, troubleshooting activities, completed work, and system configurations. * Perform quality\-control inspections of electrical control systems, panels, field wiring, and installed equipment. * Represent Automation Solutions professionally while working at customer facilities. ### **Shop and Workplace Responsibilities** * Maintain a clean, safe, and organized work area. * Assist with general housekeeping throughout the fabrication and shop areas, including organizing materials and parts, removing trash, and sweeping floors. * Follow company safety procedures and use required personal protective equipment. * Work safely around energized electrical systems, industrial machinery, robotic equipment, and other automated systems. **Qualifications** ------------------ ### **Education** * Associate degree in Electrical Engineering Technology, Mechatronics, Industrial Automation, or a related technical field is preferred. * Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics, or a related field is preferred. * Relevant industrial controls experience may be considered in place of a degree. ### **Experience** * Two to four y d ability to perform hands\-on work in both shop and field environments. **Travel and Field\-Service Requirements** ------------------------------------------ * Willingness and ability to travel approximately 25%, as necessary, based on project and customer requirements. * Travel may include customer\-site visits for equipment installation, commissioning, startup, troubleshooting, training, and post\-delivery support. * Some projects may require overnight travel. * Travel frequency and duration may vary depending on project schedules and customer needs. * Ability to work at industrial and manufacturing facilities while following customer\-specific safety and access requirements. * Possess and maintain a valid U.S. driver’s license and a driving record acceptable under company requirements. **Additional Employment Requirements** -------------------------------------- * Ability to pass applicable background checks. * Ability to pass pre\-employment and random drug screenings. * Ability to comply with company and customer safety requirements. * Ability to wear required personal protective equipment. **Physical Requirements** ------------------------- The physical requirements listed below are representative of those required to perform the essential functions of the position: * Ability to lift and carry up to 50 pounds. * Ability to stand and work on your feet for extended periods. * Ability to bend, reach, climb, kneel, and perform hands\-on work around industrial equipment. * Ability to use electrical test equipment, hand tools, and power tools. * Ability to work safely around automated machinery, robotic systems, electrical equipment, and industrial processes. * Ability to wear required personal protective equipment. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the position. **Why Join Automation Solutions?** ---------------------------------- * Work on diverse custom automation and robotic systems rather than supporting the same equipment every day. * Participate in projects from initial concept through programming, testing, commissioning, installation, and customer support. * Develop valuable skills across multiple industrial controls and automation technologies. * Gain hands\-on experience with PLCs, HMIs, VFDs, servo systems, robotics, machine vision, and industrial networks. * Solve challenging, real\-world manufacturing and automation problems. * Work alongside experienced engineers, technicians, fabricators, and other automation professionals. * Receive stable, full\-time employment with opportunities for professional development and growth. * See the systems you help design and program become fully functioning production equipment. Automation Solutions and Livingston \& Haven consider all qualified applicants without regard to age, race, color, national origin, sex, religion, veteran status, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other status protected by applicable law. You should be proficient in: * PLC Troubleshooting Skills * Bachelor's Degree * Electrical Schematics * Troubleshooting Skills * Machine Building/Assembling * Single and Three Phase Power * 120/208/240/480 Voltage Systems * CAD Software * Industrial Robot Programming * Electrical Installation * Troubleshooting Industrial Automation Equipment * PLC Programming Experience * SCADA Experience * Programming Machine Vision Systems * Electrical / Electronic Systems * Pneumatics Troubleshooting * Field Service Readiness * Industrial Electrical Systems * Electrical Schematic Reading * Equipment Installation \& Wiring Machines \& technologies you'll use: * Variable Frequency Drives (VFD) * CAD Software (AutoCAD, Autodesk Inventor) * Programmable Logic Controller (PLC) (Fanuc, Allen Bradley, Omron, Siemens) * Vision System (Keyence, Cognex, Omron, Banner) * Servo Motors * Industrial Robot (Fanuc, Kuka, ABB, Yaskawa Motoman, Universal Robotics, Nachi, Epson, Kawasaki)

Our focus is on writing fast and easily maintained code that can be adapted to scale with large datasets. **Requirements:** * Strong understanding of data and statistics * Experience with programming languages like JavaScript, C\+\+, or Java * Ability to work well with a worldwide team * English fluency in speaking and writing Please send all applications, including resume, to jobs@fastbrowser.org.

jobs.title: Enterprise Solution Architect
jobs.description: ### **About Artos:** At Artos, we build tools that help biopharma companies create and manage their R\&D documentation in a fraction of the time. If you’re looking to join a team whose mission is to fundamentally change the way that drug development gets done, we’d love to talk to you. **The Role:** ============= We're looking for a Enterprise Solutions Architect to own the technical relationship with Artos' largest enterprise customers. You'll work with technical and business leaders at major pharmaceutical companies to understand their technology landscape, determine how Artos fits within it, and identify new ways our platform can solve problems across the organization. You'll serve as the primary technical partner from pre\-sales through deployment and expansion, working across customer IT, Security, Infrastructure, and business teams while partnering internally with Engineering, Product, and Customer Success. **What You'll Do:** =================== **Own Customer Technical Relationships** ---------------------------------------- * Serve as the primary technical partner for our largest enterprise customers. * Build trusted relationships with IT, architecture, security, infrastructure, and business leaders. * Lead technical discovery, architecture reviews, and planning discussions. * Understand customer systems and how Artos fits within their broader technology ecosystem. **Architect \& Expand Solutions** --------------------------------- * Design approaches for integrating and deploying Artos in complex enterprise environments. * Advise customers on system architecture, APIs, authentication, networking, data flows, and integrations. * Identify new technical use cases and opportunities to expand Artos across customer organizations. * Partner with Engineering and Product to turn customer needs into technical solutions. **Lead Customer Initiatives** ----------------------------- * Own technical coordination of deployments, integrations, upgrades, and new initiatives. * Manage customer commitments, timelines, dependencies, SLAs, and technical requirements. * Coordinate validation, documentation, and compliance activities * Identify blockers and bring in the right internal experts to resolve them. **Help Build the Function** --------------------------- * Develop repeatable approaches for enterprise deployments and technical customer engagement. * Help define how Solutions Architecture scales as Artos grows. * Potentially help build and lead a broader Solutions Architecture team over time. **What We're Looking For:** =========================== * 10\+ years of experience in Solutions Architecture, Enterprise Architecture, Customer Engineering, or similar roles. * Experience working with complex enterprise software environments * Strong understanding of system architecture, APIs, authentication, networking, integrations, and distributed systems. * Experience owning technical relationships with large enterprise customers. * Ability to work effectively with everyone from engineers to executive stakeholders. * Experience supporting both pre\-sales technical conversations and post\-sale deployments. * Comfortable operating in a startup environment where processes are still being built. **Nice to Have:** ================= * Pharmaceutical or life sciences experience. * GxP or similar regulated/compliance experience. * Startup or small\-company experience. * Previous software engineering or hands\-on technical background. * Experience building or leading Solutions Architecture or Solutions Engineering teams. **Other Information:** Very comfortable working in a fast\-paced and intense startup environment Willing to work in\-person in our office in Mission Bay 4\-5 days/week Likes matcha KitKats, believes every LLM prompt is just Schrödinger’s cat waiting to be observed, and knows too many random facts about the Mongol postal system Compensation Range: $210K \- $260K

jobs.title: Founding Marketer
jobs.description: **About Us** ------------ **MintMCP** helps companies put agents to work safely. We exist to help companies do more of their work with agents, and we build the infrastructure that makes a company's own work runnable by them. That has to start from trust. Our first product is an MCP gateway that gives those agents governed access to company data and tools. Before agents can touch Slack, GitHub, Jira, Snowflake, internal databases, or production systems, you need to know what they can reach, what they did, and why they were allowed to do it. Most people carry far more permissions than any single task needs. If an agent uses your token directly, it inherits all of them. MintMCP scopes that access down to exactly what an agent needs to do its job and captures the data flows and audit logs security teams need. From there we are building the rest of the agent stack: connectors, monitoring, sandboxing, long\-running agents, and memory, with the goal of becoming the system a company's work runs on. We work in person in the San Francisco Bay Area. The structure is flat and the market moves fast, so you have a lot of latitude over what you work on and how. **AI\-Native Startup** We are AI\-native. Everyone uses Claude and Codex every day, and we have more agents than employees. They run in Slack alongside the team and handle sales, marketing, deal ops, and engineering on the same gateway we sell to customers, and we are building an entire company operating system around them. **Traction** Since launching in February 2026, we have grown to 50\+ paying customers, with strong inbound demand. Customers include Coursera, Arlo, and Braze. We are backed by Cowboy Ventures and Coatue, with angels including Frederic Kerrest (Okta), Michael Grinich (WorkOS), Andrej Karpathy, Jeff Dean, and Scott Belsky. Our founders are machine learning experts from Stanford, Berkeley, and CMU, with applied research at Google Brain and Waymo, and one co\-founded Coursera. **The Job** ----------- You own how MintMCP grows. Turn heavy inbound into measurable, repeatable pipeline across both motions: self\-serve, where an engineer tries the gateway, and sales\-assisted, where security review turns into a company\-wide deal. You own positioning for a technical buyer and demand gen across SEO, AEO, paid, and content. You run a webinar series and a steady stream of campaign experiments, build outbound from the ground up with the AE team, and own the lifecycle that turns signups, trials, and security reviews into pipeline. You also own the numbers: how every channel performs, CAC, payback, and a forecast the team can plan against. What makes this different is how you do it. You will not run every campaign by hand, and you will not wait to hire a team. You orchestrate a fleet of agents to do the research, enrichment, sequencing, follow\-up, content drafts, and reporting, so one marketer covers more ground than a traditional team. Agents take on the repeatable work, so the role can stay broad. This role calls for a senior growth marketer with the range to set the message, pick the highest\-leverage bets, and instrument the funnel, then use agents to run it. The work is to look at a messy funnel, find the bottleneck, design the experiment, ship it the same day, and read the data the next morning. You report to the CEO and work across the GTM team. The role is in person. **About You** * You have built a growth marketing function from zero. You have turned messy demand into measurable pipeline at an early\-stage B2B company, ideally dev\-tools, infra, or security, and you can point to the number. * You have real positioning and messaging instincts for a technical buyer. You can hold a conversation with engineers, security leaders, and AI leaders, and turn it into content and campaigns that land. * You have run demand across multiple channels, some mix of SEO, AEO, paid, lifecycle, and content, and you know how to pick the next lever, not just operate the one you know best. * You have run both a self\-serve PLG motion and a sales\-assist motion into a buying committee, and you know they need different plays. * You own the numbers. You are fluent in attribution and funnel analytics, and you can model CAC, payback, and a forecast the team can plan against. If that is not your background, you partner well with whoever owns it. * You are deeply AI\-native and already use agents to multiply yourself. You have built or directed agentic workflows, not just used AI tools, and you are excited to run a fleet of agents as your team instead of hiring one. * You thrive before the playbook exists. You decide what matters, ship within hours, measure what happened, and change direction without a mature org around you. **Nice to have:** * You have stood up outbound that worked, partnering closely with AEs on targeting, messaging, and sequencing, not just running campaigns on your own. * Experience taking a product upmarket, or repositioning and repricing one. * Having built this once already at an AI\-native company. * Field marketing or events experience. **What we offer:** * Competitive compensation and meaningful equity. * The room to define how a fast\-growing infrastructure company goes to market, and to build the first AI\-native growth engine from scratch. * Direct access to the CEO, customers, and product direction. * Health benefits, on a team that puts family and health first. *Prefer to have your agent apply? Point it at* *https://www.mintmcp.com/hiring/mcp*

jobs.title: Full Stack .NET Developer
jobs.description: Job Description We are seeking a **Full Stack .NET Developer** to join a development team supporting the **State of Michigan**. This opportunity is open to candidates across experience levels. We are interested in both experienced developers and individuals with a strong development foundation who are looking for an opportunity to learn, grow, and gain hands\-on experience. The development environment includes **C\#/.NET, Angular, SQL Server, and Azure DevOps**. The team follows Agile/Scrum practices and works collaboratively to develop new functionality, resolve application issues, and support ongoing application development. Responsibilities* Develop and maintain applications using **C\#/.NET and Angular** * Build and support backend application functionality * Develop and maintain **SQL Server** database components, including SQL projects and declarative schemas * Develop front\-end functionality using **Angular** * Develop new application features and functionality * Troubleshoot and resolve application bugs * Manage assigned development work through **Azure DevOps** * Work with stakeholders to clarify requirements * Participate in pull request (PR) and code reviews * Collaborate with other developers to complete assigned work * Follow established coding standards and development practices * Participate in an **Agile/Scrum** development environment **Requirements** Qualifications* Knowledge of or hands\-on experience with **C\#/.NET** * Familiarity with **Angular** or modern front\-end development * Understanding of **SQL and relational databases** * Understanding of object\-oriented programming and software development fundamentals * Familiarity with source control and collaborative development practices * Strong problem\-solving and communication skills * Ability to work collaboratively within a development team * Willingness and ability to learn new technologies and development practices * Experience with **Azure DevOps, Agile/Scrum, SQL Server, or full\-stack application development** is a plus * Professional experience, internships, academic projects, personal projects, and other demonstrated development experience will be considered Technology Environment**C\# \| .NET \| Angular \| SQL Server \| Azure DevOps \| Git/Pull Requests \| Agile/Scrum**

jobs.title: Full-Stack Software Engineer
jobs.description: **Job Title:** Full\-Stack Software Engineer **Team:** Engineering **Location:** Onsite \- Sawtelle (Between Santa Monica \& West LA) or San Francisco, CA **Employment Type:** Full\-time, Salary, Exempt **Reports To:** Engineering Lead **About Plug** -------------- Plug is an automotive fintech startup building the marketplace for electric vehicles. Consumers, dealers, and commercial partners trade in, sell, and auction used EVs through a platform built exclusively for electric, with nothing adapted from legacy automotive. Consumers can get an instant cash offer in minutes, backed by data\-driven pricing, battery state\-of\-health analysis, with pickup, payment, and title transfer handled end\-to\-end. Franchise and independent dealers across the United States bid in real time on inventory sourced directly from these consumers, dealers, and commercial partners. The result is a single platform that gives sellers a fast, fair exit and gives dealers a dedicated channel for sourcing used EV inventory. Founded in 2023 and led by former Tesla executives, Plug has facilitated $100M in EV sales since launch and is backed by a $20M Series A from Lightspeed Venture Partners. We're building the most AI\-native startup team in Los Angeles, full of operators, engineers, and ML researchers laying the transaction rails for the used EV market's exponential growth. **Why Plug** ------------ * You'll own a piece of the biggest infrastructure opportunity in automotive. * You'll work on a platform built exclusively for EVs, with nothing adapted from legacy automotive. * You'll be part of an AI\-native company. We're rethinking how work gets done at a fundamental level. * You'll work directly with operators who have scaled multi\-billion dollar businesses in automotive, EV, and marketplaces. * You'll have real ownership, high autonomy, and a direct line to company outcomes. **The Opportunity** ------------------- We are looking for a Full\-Stack Software Engineer to join our growing team! A full\-stack software engineer who will report to our engineering lead, and who will own features and components within our products \- working closely with senior software engineers (SSEs) on scope, architecture, and cross\-system tradeoffs. We're building systems like AI\-powered pricing intelligence, real\-time connectivity to vehicle manufacturer APIs, auction application, and data pipelines that aggregate EV\-specific information from dozens of sources \- all to make the wholesale EV market faster, smarter, and more transparent. As a member of the team you'll help build the technical and product foundation for our growing business, with direct mentorship from senior engineers as you grow into more ownership. We're building a culture that cares about collaboration, encourages intellectual honesty, celebrates technical excellence, and is driven by careful attention to detail and planning for the future. We believe diversity of perspective and experience are key to building great technology and a thriving team. Sounds cool? Let's work together. **What You’ll Do** ------------------ * Collaborate with colleagues and contribute your voice in product design sessions, architecture discussions, and code reviews. * Design, implement, test, debug, and document work on new and existing software features, ensuring they meet business, quality, and operational needs. * Take ownership of features, with support from SSEs on architecture or cross\-system tradeoffs, understanding the ultimate goal and evaluating effort and priority in an agile environment. * Use agentic coding tools to write clear, efficient, and maintainable code, growing your judgment on flexibility and scalability with guidance from senior engineers. * Contribute to team productivity and process improvements. * Use and integrate APIs to connect Plug with 3rd party platforms. * Contribute to code review and pairing, and reach out to SSEs to spark good technical discussions \- including how you use AI tools. * Be an integral part of a close team of developers; this is an opportunity to grow quickly with direct mentorship from senior engineers as the team scales. **What You’ll Bring** --------------------- * 3\+ years of hands\-on experience developing and delivering production applications. * Solid proficiency in TypeScript across the full stack \- backend, frontend, relational databases, and API/webhook integrations. * Experience deploying and operating cloud\-hosted applications; comfort with CI/CD pipelines and observability tooling, with interest in infrastructure\-as\-code (we use Terraform) and feature flag systems. * Comfortable working in agent\-first development workflows \- defining clear acceptance criteria and reviewing AI\-generated output with a high quality bar. * A strong engineering quality bar \- writing tests, participating in code reviews, and producing code that is readable by both humans and AI agents. * Track record of owning work end\-to\-end: scoping, shipping, and measuring impact, with growing autonomy. * Startup or fast\-paced team experience is a plus. * Authorized to work in the US for any employer. * Prior experience in automotive or EV systems is a plus. **Compensation** ---------------- Annual salary: $145,000 \- $175,000 *Salary ranges reflect independent, third\-party benchmarking against national compensation data. Where an individual's actual offer falls within that range depends on a combination of factors, including relevant experience, specialized skills, training and qualifications, current business needs, and prevailing market conditions. Ranges are reviewed periodically and may be adjusted to reflect changing market conditions.* **Benefits \& Perks:** * Health, Vision, and Dental insurance * 401(k) plan * Work from anywhere up to 30 days per year. * Daily lunch stipend * Equity (based on role and performance) * 30\-day remote work from anywhere policy * Unlimited PTO * Fully stocked kitchen * Dog\-friendly office * Ongoing opportunities for growth and development This full\-time position is an in\-person role ideally based in Sawtelle (between Santa Monica and West Los Angeles). We are headquartered in Los Angeles and is our preferred location, with relocation assistance provided for successful candidates who need to relocate. Candidates already based in the San Francisco area will also be considered; relocation is not required for these candidates. Sponsorship is not available at this time. **Acknowledgments** Plug is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We believe diverse teams build better products \- full stop.

jobs.title: General Maintenance Engineer
jobs.description: **Summary** ----------- Join our dynamic team and work in a beautiful setting with an unobstructed view of the ocean! We are looking individuals who can provide authentic and memorable experiences that deliver the Southern California Dream to our guests as a General Maintenance Engineer. This is a full\-time position with benefits. This role is fully onsite and requires open availability to work any shift as needed, included weekends and holidays. This position will rotate working overnight shifts. The General Maintenance Engineer will: * Perform routine maintenance throughout both properties and will monitor, operate, and maintain the mechanical equipment in all areas. * Regularly required to stand walk and occasionally lift or move 50 pounds. * Possess general troubleshooting skills to repair kitchen equipment, laundry equipment, and HVAC equipment. * Must be able to do general facilities maintenance to include but not limited to replace light switches, outlets, light fixtures, and work on basic electrical, mechanical and plumbing equipment. * Have familiarity with basic OSHA safety requirements, and fire life safety systems. * Complete some painting and patching work. * Complete guest calls as needed and properly document in the Engineering software system. * Complete projects as needed. *This list is not all\-encompassing and that daily work tasks may and can be altered to meet business needs.* *The rate for this position ranges from $22\.49\-$27\.59/hour.* **Hyatt has a very competitive benefit package for colleagues, which may include:** * 12 Complimentary hotel room nights at Hyatt hotels world\-wide * Unlimited colleague and friends \& family discounted room rates at Hyatt hotels world\-wide * Bereavement and jury duty pay * Vacation, sick, and new child leave * Medical, dental and vision Insurance, discounted prescriptions, life and disability insurance, flexible spending account, * Retirement Savings Plan option (401K) with employer match * Employee Stock Purchase Plan * Complimentary employee meals * And so much more! **SAFETY REQUIREMENTS:** OSHA laws require the use of Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) when performing work duties that have a potential of risk to your health or safety. The following is a list of some of the devices required. This is only a sample list and is not to be all\-inclusive do to the nature of the work conductive to the Engineering Department. * Protective gloves, eye protection, breathing protection, hearing protection, lock\-out/tag\-out protection and any other equipment as necessary to provide a safe working environment. All work duties conducted by Engineering personal will be evaluated and regular scheduled training and refresher training will be conducted as required by law. Associates will be trained as to the use and care of any and all required PPE equipment. The hotel provides this required PPE and it is the responsibility of engineer to wear this equipment as it relates to daily work assignments. jobs.title: Mechanical Fabricator & Technician
jobs.description: The Mechanical Fabricator and Technician supports the fabrication, assembly, installation, and servicing of custom automated and robotic systems. This is a hands\-on position involving MIG and TIG welding, mechanical fabrication, equipment assembly, painting, machining, installation, troubleshooting, and repair. The position works closely with mechanical engineers, controls engineers, electricians, technicians, and other team members to build custom industrial equipment from mechanical drawings and technical specifications. Work is performed at our Birmingham facility and at customer locations, with approximately 15% travel required as necessary for equipment installation, startup, troubleshooting, and support. Successful candidates will demonstrate strong mechanical aptitude, welding and fabrication experience, attention to detail, and a commitment to safe, efficient, and high\-quality work. The ideal candidate is self\-motivated, organized, capable of working both independently and as part of a multidisciplinary team, and able to manage multiple assignments. **Primary Responsibilities** ---------------------------- ### **Welding and Mechanical Fabrication** * Perform MIG and TIG welding on mild steel, stainless steel, and occasionally aluminum. * Fabricate components and assemblies according to mechanical drawings, specifications, and project requirements. * Fit, tack, weld, grind, and finish fabricated parts and assemblies. * Prepare and paint fabricated parts, frames, components, and equipment assemblies. * Inspect completed welds and fabricated components for quality, fit, and conformance to specifications. * Identify fabrication issues and work with the engineering team to determine appropriate corrections. * Maintain welding and fabrication tools in safe, working condition. ### **Mechanical Assembly** * Read and interpret mechanical blueprints, assembly drawings, technical drawings, and schematics. * Assemble custom automated equipment, robotic systems, frames, guarding, fixtures, conveyors, and other mechanical components. * Use hand tools, power tools, and precision measuring equipment to assemble mechanical systems to specification. * Install and align bearings, shafts, belts, gears, sprockets, couplings, linear components, cylinders, valves, sensors, guards, and related equipment. * Verify equipment fit, alignment, movement, and function throughout the assembly process. * Identify incorrect dimensions, interferences, fitment problems, missing components, and other assembly concerns. * Communicate mechanical and design issues clearly to engineers and other project team members. ### **Machining and Component Modification** * Use manual machining equipment to modify and produce parts according to project requirements. * Perform basic drilling, tapping, cutting, grinding, fitting, and other part\-modification activities. * Use precision measuring tools to verify dimensions and tolerances. * Modify existing components when necessary to support assembly, installation, repair, or design revisions. * Follow drawings, specifications, and engineering direction when machining or modifying components. ### **Prototype and Engineering Support** * Work alongside mechanical engineers, controls engineers, electricians, and other technicians during the assembly of prototype and custom equipment. * Build equipment from initial concept models, drawings, and design revisions. * Provide practical feedback regarding ease of assembly, component fit, serviceability, and potential design improvements. * Assist with functional testing and documentation of prototype and early\-stage equipment. * Support equipment modifications resulting from testing, customer feedback, or engineering revisions. * Recommend improvements to build processes, part designs, tooling, and equipment reliability. ### **Equipment Installation and Field Support** * Support the installation of mechanical systems at Automation Solutions and customer facilities. * Travel to customer sites as necessary, approximately 15%, to support equipment installation, startup, troubleshooting, repair, and post\-delivery service. * Install machine frames, components, guarding, fixtures, conveyors, and other mechanical assemblies according to site plans and technical instructions. * Align, level, anchor, adjust, and verify installed equipment. * Test equipment movement, fit, and function under simulated or operating conditions. * Participate in machine startup, tuning, testing, and functional verification. * Work with engineers, electricians, controls personnel, and customer representatives to achieve complete system readiness. * Represent Automation Solutions professionally while working at customer facilities. ### **Troubleshooting and Repairs** * Diagnose mechanical failures and implement corrective actions. * Inspect mechanical components for wear, damage, misalignment, looseness, interference, or other potential failure conditions. * Identify root causes by evalua ble, self\-motivated, and willing to take ownership of assigned work. * Willingness to learn new processes, equipment, and technical skills. **Travel and Field\-Service Requirements** ------------------------------------------ * Willingness and ability to travel approximately 15%, as necessary, based on project and customer requirements. * Travel may include customer\-site visits for equipment installation, startup, alignment, troubleshooting, repair, and post\-delivery support. * Some projects may require overnight travel. * Travel frequency and duration may vary depending on project schedules and customer needs. * Ability to work at industrial and manufacturing facilities while following customer\-specific safety, security, and access requirements. * Possess and maintain a valid U.S. driver’s license and a driving record acceptable under company requirements. **Certifications** ------------------ The following certifications are preferred but not required: * OSHA 10 or OSHA 30 certification. * Forklift or powered industrial truck operator certification. * Aerial lift or mobile elevated work platform certification. * Relevant welding, mechanical, equipment\-manufacturer, or safety certifications. **Additional Employment Requirements** -------------------------------------- * Ability to pass applicable background checks. * Ability to pass pre\-employment and random drug screenings. * Ability to comply with company and customer safety requirements. * Ability to wear required personal protective equipment. **Physical Requirements** ------------------------- The physical requirements listed below are representative of those required to perform the essential functions of the position: * Ability to lift and carry up to 50 pounds. * Ability to stand and work on your feet for extended periods. * Ability to bend, reach, climb, kneel, crouch, and work in positions necessary to assemble and install industrial equipment. * Ability to safely use welding equipment, fabrication machinery, hand tools, power tools, and precision measuring equipment. * Ability to work safely around industrial machinery, automated equipment, welding operations, and manufacturing processes. * Ability to wear required personal protective equipment. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the position. **Why Join Automation Solutions?** ---------------------------------- * Build diverse custom automation and robotic systems rather than performing repetitive production work. * Participate in projects from fabrication and initial assembly through testing, installation, and customer startup. * Develop valuable skills in welding, fabrication, machining, mechanical assembly, troubleshooting, automation, and industrial equipment installation. * Work alongside experienced engineers, technicians, electricians, fabricators, and automation professionals. * Provide practical input that can improve equipment designs, assembly processes, and system reliability. * Solve challenging, real\-world mechanical and manufacturing problems. * Receive stable, full\-time employment with opportunities for professional development and growth. * See the equipment you help fabricate and assemble become fully functioning production systems. **Equal Employment Opportunity** -------------------------------- Automation Solutions and Livingston \& Haven consider all qualified applicants without regard to age, race, color, national origin, sex, religion, veteran status, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other status protected by applicable law. You should be proficient in: * Mechanical Troubleshooting Skills * OSHA 10\-Hour Certification (OSHA 10\) * Pneumatics Troubleshooting * Maintenance and Repair Skills * Field Service Readiness * CNC Machine Setup \& Changeover * Mechanical Systems \& Component Repair * Crane \& Lifting Equipment Systems * Lockout/Tagout (LOTO) * Equipment Installation

jobs.title: Motion Control Automation Engineer — Linear Actuation
jobs.description: **Motion Control Automation Engineer — Linear Actuation** ========================================================= **A day in this role** ---------------------- Morning stand\-up done, you dive into a customer application: calculating loads, sizing a servo and drive, and selecting sensors and safety devices for a cartesian robot. You open your electrical design software to finalize a control panel layout, confirm wiring specs, and review schematics. After lunch, you tune a stepper\-driven actuator to hit a tight move profile, then switch to debugging a PLC routine written in IEC 61131\-3\. You wrap the day collaborating with sales and application engineering to recommend the right PBC Linear actuators, profile rail, and ball/lead screw components—or sketching an idea for a new product variant that fits a unique requirement. **What you’ll do** ------------------ * Provide product and application support for linear motion systems, components, and actuators. * Design, select components, and troubleshoot motion control solutions using stepper motors, servo motors, drives, sensors, safety equipment, and related hardware. * Size and choose motors and drives using appropriate load calculations. * Tune servo\- and stepper\-driven linear motion systems for performance and stability. * Program PLC systems using IEC 61131\-3 languages and interface with controls, drives, and sensors. * Install and wire electrical components into control panels; read and interpret electrical control panel schematics. * Diagnose and repair issues in existing electrical panels. * Support the design, construction, operation, and troubleshooting of customer applications and test stands for linear motion products. * Communicate with engineers, vendors, and customers on controls\-related opportunities and issues. * Leverage mechatronics knowledge across controls, software, and mechanical actuator systems. * Use electrical design software to document and validate designs. * Occasionally partner with sales teams and customers to understand requirements and either select appropriate PBC Linear products or help design new offerings. * Optional but valuable: C\+\+, C\#, or Visual Basic for tooling, test, or integration tasks. **What you bring** ------------------ * Hands\-on knowledge of servo and stepper motor dynamics, PLCs, controls, and drive systems. * Familiarity with linear motion technologies such as actuators, profile rail, ball screws, lead screws, and linear bearings (preferred). * Bachelor’s degree in engineering or a related 2\-year technical degree—preferably Electrical Engineering, Robotics, or Mechatronics. **Why PBC Linear** ------------------ PBC Linear (A Pacific Bearing Company) is a global leader in linear technology—and a local manufacturer committed to our associates and community. If you enjoy tackling complex motion challenges in a fast\-changing, dynamic environment, you’ll feel at home here. We offer a competitive benefits package including medical, dental, vision, 401(k), life insurance, STD, LTD, AD\&D, and Aflac. **Equal Opportunity** --------------------- PBC Linear is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Oracle APEx Developer
jobs.description: **Job Title** Oracle APEX/PL/SQL Developer \- Fully Onsite for 30 days and then Hybrid \- Need Only LOCAL to Virginia **Location** \[Richmond, VA, 23218] **Job Description** **Works as part of the Virginia Department of Health, Office of Information Management (OIM) team and plan, coordinate, develop, implement data modernization of vital statistics and vital records related projects.** **Virginia Vital Events and Screening Tracking System (VVESTS) is developed in Oracle Application Express (APEX), a secure, low‑code development platform used to build scalable enterprise applications. VVESTS supports mission‑critical functions for the Virginia Department of Health, including the Birth Registry, Death Registry (EDRS), and Screening Registry. The system also integrates with multiple state partners such as LVA, DSS, DMV, and DCLS, as well as federal agencies including SSA, CDC, NCHS, and NAPHSIS.** Given the highly sensitive nature of the data managed within VVESTS (PII and PHI), continued modernization and enhancement using advanced Oracle APEX features is essential for maintaining strict security standards, improving system performance, and ensuring ongoing compliance with HIPAA regulations. This requisition is for Oracle APEX development to implement new enhancements that support the data modernization of vital records and vital statistics projects. The effort will focus on creating new Oracle APEX pages and application components, strengthening security controls, improving the user experience through modern UI capabilities, and ensuring the long‑term sustainability of the VVESTS platform **Required/Desired Skills** **Skill** **Required /Desired** **Amount** **of Experience** Oracle 11g/18c/19c database Required 5 Years Strong sql and pl/sql experience Required 5 Years Javascript OR Jquery Required 5 Years Oracle APEX Required 5 Years Oracle PL/SQL web toolkit Desired 1 Years RESTful and SOAP Webservices Desired 1 Years Pay: $119,895\.40 \- $144,390\.16 per year Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Principal Software Engineer, Fintech
jobs.description: **Job Title:** Principal Software Engineer, Fintech **Team:** Engineering **Location:** Onsite \- Sawtelle (Between Santa Monica \& West LA) or San Francisco, CA **Employment Type:** Full\-time **Reports To:** Head of Engineering / CTO ### **About Plug** Plug is an automotive fintech startup building the marketplace for electric vehicles. Consumers, dealers, and commercial partners trade in, sell, and auction used EVs through a platform built exclusively for electric, with nothing adapted from legacy automotive. Consumers can get an instant cash offer in minutes, backed by data\-driven pricing, battery state\-of\-health analysis, with pickup, payment, and title transfer handled end\-to\-end. Franchise and independent dealers across the United States bid in real time on inventory sourced directly from these consumers, dealers, and commercial partners. The result is a single platform that gives sellers a fast, fair exit and gives dealers a dedicated channel for sourcing used EV inventory. Founded in 2023 and led by former Tesla executives, Plug has facilitated $100M in EV sales since launch and is backed by a $20M Series A from Lightspeed Venture Partners. We're building the most AI\-native startup team in Los Angeles, full of operators, engineers, and ML researchers laying the transaction rails for the used EV market's exponential growth. ### **Why Plug** * You'll own a piece of the biggest infrastructure opportunity in automotive. * You'll work on a platform built exclusively for EVs, with nothing adapted from legacy automotive. * You'll be part of an AI\-native company. We're rethinking how work gets done at a fundamental level. * You'll work directly with operators who have scaled multi\-billion dollar businesses in automotive, EV, and marketplaces. * You'll have real ownership, high autonomy, and a direct line to company outcomes. ### **The Opportunity** Every transaction on Plug moves real money \- consumer payouts, dealer settlements, lien payoffs, auction proceeds \- and today those flows run on infrastructure that was built to get us to $100M in volume, not to $1B. We need a technical architect to design the money systems that get us there: a ledger and payments architecture that's correct, auditable, and fast, built to survive contact with banking partners, regulators, and scale. We believe building consumer\-facing product architecture and building money\-facing architecture are fundamentally different disciplines, and rarely the same person's strength. This role exists because we need someone whose primary craft is the latter: designing systems that hold up under regulatory scrutiny, banking\-partner constraints, and financial audit \- not just under user load. ### **What You'll Do** * Own the architecture for Plug's money\-facing systems: ledger, payment disbursement, settlement, reconciliation, and lien/title payoff processing. * Design a ledger that is deterministic, auditable, and gives a single, queryable source of truth for every dollar that moves through the platform. * Architect systems that integrate directly with banking partners, payment processors, and lien/title servicers \- working within the regulatory and compliance constraints those partnerships require, and doing so elegantly rather than with brittle workarounds. * Make and document the core technical tradeoffs for financial systems: consistency vs. availability, idempotency, fault tolerance, and failure recovery for transaction\-critical infrastructure. * Partner with Product, Risk, Finance, and Compliance to translate business and regulatory requirements into system design. * Set technical standards and review architecture for any system that touches money, acting as the final technical guardrail before it ships. * Mentor and raise the technical bar for engineers working in and around the money systems domain, without owning formal people management. * Evaluate and help decide when to build vs. integrate with external payments/banking infrastructure providers. ### **What You'll Bring** * 10\+ years in software engineering, with 5\+ years working on B2B and B2C payments solutions. * Direct experience designing and building payments, ledger, lending, or money movement infrastructure \- not just consumer\-facing payment systems. * A genuine taste for elegance: the ability to design within real regulatory and stakeholder constraints in a way that stays efficient and clean, rather than accumulating one\-off exceptions and technical debt to satisfy each new requirement. * Proven experience designing systems within regulatory and banking\-partner constraints \- you understand what it takes to build infrastructure that a bank, processor, or regulator will actually sign off on. * Deep expertise in distributed systems: transaction integrity, financial data consistency, idempotency, auditability, and fault tolerance at scale. * A track record of owning architecture decisions end\-to\-end, from design through implementation and long\-term maintainability. * Comfort operating with high agency in an ambiguous, fast\-moving startup environment \- you'll be the first and primary technical owner of this domain. * Strong cross\-functional collaboration skills \- you can translate complex technical tradeoffs for Product, Risk, Finance, and Compliance stakeholders. * International or cross\-border money movement experience is a plus, but not required. * Experience with title, lien, lending, or marketplace escrow\-like flows is a plus. * You work agent\-first. You are comfortable orchestrating multiple coding agents, defining clear acceptance criteria, and reviewing AI\-generated output to a high bar \- and you have a point of view on where that is and is not appropriate in code that moves money. ### **Compensation and Benefits** Annual salary: $222,256 \-$259,324 Salary ranges reflect independent, third\-party benchmarking against national compensation data. We are headquartered in Los Angeles and is our preferred location, with relocation assistance provided for successful candidates who need to relocate. Candidates already based in the San Francisco area will also be considered; relocation is not required for these candidates. Sponsorship is not available at this time. ### **Acknowledgments** Plug is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We believe diverse teams build better products.

jobs.title: Senior Forward Deployed Engineer – Key Accounts (AI Solutions)
jobs.description: Aircall is a unicorn, AI\-powered customer communications platform used by 22,000\+ companies worldwide to drive revenue, resolve issues faster, and scale customer\-facing teams. Aircall's AI Voice Agent automates routine calls, AI Assist streamlines post\-call work, and AI Assist Pro delivers real\-time guidance so people can do their best work. The result is higher revenue, faster resolutions, and teams that scale with confidence. Aircall is headquartered in Paris, our European HQ, with a strong North American presence anchored in Seattle, our North American HQ, and teams across Madrid, London, Berlin, San Francisco, New York City, Sydney, and Mexico City. We've built a product customers love and a business that's scaling quickly, backed by world\-class investors and driven by rapid AI innovation across multiple product lines. At Aircall, you'll join a company in motion. We're ambitious, product\-driven, and execution\-focused, with visible impact, fast decisions, and real growth. **How we work at Aircall**: We're customer\-obsessed, data\-driven, and focused on delivering meaningful outcomes. We value ownership, continuous learning, and thoughtful speed. If you thrive in a collaborative, fast\-moving environment where trust and impact matter, you'll feel at home here. ***The embedded technical partner for a focused portfolio of Aircall's most strategic global accounts, driving agentic AI adoption use case by use case, in lockstep with Key Account Managers, from a first deployed use case to platform\-wide expansion.*** #### **About the Team** Aircall's Forward Deployed Engineering team connects our innovative AI Agents technology to real\-world customer workflows. We turn possibility into production by delivering automation that improves customer experience, boosts productivity, and unlocks new business value. Working cross\-functionally with Product, Engineering, Sales, Solutions, and Customer Success, the team ensures every deployment delivers measurable impact. Within that team, this is a senior, Key Accounts–focused role for someone who wants to go deep rather than broad — embedding with a portfolio of Aircall's most strategic global customers and growing agentic adoption inside each one over time. It sits at the intersection of technical consulting, project leadership, and AI adoption strategy. *You don't need to be a full\-time software engineer, but you should be fluent in APIs, highly confident leading complex technical engagements, and credible in the room with senior customer stakeholders.* #### **About the Role** As a Senior Forward Deployed Engineer for Key Accounts, you are the embedded technical owner for a portfolio of Aircall's highest\-value global customers. You don't run a deployment and move on — you stay with the account, building a long\-term agentic roadmap alongside the Key Account Manager (KAM). You land a first high\-impact use case, prove value fast, then systematically expand the footprint use case by use case until Aircall's AI Agents are woven through the customer's core workflows. This is a high\-autonomy role: you set the technical strategy for your accounts, you're trusted in the room with customer leadership, and you act as the connective tissue between the customer, the KAM, Product, and Engineering. *Please note, this is not a software engineering role. This is a hybrid, revenue\-driving role spanning Solutions Engineering, Consulting, Professional Services, and Product Ownership* **What you'll do** * **Own a sustained, embedded relationship** with each account in your portfolio — you are the customer's go\-to technical authority on agentic AI, not a project resource who rotates off once a deployment ships. * **Partner directly with the Key Account Manager** on a joint account plan: the KAM owns the commercial relationship and quota; you own the agentic use\-case roadmap and technical execution; together you build and drive the pipeline of expansion use cases. * **Land the first use case fast, then expand** — deploy an initial high\-value workflow, instrument the outcome, and use proven value to open the next use case and the next buying centre within the account. * **Run an evergreen use\-case discovery cadence** — continuously surface, qualify, and prioritise new automation opportunities across the customer's teams, so there is always a next use case in flight. * **Serve as the customer's trusted advisor on agentic strategy** — map their AI roadmap 6–12 months out, not just the deployment in front of you, and keep Aircall positioned as the platform of record. * **Lead discovery and solution\-design sessions** with customer stakeholders to map business processes, identify automation opportunities, and define solution architecture. * **Design, build, and deploy integrations** u rvices — ideally with time owning strategic or enterprise accounts. * Client facing experience: + Proven ability to own a long\-term customer relationship as the technical authority, operating with autonomy and credibility in front of senior (VP / CxO) stakeholders. + Proven experience running account\-based motions in partnership with sales / account management on strategic or enterprise customers. * Technical skills: + Strong command of APIs, webhooks, and data structures (JSON, REST, GraphQL) — able to design and troubleshoot integrations confidently. Even better if you have experience with MCP Servers. + Proficiency in scripting (JavaScript and/or Python) — used to build, customise, and debug integrations, not just read them. + Hands\-on experience with low\-code orchestration tools (Zapier, Make, n8n, Workato) and CRM automation (HubSpot, Salesforce). + Practical understanding of AI workflow configuration, including prompt engineering, evaluation, and monitoring. * Proven ability to lead complex, cross\-functional programs with Engineering, Product, and Customer Success to deliver scalable outcomes. * Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, translating fluently between technical and business audiences. * A growth mindset — constantly learning new tools, frameworks, and ways to improve the customer experience and team capability. * Nice\-to\-haves + Experience in telephony, voice, or contact centre systems (SIP/WebRTC, call routing, containment, AHT). + Familiarity with BI and analytics tools (Looker, BigQuery, Snowflake). #### **What success looks like** * **Depth and expansion within each account** — a growing number of live agentic use cases, and adoption spreading into new teams and buying centres over time. * **Net revenue retention and expansion MRR** across your portfolio, driven jointly with the KAM. * **Trusted\-partner status** — reflected in access, executive relationships, and roadmap influence, not just tickets closed. * **Shortened time\-to\-first\-value** on the initial use case, then a repeatable path to use case two and beyond. * **Reusable frameworks and models** actively used by peers and partners on other Key Account engagements. * **Strong collaboration with Engineering and Product** to enhance platform capabilities. * **Sustained improvements in customer metrics** (containment, AHT, CSAT) and revenue impact (ARR, NRR) driven by your solutions. **Why join us?** Key moment to join Aircall in terms of growth and opportunities ‍️ Our people matter, work\-life balance is important at Aircall Fast\-learning environment, entrepreneurial and strong team spirit 45\+ Nationalities: cosmopolite \& multi\-cultural mindset Competitive salary package \& benefits **DE\&I Statement:** At Aircall, we believe diversity, equity and inclusion – irrespective of origins, identity, background and orientations – are core to our journey. We pride ourselves on promoting active inclusion within our business to foster a strong sense of belonging for all. We're working to create a place filled with diverse people who can enrich and learn from one another. We're committed to ensuring that everyone not only has a seat at the table but is valued and respected at it by providing equal opportunities to develop and thrive. We will constantly challenge ourselves to make sure that we live up to our ambitions around diversity, equity and inclusion, and keep this conversation open. Above all else, we understand and acknowledge that we have work to do and much to learn. Want to know more about candidate privacy? Find our Candidate Privacy Notice here. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description: **About Us** ------------ **MintMCP** helps companies put agents to work safely. We exist to help companies do more of their work with agents, and we build the infrastructure that makes a company's own work runnable by them. That has to start from trust. Our first product is an MCP gateway that gives those agents governed access to company data and tools. Before agents can touch Slack, GitHub, Jira, Snowflake, internal databases, or production systems, you need to know what they can reach, what they did, and why they were allowed to do it. Most people carry far more permissions than any single task needs. If an agent uses your token directly, it inherits all of them. MintMCP scopes that access down to exactly what an agent needs to do its job and captures the data flows and audit logs security teams need. From there we are building the rest of the agent stack: connectors, monitoring, sandboxing, long\-running agents, and memory, with the goal of becoming the system a company's work runs on. We work in person in the San Francisco Bay Area. The structure is flat and the market moves fast, so you have a lot of latitude over what you work on and how. **AI\-Native Startup** We are AI\-native. Everyone uses Claude and Codex every day, and we have more agents than employees. They run in Slack alongside the team, write code, review PRs, and handle sales, marketing, and deal ops on the same gateway we sell to customers. We are building an entire company operating system around them, and you will help build it. **Traction** Since launching in February 2026, we have grown to 50\+ paying customers, with strong inbound demand. Customers include Coursera, Arlo, and Braze. We are backed by Cowboy Ventures and Coatue, with angels including Frederic Kerrest (Okta), Michael Grinich (WorkOS), Andrej Karpathy, Jeff Dean, and Scott Belsky. Our founders are machine learning experts from Stanford, Berkeley, and CMU, with applied research at Google Brain and Waymo, and one co\-founded Coursera. **The Job** You will own features end to end, from conception to production, across our gateway infrastructure, enterprise deployments, and agentic systems. The work leans backend and infra, but nothing is off limits: when the product needs a better UI you build it, and when a connector breaks during a security review you fix it. Claude and Codex are your primary working environment, and you use a fleet of agents to move faster than a team this size has any right to. Agents write much of the code and review PRs, so your real job is the judgment they cannot make: shaping the problem, making architecture, product, and UX calls, hardening enterprise paths, designing connectors, protecting security\-sensitive surfaces, and catching generated code that is quietly wrong. Roles are blurred and we ship within hours, and you will learn directly from the founders and from customers. We hire across levels, from strong early\-career builders to seasoned engineers, and we set level and pay to match. What matters most is judgment, range, and how fast you ship. **About You** * You are a builder with a track record of shipping to real users, whether that is a product, an internal tool, an open\-source project, or a serious side project. You ship, then iterate, without waiting for specs or approvals. * You have strong fundamentals and learn fast. How quickly you pick things up matters as much as years of experience. * You care about product value and customer needs over technical purity. * You take infra seriously. You think about blast radius, trust boundaries, and what happens when your code is in the path of every customer's agents. * You can read unfamiliar code, reason from first principles, and explain your tradeoffs. * You are comfortable across the stack (TypeScript, Python, CockroachDB), or you pick up new languages, protocols, and domains fast. * You are excited to build with agents, and to learn when they help and when they hide a problem. * You already build with AI every day and want room to move without heavy process. **Nice to have:** * Developer\-facing products, protocol or gateway work, or infrastructure at scale. * Background in security, identity, or permission systems. * Contributions to open source, MCP servers, or agentic frameworks. * Design sensibility: engineers who care about design, designers who think about infrastructure. **What we offer:** * Competitive compensation and meaningful equity. * Unusual scope and ownership of features that ship to enterprise customers. * Building and deploying agents on the same platform we sell. * Direct access to the founders, customer context, and product direction, with mentorship as you grow. * Health benefits, on a team that puts family and health first. *Prefer to have your agent apply? Point it at* *https://www.mintmcp.com/hiring/mcp*

back\-end systems. * Build scalable microservices architectures utilizing cloud infrastructure like AWS or Azure, ensuring high availability and performance. * Collaborate with cross\-functional teams scalable systems using microservices architecture and applying design patterns for robustness. * Familiarity with programming languages including Java, Python, C\+\+, Ruby on Rails, VBA, C\#, and jobs.title: Software Engineer — AI-Native CAD Integrations
jobs.description: **Location** ------------ Remote \- US **Employment Type** ------------------- Full time **Location Type** ----------------- Remote **Department** -------------- Engineering **Compensation** ---------------- * $150K – $160K • Offers Equity The base salary will be determined by the level and scope of the role, along with the candidate’s experience, skills, credentials, education, and performance in the interviews. We view equity as long\-term ownership, giving team members the opportunity to participate directly in the company’s future growth and success. **About Quilter** ================= At Quilter, we are helping electrical engineers save time and accomplish more by automating the tedious and time\-consuming task of designing printed circuit boards (PCBs). Our small team is composed of experts in electrical engineering, electromagnetic simulation, ML/AI, and high\-performance computing (HPC). We are inventing and leveraging novel techniques to solve the decades\-old problem of automating circuit board design where today hundreds of billions of dollars are spent. We have raised $25 million in Series B funding from some of the very best and are charging full\-speed toward our goal. No matter where we come from, we're united by a common vision for the future and a core set of values we think will get us there: * Curiosity * Conviction * Rigor Quilter's File I/O team builds the bridges between Quilter and the world's leading PCB CAD tools—Altium, Cadence Allegro, and Siemens Xpedition. You'll work primarily in our Python File I/O codebase: parsing, translating, and generating complex (and often undocumented) CAD formats, and mapping them into Quilter's internal "board" model. This is a genuinely AI\-native team—and we'll make you *dangerous* with it. A lot of companies say "we use AI." Here, we will pay for you to master it: * Build your own agent harnesses for the kind of reverse\-engineering we do—parsing undocumented binary formats, mapping vendor schemas, automating the tedious parts of integration work. * Run real model evals on our actual problems—not vibes or Twitter threads. * Develop genuine craft in prompting, context engineering, and MCP server design—skills that compound over your whole career. * Operate with the leverage of a team of ten. Work that used to require a squad of engineers, you'll learn to ship solo. * *You'll leave this job a substantially more capable engineer than you arrived.* **That's the deal.** **What You'll Do** * Build and extend integrations with CAD vendors' file formats and scripting systems. * Reverse\-engineer proprietary binary and text\-based formats, with support from senior engineers. * Help shape Quilter's internal PCB representation as we expand support for new tools. * Write robust, well\-tested code that holds up against messy real\-world customer data. * Use—and help build—the next generation of agent\-powered workflows for CAD reverse engineering. * Own features end\-to\-end: design, implementation, testing, rollout. **What We're Looking For** * 3\-7 years of software engineering experience, with meaningful backend or systems work. * Strong Python proficiency. This is the language you'll spend nearly all your time in, and real expertise here matters more than anything else on this list. A track record of writing clean, maintainable code in real production codebases. * Genuine excitement about coding agents and a real hunger to get great at them—you want a team that will invest in that growth, not throttle it. * Comfort with ambiguous, reverse\-engineering\-flavored problems: unfamiliar code, undocumented formats, weird edge cases. * General knowledge of binary formats. * Solid fundamentals in design, testing, and debugging. * Strong communication and high ownership in a fast\-moving startup environment. **Nice to Have** (genuinely nice\-to\-have — none of these are required, and we don't expect any one candidate to have most of them) * A little C or C\+\+ — not required at all, but occasionally helpful for skimming vendor SDKs or binary formats. * Familiarity with PCB / EDA / CAD workflows or hardware tinkering. * Experience with binary or large\-scale serialization formats (protobuf, custom binary, XML, JSON). * Experience building tooling around coding agents (evals, harnesses, MCP servers, etc.). * Cloud infra (AWS, Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform). * Open\-source contributions in developer tooling, CAD, or simulation. **Please note**: We are an equal opportunity employer. At this time, we are focused on hiring primarily within the US, with occasional exception to accommodate exceptional talent. **What we offer:** ================== * Interesting and challenging work * Competitive salary and equity benefits * Health, dental, and vision insurance * Regular team events and offsites (\~4x / year) * Unlimited paid time off * Paid parental leave

jobs.title: Sr. Full-Stack Software Engineer
jobs.description: **Job Title:** Sr. Full\-Stack Engineer **Team:** Engineering **Location:** Onsite \- Sawtelle (Between Santa Monica \& West LA) or San Francisco, CA **Employment Type:** Fulltime, Salary, Exempt **Reports To:** Engineering Lead **About Plug** -------------- Plug is an automotive fintech startup building the marketplace for electric vehicles. Consumers, dealers, and commercial partners trade in, sell, and auction used EVs through a platform built exclusively for electric, with nothing adapted from legacy automotive. Consumers can get an instant cash offer in minutes, backed by data\-driven pricing, battery state\-of\-health analysis, with pickup, payment, and title transfer handled end\-to\-end. Franchise and independent dealers across the United States bid in real time on inventory sourced directly from these consumers, dealers, and commercial partners. The result is a single platform that gives sellers a fast, fair exit and gives dealers a dedicated channel for sourcing used EV inventory. Founded in 2023 and led by former Tesla executives, Plug has facilitated $100M in EV sales since launch and is backed by a $20M Series A from Lightspeed Venture Partners. We're building the most AI\-native startup team in Los Angeles, full of operators, engineers, and ML researchers laying the transaction rails for the used EV market's exponential growth. **Why Plug** ------------ * You'll own a piece of the biggest infrastructure opportunity in automotive. * You'll work on a platform built exclusively for EVs, with nothing adapted from legacy automotive. * You'll be part of an AI\-native company. We're rethinking how work gets done at a fundamental level. * You'll work directly with operators who have scaled multi\-billion dollar businesses in automotive, EV, and marketplaces. * You'll have real ownership, high autonomy, and a direct line to company outcomes. **The Opportunity** ------------------- We are looking for a Senior Engineer to join our growing team! A senior full\-stack software engineer who will report to our engineering lead, and who will own entire customer\-facing or internal products. We're building systems like AI\-powered pricing intelligence, real\-time connectivity to vehicle manufacturer APIs, auction application, and data pipelines that aggregate EV\-specific information from dozens of sources \- all to make the wholesale EV market faster, smarter, and more transparent. As a member of the team you'll help lay the technical and product foundation for our growing business. We're building a culture that cares about collaboration, encourages intellectual honesty, celebrates technical excellence, and is driven by careful attention to detail and planning for the future. We believe diversity of perspective and experience are key to building great technology and a thriving team. Sounds cool? Let's work together. **What You’ll Do** ------------------ * Collaborate with colleagues and be a strong voice in product design sessions, architecture discussions, and code reviews. * Design, implement, test, debug, and document work on new and existing software features and products, ensuring they meet business, quality, and operational needs. * Take ownership of features and products, and support their planning and development by understanding the ultimate goal and evaluating effort, risk, and priority in an agile environment. * Use agentic coding tools to write clear, efficient, and scalable code with an eye towards flexibility and maintainability. * Own and contribute to team productivity and process improvements. * Use and develop APIs to create integrations between Plug and 3rd party platforms. * Actively raise the technical bar of the team through thoughtful code review, pairing, and knowledge sharing \- including how you use AI tools. * Be an integral part of a close team of developers; this is an opportunity to help shape a nascent team culture. The ideal candidate will be a high\-growth individual able to grow their career as the team grows. **What You’ll Bring** --------------------- * 5\-8 years of hands\-on experience developing and delivering production applications. * Demonstrated proficiency in TypeScript across the full stack \- backend, frontend, relational databases, and API/webhook integrations. Temporal experience is a strong plus. * Hands\-on experience deploying and operating cloud\-hosted applications; comfort with infrastructure\-as\-code (we use Terraform), CI/CD pipelines, feature flags, and observability tooling. * Operates in agent\-first development workflows \- comfortable orchestrating multiple agents, defining clear acceptance criteria, and reviewing AI\-generated output with a high quality bar. * A strong engineering quality bar \- writing tests, conducting code reviews, producing code that is readable by both humans and AI agents, and communicating clearly in writing. * Considers cross\-surface and downstream implications of technical decisions \- writes code and designs systems that other engineers can understand, extend, and depend on. * Prior startup experience and a track record of owning work end\-to\-end: scoping, shipping, and measuring impact. * Authorized to work in the US for any employer. * Prior experience in automotive or EV systems is a plus. **Compensation and Benefits** ----------------------------- Annual salary: $175,000\-$215,000 *Salary ranges reflect independent, third\-party benchmarking against national compensation data. Where an individual's actual offer falls within that range depends on a combination of factors, including relevant experience, specialized skills, training and qualifications, current business needs, and prevailing market conditions. Ranges are reviewed periodically and may be adjusted to reflect changing market conditions.* **Benefits \& Perks:** * Health, Vision, and Dental insurance * 401(k) plan * Daily lunch stipend * Equity (based on role and performance) * 30\-day remote work from anywhere policy * Unlimited PTO * Fully stocked kitchen * Dog\-friendly office * Ongoing opportunities for growth and development This full\-time position is an in\-person role ideally based in Sawtelle (between Santa Monica and West Los Angeles). We are headquartered in Los Angeles and is our preferred location, with relocation assistance provided for successful candidates who need to relocate. Candidates already based in the San Francisco area will also be considered; relocation is not required for these candidates. Sponsorship is not available at this time. **Acknowledgments** Plug is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We believe diverse teams build better products \- full stop.
