jobs.description: ### **About the Role** As a Software Engineer at K Health, you are the champion of technical excellence for a high\-stakes portfolio of clinical AI and a suite of products that serve the patients and the physicians. We don't just build apps; we build, and operate modern, AI\-powered, 24/7 virtual clinics for the nation's largest health systems. In this role, your mission is to help build a product ecosystem where reliability, privacy, and performance are non\-negotiable. You will develop reusable components and resilient architectures that exude trust, ensuring that every patient interaction is seamless and every clinical data point is secure. You will be a "multiplier," creating the foundational frameworks that allow us to deploy 5\-star experiences across a portfolio of partners without sacrificing the quality our users depend on. **This role requires onsite presence in our New York City office 4 days a week and does not provide immigration support.** ### **What you will do** * Full\-Stack: Support the end\-to\-end lifecycle of products and features, from multi\-platform clients, to the Kotlin/JVM\-based backend services that power them. * Quality as a Feature: Enforce standards for high\-stakes engineering—ensuring that performance, accessibility, and data privacy are baked into every feature * Platform Innovation: Proactively modernize our systems to leverage agentic AI tools that improve developer productivity and team efficiency. * Technical Stewardship: Act as a stabilizing force in complex technical situations, bringing clarity to ambiguous requirements and making informed decisions that mitigate risk. * Mentor \& Multiply: Level up the engineering organization by fostering an ownership mindset and modeling how to move fast while maintaining clinical\-grade quality. ### **What we are looking for** * Established Expertise: 3\-5\+ years of professional software engineering experience, with a deep focus on building robust, customer\-facing products from front\-to\-back. * Full Stack Fluency: Strong professional experience in front\-to\-back\-end development using Node/Typescript with a JVM language (Kotlin or Java) as a major plus. * Middle Layer Proficiency: You understand how to build resilient APIs that support critical workflows on any user\-facing platform. We leverage GraphQL and Typescript heavily in the middle layers. * Tasteful User Experience: You develop with the customer in mind, and prioritize their experience across the functional and non\-functional considerations that shape the overall experience across Web and for Mobile platforms. * AI\-First Mindset: Proficiency with modern agentic development tools (i.e., Claude Code), using them effectively across platforms to deliver high\-quality code quickly and reliably. * Repeatable Patterns Mentality: Experience building reusable frameworks, white\-label solutions, or multi\-tenant architectures where code quality directly impacts multiple products. * Mission\-Driven Reliability: A background in high\-stakes industries (e.g., HealthTech, ConsumerTech, or Conversational AI) where performance and privacy are paramount. * Autonomy \& Judgment: Proven ability to work with high levels of autonomy, using your expertise to "do the right thing" for the patient and the partner. * Education: A Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science or a related technical field. ### **Bonus** * KMP: Experience with Kotlin Multiplatform to drive logic sharing across the portfolio. * Security Expertise: Deep knowledge of security best practices and data encryption. * Clinical Integration: Experience with healthcare standards (FHIR, HL7\) or integrating with EHR systems. **Benefits \& Perks:**\#LI\-Hybrid * Hybrid work schedule with weekly lunches and stocked fridges * Monthly social committees for company events * 18 vacation days, 9 company holidays, 5 sick days, and 2 personal days * Stock options for every full\-time employee * Paid parental leave * 401k benefit * Commuter Benefits * Competitive health, dental, and vision insurance options **Who We Are:** Behind every leading health system is K Health's AI\-powered virtual care engine. Our deeply integrated model modernizes the primary care loop by using AI to put humans first. For our patients, we offer clinical AI (i.e., PatientGPT) and unparalleled access to close care gaps around the clock. For our Providers, we deliver provider\-serving agentic solutions (i.e., Perfect Note) to eliminate administrative overload and burnout. And for the health systems, we deploy our top\-grade Virtualists in AI\-powered virtual clinics 24/7 to capture the patients' care journeys at step one, retain the journey through the system for longitudinal care, and strengthen profitability. We're founded in 2016, headquartered in New York City, and backed by over $443\.5M from leading investors including Valor Equity Partners, Claure Group, Mangrove Capital Partners, 14W, Notable Capital, Lerer Hippeau, Primary Venture Partners, Comcast Ventures, PICO Venture Partners, Max Ventures, and other strategic healthcare partners. *We offer competitive compensation packages based on industry benchmarks for function, level, and geographic location. We depend on our differences to make our team stronger, our workplace more dynamic, and our product accessible to all of our users.* *We are committed to maintaining the integrity of our hiring process and ensuring a safe environment for all candidates. jobs.description: Job Description Job Title: Support Engineer I (Tier 1 Support Technician)\- Bilingual (Spanish/English) Location: Dallas, Texas (On\-Site – only local candidates will be considered) Employment Type: Full\-Time About K3 Technology K3 Technology is a leading IT services company dedicated to helping medium to large\-sized businesses overcome IT challenges. As a cloud\-centric organization with deep expertise in developing custom solutions, we integrate and optimize systems to create unified data\-sharing environments and robust BI/analytics platforms. In this on\-site role, you will be the first point of contact for our clients—triaging tickets, handling service requests, and resolving both basic and advanced IT issues. Your high emotional IQ and sense of ownership will be key in delivering the white\-glove support our clients expect. Documentation: Maintain detailed records of ticket activities and resolutions to support ongoing process improvements. jobs.title: Software Deployment Engineer
jobs.description: About KPI Solutions KPI Solutions is a national supply chain consulting and warehouse automation systems integrator, helping some of the biggest names in e\-commerce, retail, and distribution move product faster and smarter. Formed in 2021 through the combination of Kuecker Logistics Group, PULSE Integration, and QC Software, KPI brings together decades of material handling and systems integration experience — rooted in material handling integration dating back to 1971\. From initial design through go\-live and ongoing support, KPI delivers engineered solutions that blend automated technologies (MHE, robotics, conveyor, ASRS, AMR/AGV) with intelligent warehouse execution software to optimize productivity, increase fulfillment speed, and build operational resilience for clients. **Position Summary** The Software Deployment Engineer I/II is an individual\-contributor role responsible for the end\-to\-end delivery, configuration, installation, and support of Kommand warehouse execution/control systems and related material handling hardware (pick\-to\-light, overhead illuminators, AutoStore, and T\-sort integrations). This role owns project\-level system configuration, commissioning, installation, upgrade, and live troubleshooting work independently, with minimal oversight, across both on\-site and remote/office phases of the project lifecycle. It combines software commissioning, hardware coordination, database scripting, environment configuration, and formal test/sign\-off responsibilities that have historically been distributed across multiple roles and a dedicated installation team. This position carries broadened scope following the consolidation of hardware installation and commissioning functions previously performed by a dedicated Systems Integration \& Commissioning (SI\&C) team, which has since been dissolved. The Software Deployment Engineer I/II is expected to operate as the primary and, in several functions, sole point of ownership for the responsibilities outlined below. **Key Responsibilities** **On\-Site Delivery** * Lead software commissioning of Kommand and peripheral hardware systems at customer sites; serve as primary technical owner, with hardware\-side support from junior/peer staff. * Own full\-scope installation of pick\-to\-light systems, including wiring, physical installation, configuration, and functional testing — a scope absorbed from the former SI\&C team. * Own full\-scope installation of overhead illuminator systems, following the same end\-to\-end responsibility as above. * Conduct IQ (Installation Qualification) and UAT (User Acceptance Testing) following installation, including preparation of formal test documentation and customer sign\-off. * Serve as the sole owner of Kommand and system\-level troubleshooting for live, in\-production issues during on\-site engagements. **Remote / Office Delivery** * Independently deliver new Kommand installations, including application pre\-configuration, database scripting, and pre\-deployment testing. Sole personnel on this workstream, currently managing 4 upcoming and 1 active installation. * Independently deliver Kommand version upgrades, including SSDT (SQL Server Data Tools) schema comparisons, version control, local pre\-install testing, and direct customer coordination. Sole personnel on this workstream, with approximately 22 major upgrades planned in the current year. * Production upgrade execution is performed after standard business hours to minimize customer downtime. * DEV, QA, and Sandbox environment work is performed during standard business hours. * Validate, diagnose, and remediate reported defects; route confirmed fixes to QA prior to merge and deployment. Escalation to other engineering resources is rare. * Participate in the on\-call rotation covering Kommand, AutoStore, and T\-sort system escalations. * Provide post\-go\-live project support on an as\-needed basis, including system migrations (e.g., bin/location migrations), integration testing with customer ERP/WMS platforms (e.g., SAP/WMS), and multi\-site rollout support. **Project Configuration \& Deployment** * Gather all Kommand configurations and system parameters required for a given project. * Translate the Business Requirements Document (BRD) and customer conversations into the Kommand system settings spreadsheet, network spreadsheet, and system parameters. * Educate the client on use of the host interface. * Not required for all projects — dependent on whether the customer's integration involves interface changes (e.g., AutoCase, Pack \& Hold). * Configure the client's Kommand sandbox environment to be project\-specific for customer testing, and support the client through that testing. * Configure the Kommand production environment ahead of go\-live. * Assist with training on any new features requiring customer or internal education. **Scope \& Independence** This role currently operates as the sole owner of several critical workstreams, including all new Kommand installations, all Kommand upgrade delivery, and all live Kommand/system troubleshooting. The role requires the judgment and technical depth to manage customer\-facing delivery, testing, and sign\-off without a dedicated support team, and to make sound decisions under time pressure during after\-hours production changes and live escalations. **Requirements** * Demonstrated experience commissioning warehouse execution/control software and associated hardware peripherals. * Working knowledge of SQL Server\-based application environments, including SSDT schema comparison and version control practices. * Experience with formal software testing methodology (IQ/UAT), including documentation and customer sign\-off processes. * Ability to independently diagnose, troubleshoot, and resolve live production issues under time pressure. * Comfort with hands\-on installation work (wiring, hardware configuration) for pick\-to\-light and overhead illumination systems, or willingness/ability to develop this competency. * Willingness to work after hours and participate in an on\-call rotation. * Ability to translate business requirements documentation and customer conversations into structured system configuration (settings, network, and parameter specifications). * Strong customer\-facing communication skills; comfortable coordinating directly with customer stakeholders during upgrades, go\-live support, and system/interface training. **Preferred Qualifications** * Prior experience with AutoStore and/or T\-sort systems. * Experience with ERP/WMS integration testing (e.g., SAP). * Background in material handling, warehouse automation, or industrial controls environments. **Benefits** **What we Offer:** * + Medical Insurance * + Dental Insurance * + Vision Insurance * + Health Care Concierge Service * + 401(k) Retirement Plan (Pre\-tax \& Roth) * + Company paid Basic Life Insurance, Short\-Term Disability \& Long\-Term Disability * + Voluntary Life \& AD\&D Insurance * + Voluntary Accident, Critical Illness \& Hospital Indemnity Insurance * + Pet Insurance * + Milk Stork Program * + Wellness Program with gift card redemption and wellness challenges * + Paid Time Off (Vacation, Sick \& 10 Holidays) * + Training \& Development **Why KPI Solutions?** At KPI Solutions, you’ll be part of a team that values innovation, accountability, and continuous improvement. This is more than a reporting role—it’s an opportunity to make a measurable impact on project success and business performance. *KPI Solutions provides equal employment opportunity to all individuals regardless of their race, color, creed, religion, gender, age, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by states, federal, or local law.*

jobs.title: Embedded Software Engineer – New Product Launch (6-12-month Contract)
jobs.description: **Embedded Software Engineer – New Product Launch (6\-12\-month Contract) — Build the brains inside real instruments** **KPM Analytics \| Westborough, MA (Onsite position \- Must be able to commute to the site)** Ever wanted to write firmware that actually ships? Not a toy project, not a simulation, real code running inside a real instrument, headed to real customers. KPM Analytics is bringing a new instrumentation product to market, and we need an embedded engineer who's hungry to get hands\-on with it. Think microcontrollers, sensors, real\-time systems, and a Windows app that ties it all together. **You'll get your hands on:** * NXP microcontroller firmware, fixing, building, improving * RTOS environments (if "real\-time" makes your eyes light up, keep reading) * Camera \+ time\-of\-flight sensor integration * Communications protocols, UART, SPI, I²C, USB, CAN, Modbus, take your pick * C\# work inside our SensorVu Windows 11 application * Actual product launch activities, you'll see this thing go out the door **This is for you if:** * You're studying CS, EE, Robotics, Data Science, or something adjacent * You've messed around with NXP chips, RTOS, or sensor interfacing (bonus points for Python/MicroPython or C\#) * You'd rather debug a weird hardware issue than avoid it * You can drop into someone else's codebase and figure it out fast * You want ownership, not busywork **The deal:** 6–12\-month contract, full\-time hands\-on work alongside engineers who've done this before. Great fit if you want real product experience before you graduate, or if you're between things and want to build something that matters. If this sounds like your kind of problem to solve, we want to hear from you.

Great fit if you want real product experience before you graduate, or if you're between things and want to build something that matters. If this sounds like your kind of problem to solve, we want to hear from you. Pay: $17\.00 \- $22\.00 per hour Application Question(s): * Are you currently enrolled in a degree program in Computer Science, Data Science, Electrical Engineering, Robotics, or a related field? * Do you have hands\-on experience with NXP microcontrollers? * Have you developed or debugged firmware in an RTOS environment? * Do you have experience with C\# and Windows desktop application development? * Have you worked with any of the following communications protocols: UART, SPI, I²C, USB, CAN, Ethernet, or Modbus? * Do you have experience interfacing sensors (e.g., camera or time\-of\-flight sensors) with embedded systems? Ability to Commute: * Westborough, MA 01581 (Required) Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Applications Developer I
jobs.description: #### **Join Housing and Dining Services as an Applications Developer I, supporting the development and maintenance of custom web applications and cloud\-based products while collaborating with a team of IT professionals.** * 522203 * Manhattan, Kansas, United States * Department of Housing \& Dining * Staff Full Time (Unclassified \- Regular) * Closing at: Oct 5 2026 \- 23:55 CDT * On\-site The Applications Developer I offers an opportunity to work alongside a seasoned team of IT professionals and student developers supporting Housing and Dining Services (HDS), a large and complex department dedicated to providing high\-quality services that strengthen the student experience at Kansas State University. This position contributes to the goals and strategies for HDS web\-based applications and works collaboratively with service\-oriented, passionate professionals across the department. Projects provide opportunities to apply technical skills, develop creative and practical solutions, and interact with a broad customer base. The position also provides opportunities to mentor student developers and contribute to the ongoing improvement, security, and effectiveness of HDS technology services. **Duties and Responsibilities** **Application Support** * Assist with the administration and support of web\-based and client applications in a distributed, multi\-server environment. * Monitor web\-based applications for problems, outdated information, and adherence to established standards; provide reports and recommendations to management. * Recommend site enhancements and identify solutions to application and technical problems. * Evaluate new project requests and design, build, code, test, deploy, and maintain applications. * Apply software development best practices, design patterns, and coding standards. * Mentor student programming staff in software design patterns, coding guidelines, and development practices. **Customer Support** * Serve as a primary contact regarding the use of departmental web\-based applications; answer questions and diagnose and resolve customer issues. * Educate customers on accessibility, application standards, current technologies, and new web technologies. * Develop methods and tools to facilitate web\-based application maintenance for customers. * Develop online and printed documentation for departmental web\-based applications. * Serve as a customer advocate in application planning and development processes. * Collaborate with the HDS Helpdesk (ResNet) and/or K\-State IT Helpdesk to track customer issues and resolutions and measure customer satisfaction. **Team Development** * Assist with mentoring, training, hiring, and evaluating a multi\-person web development team consisting of hourly student staff. * Participate in establishing goals and coordinating strategies for developing and supporting HDS web\-based applications. * Make measurable contributions to software development projects and team initiatives. **Enterprise Security** * Provide innovative suggestions to improve existing processes and implement new security measures that strengthen the enterprise security posture. * Participate as a team member in implementing new or updated security measures. * Monitor compliance with information security policies and procedures and appropriately refer concerns. **About Us** ------------ The Department of Housing and Dining Services offers award\-winning dining centers, residence halls, and apartment neighborhoods. We pride ourselves in taking excellent care of our residents, and that is reflected in our recent Princeton Review rankings. The 2025 Princeton Review ranks us \#2 Happiest Students, \#2 Best Quality of Life, \#8 Best College Residence Halls, and \#14 Best Campus Food. From fostering community in our residence halls, to serving up delicious home cooked meals in the dining centers, and teaching responsibility and leadership through student employment throughout our department, Housing and Dining strives for residents to have a well\-rounded and positive experience living on\-campus. Functional areas within the department include administrative, maintenance, student living, and dining services. **Worksite Description** ------------------------ This position is **On\-site**. All employees must reside in the United States when they begin working to comply with state law. K\-State is unable to provide remote or hybrid work opportunities for residents of the state of Idaho. **What You'll Need to Succeed** ------------------------------- **Minimum Qualifications:** * Requires a high school diploma (or equivalent) and six years of relevant experience. Requirements may be met through a combination of work experience and education. **Preferred Qualifications:** * Bachelor's degree in MIS, CIS, business administration or related field. * Three years’ experience as an application developer or web developer. * Knowledge of the use of usability good practice and standards and testing in web ap lving skills **Sponsorship eligibility:** Candidates must be legally authorized to work in the U.S. on an ongoing basis without sponsorship **How to Apply** ---------------- Please submit the following documents: * Letter of interest * Resume * Names and contact information for three professional references **Application Window** ---------------------- Applications close on: October 5, 2026 **Anticipated Hiring Pay Range** -------------------------------- $22\.83 \- $28\.00 per hour **Why Join Us:** ---------------- Kansas State University offers a supportive and inclusive community, dedicated to your professional growth. While specific benefits may vary by position, many roles come with comprehensive packages that support your well\-being and work\-life balance, including health and life insurance, retirement plans, and generous paid time off. To learn more about benefits that are available for various positions, visit our benefits overview page. **Work Authorization and Sponsorship:** --------------------------------------- Employees must be authorized to work in the United States at the time of employment. International candidates who require employer\-sponsored work authorization are welcome to apply. Eligibility for visa sponsorship depends on several factors, including but not limited to, the job’s occupational requirements, specific duties, wage level, the candidate’s qualifications (such as degree field) and available departmental resources. As a result, not all positions or applicants will be eligible for sponsorship. **Equal Employment Opportunity:** --------------------------------- Kansas State University is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, age, national origin, disability or status as a protected veteran. **Remote and Hybrid work options:** ----------------------------------- Some positions are eligible for remote or hybrid working arrangements. An employee who is working in a remote or hybrid capacity for K\-State must reside within the United States in order to comply with all federal and state laws, filings, or tax requirements. Remote and hybrid work arrangements are not available for anyone who resides in the state of Idaho. **Relocation to Kansas:** ------------------------- Kansas participates in the MakeMyMove program, which connects eligible newcomers with participating communities offering financial incentives, housing support, and local perks to help make your move easier and more rewarding. If relocating from outside of Kansas you can visit the site to apply online for the program incentives. **Background Screening Statement:** ----------------------------------- Upon acceptance of a contingent offer of employment, a candidate may be subject to a background check per K\-State’s background check policy. **Interview Preferences:** -------------------------- Kansas State University honors interview preferences for qualified applicants who are veterans or individuals with disabilities. Eligible applicants who meet the minimum qualifications, submit all required application materials, and submit required preference documentation by the closing date on the job advertisement will be granted a first\-level interview. The disability and veteran interview preferences do not apply to student employment positions, temporary positions, athletics positions, academic and administrative department heads\*, positions that require licensure as a physician, and positions that require that the employee be admitted to practice law in Kansas. * *Heads of Departments refers to any individual holding a primary leadership role responsible for the overall strategic direction, management and operational oversight of a recognized academic or administrative unit within the university.* To learn more about interview preferences at K\-State, please visit our **interview preferences page**.

jobs.title: Lead Systems Engineer
jobs.description: Kapsch is one of Austria's most successful global technology companies. With its comprehensive ITS (Intelligent Transportation Systems) portfolio, Kapsch is actively addressing the challenges of the present and the future with intelligent mobility solutions in a wide range of application areas. As a family\-owned company founded in 1892 and headquartered in Vienna, Kapsch can look back on 130 years of experience with the future. To learn more about our solutions and innovations, visit our website here. As Lead Systems Engineer, you'll hold the highest level of technical ownership on our Systems Engineering track, joining a dispersed, cross\-disciplinary team of hardware, software, and electrical engineers. You'll own how the pieces come together as one working system — roadside hardware, embedded devices, applications, and back\-office software — from bid phase through integration, commissioning, and operational handoff on high\-visibility tolling and roadside infrastructure programs that continue to expand as the toll road increases in capacity, capabilities and integrates new technologies. This is a role for someone who wants to be the technical face of the client relationship, build trust with customers over the life of a program, and own the requirements baseline from the first conversation through final acceptance. You'll translate customer needs into clear, buildable, and verifiable requirements; manage expectations and scope as the solution evolves; and lead difficult technical conversations. You'll also hold the seams between hardware and software where most programs get into trouble, maintain the end\-to\-end technical view of the solution, and step in to drive the technical path forward whenever the team hits a roadblock. **How You'll Make an Impact** * **Serve as the primary technical point of contact** —Lead technical discussions, understand the client's business and operational objectives, communicate tradeoffs clearly, manage expectations, and navigate difficult technical or scope conversations with professionalism and sound judgment. * **Own the requirements baseline end\-to\-end** — lead requirements elicitation, analysis, decomposition, specification, validation, traceability, and change control from the first customer conversation through final acceptance. Translate customer needs and contractual requirements into clear, testable, and achievable system requirements, while identifying gaps, ambiguities, dependencies, and risks before they become program issues. * **Manage requirements and scope as the solution evolves** — establish and maintain requirements traceability across hardware, software, electrical, integration, and verification activities. * **Own the integrated solution end\-to\-end** — from bid\-phase sales support, proposal review, and requirement gap analysis, through hardware and software design decisions, to integration, commissioning, and operational handoff. * **Overall responsibility for the technical implementation** \- including installation/implementation phase ensuring the system is delivered efficiently to required quality. * **Define and control the interfaces** between roadside hardware (sensors, cameras, controllers, gantry equipment, power) and the software layer (applications, databases, back\-office systems) — specifying protocols, data flows, timing, dependencies, and failure behavior so subsystems perform as one system. * **Support integration, verification, and validation** — support the test and commissioning strategy, drive FAT/SAT, and lead troubleshooting where hardware, firmware, and software meet in the field. * **Design and maintain the full solution architecture** — systems, interfaces, protocols, databases, and applications — while maintaining end\-to\-end awareness of where bottlenecks exist, where requirements are at risk, and where the design can be optimized. * **Lead cross\-functional teams across the program** — align hardware, software, and electrical engineering against a single requirements baseline, resolve technical dependencies, and keep both internal stakeholders and the client informed as the design evolves. * **Build out the physical design layer** — wiring diagrams, civil drawing interpretation, and cable/conduit layouts — partnering with highway designers to fit our technology into the physical infrastructure. * **Set the technical direction and standard for how the team delivers** — step in to unblock the team and propose solutions when work stalls, challenge assumptions constructively, and provide the technical leadership needed to keep the program moving. * **Connect technical execution to customer outcomes** — understand not only what the system must do, but why the client needs it to work that way. Use that understanding to make practical engineering decisions, communicate tradeoffs, and deliver solutions that satisfy both technical requirements and operational objectives. **What Makes You a Great Fit** * Bachelor's Degree in E rs, understanding their needs, managing expectations, communicating technical tradeoffs, and handling difficult scope or technical discussions directly with the customer. * 5\+ years implementing technical solutions, with a practical background in systems engineering, including system architectures, interfaces, protocols, databases, and frameworks. * Demonstrated ownership of hardware/software integration through at least one full lifecycle — design, integration, test, commissioning, and handoff. * 4\+ years of experience and expertise across two or more of: electrical, mechanical, civil, structural, software, embedded/firmware, database, or systems integration engineering. * Strong requirements engineering experience — eliciting requirements from customers and stakeholders, writing and decomposing requirements, identifying gaps and ambiguities, establishing traceability from customer specifications through verification, and managing requirements and change control on a live program. * Excellent communication and relationship\-management skills, with the ability to establish credibility with both technical and non\-technical stakeholders and maintain productive client relationships through challenging project situations. * Working knowledge of IP networking — enough to integrate, configure, and troubleshoot devices on the network (our environment runs on Cisco). Certification not required. * Proven ability to lead technical conversations with customers, make sound technical decisions, and guide successful cross\-functional collaboration. * Ability to develop and deliver technical presentations while engaging with and managing client relationships. * Strong written communication skills, including the ability to produce clear requirements, specifications, interface definitions, technical documentation, and customer\-facing communications. * Ability to recognize when a customer request represents a requirement clarification, a change in scope, or a technical risk — and appropriately manage each situation. * Curiosity, ownership, and a roll\-up\-your\-sleeves mindset, balanced with strong team collaboration. **Bonus Qualifications** * Professional Engineer (PE) license or Engineer in Training (EIT) certification. * Networking certification (CCNA, CCNP, or equivalent). * Background in tolling or traffic systems. * Prior technical or people leadership. * Project management skills, with knowledge of business economics. * Experience estimating time and effort for system functionalities. * Familiarity with relevant international standards. **What We Offer** ----------------- * The opportunity to solve complex problems that improve the daily lives of people around the world. * Career growth, stability, and the opportunity to develop within a global organization. * A full benefits package, including unlimited paid time off, 11 paid holidays, 401(k), a no\-cost medical insurance option for employees and eligible dependents, and an FSA option. **Take the next step in your career with Kapsch** *We believe hiring is a human decision. AI supports some of the operational side of our process (things like interview scheduling and coordination), but every step that matters is handled by a person. Your application will be read, your interviews will be conducted, and your offer will be made by humans who are genuinely invested in getting it right.* *Applicants must have working rights in the US and pass a background check.* *Kapsch is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities throughout the recruitment process. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please contact our TA team. Kapsch TrafficCom is an Equal Opportunity Employer and is committed to creating an inclusive workplace. We consider all qualified applicants for employment without regard to any legally protected characteristic under applicable federal, state, or local law. Kapsch TrafficCom is a drug\-free workplace.*

jobs.title: Site Director - Moses Lake (Grant Node)
jobs.description: **Careers at Keel** Keel Infrastructure is a publicly traded energy and digital infrastructure company that develops and owns data centers and power assets across North America. At Keel, you're not just joining a company, you're helping build the infrastructure behind the future of compute. **Why Keel** We're at the intersection of energy and technology, two industries transforming in real time. The work is complex. The pace is fast. The impact is real. You'll be part of a team that values: * **Ownership**— we take responsibility and follow through * **Collaboration**— we work across teams, functions, and borders * **Curiosity**— we ask questions and keep learning * **Endurance**— we build for the long term **What It Feels Like to Work Here** * Fast\-moving, high\-growth, and hands\-on * Smart, driven people solving real challenges together * Work that directly supports AI and next\-generation infrastructure * Room to grow, stretch, and take on more **What We Offer** * Competitive salary, bonus and equity opportunities * Comprehensive health and wellness benefits * Retirement savings with company contribution * Employee referral program We are currently looking for a **Site Director \- Moses** **Lake** to join our team **Role summary** ---------------- The senior Keel Operations authority at the Moses Lake facility and the primary point of contact for the anchor tenant. Keel operates a governance model: the FM operations provider runs the plant day to day with its own site organization; this role governs that operator, owns the tenant relationship, and holds the change, escalation, and acceptance authorities that make an outsourced operating model accountable. The role additionally owns the operations side of the construction\-to\-operations transition. Commissioning execution and delivery quality belong to the Keel delivery organization under the Director of Data Center Commissioning \& Quality Assurance; this role is the operations acceptance counterpart at the formal transition\-to\-operations gate — delivery attests completion, operations accepts readiness. This transition scope is front\-loaded into the first two quarters in seat and burns off after occupancy. The dual permanent mandate — operator governance and tenant advocacy — is deliberate and concentrated in one accountable role. The Site Operations Coordinator (direct report) absorbs transactional volume so this role does not degrade into administration. **Key accountabilities** ------------------------ * Hold operations acceptance authority at the formal transition\-to\-operations gate, as dual signatory alongside the Director of Data Center Commissioning \& Quality Assurance: delivery attestation by the delivery organization; operational readiness acceptance by this role, on documented evidence. * Gate FM operator mobilization: CMMS population quality using turnover asset data, PM schedule seeding, shift structure validation, badge and access provisioning, and acceptance of mobilization milestones prior to steady\-state operations and billing. * Verify operational readiness before energization: MOPs/SOPs/EOPs validated through witnessed tabletop and live drills; independent verification of FM operator training competence (beyond training delivery); critical spares confirmed on shelf against the approved list, including long\-lead liquid\-cooling wet\-side spares. Contribute operations scenarios (including thermal transient and CDU failure modes) to the integrated systems test scripts owned by the delivery organization. * Govern FM operator performance in steady state through independent verification against the Keel\-owned KPI framework rather than operator self\-reporting; convert findings into corrective action through the operator's site leadership and, where commercial, through the FM Commercial function. * Hold change management authority: approval of maintenance windows, MOP deviations, deferral requests, and configuration changes above operator\-delegated thresholds. * Serve as Keel incident command interface during abnormal events; own tenant and executive communications; conduct post\-incident review acceptance. * Own the anchor tenant relationship: SLA reporting delivery, escalation interface to the tenant operations team, quarterly business reviews, and the working relationship that protects occupancy economics. * Maintain the site duty rotation and delegated\-authority matrix with the Site Operations Coordinator; ensure the tenant holds a documented escalation path at all times. * Supervise the Site Operations Coordinator. **Explicitly not in scope** --------------------------- Commissioning program ownership, test script development, CxA management, L4/L5 test execution, and construction quality assurance (Director, Data Center Commissioning \& Quality Assurance scope); jobs.title: Data & BI Senior Assoc
jobs.description: **Location:** 4910 Tiedeman Road, Brooklyn Ohio**Job Summary** The Senior Data \& Business Intelligence Associate is primarily responsible for the sourcing, manipulation, preparation, and validation of data for consumption – which may be in the form of production reports or as analytical data sets to answer questions or to perform predictive analysis. The Senior Data \& Business Intelligence Associate uses queries and data mining to produce more complex reports and descriptive analysis that provide answers to questions such as “How do I measure?” and “What happened?”. Through self\-managed data sourcing projects, the Senior Data \& Business Intelligence Associate should liaise between technology partners and the business to engineer data into insightful business intelligence solutions, process improvements / automations, and reports. Success criteria include: leveraging critical thinking, technical expertise, and anticipation of business needs from technology and business partners to provide reporting and analysis or implement process improvements; leading conversations with business partners and effectively communicate with all stakeholders; and providing solutions based on an understanding of impacts / intersections with other business partners and lines of business. **ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS:** * Provide moderate to more complex analysis and reports, leveraging critical thinking and business acumen to source and translate data into business intelligence insights, reports, and analysis that answer business problems * Collaborate and lead conversations with business and technology partners to identify and understand analytic / business needs * Automate and standardize reports for production * Make process improvement suggestions * Effectively communicate key points to respective stakeholders, with the right amount of detail * Review work product of junior staff; provide input, direction, and mentorship **REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS:** * Bachelor’s degree (or its equivalent) in Data Analytics, Business Management, Finance, Economics, Engineering, Computer Science, Management Information Systems, or Statistics (or other related field) with at least 6 years of relevant experience; or Master’s degree (or its equivalent) in Data Analytics, Business Management, Finance, Economics, Engineering, Computer Science, Management Information Systems, or Statistics (or other related field) with at least 4 years of relevant experience * Proficient in: o Advanced Microsoft Excel / PowerPoint o Intermediate/advanced query writing/coding including complex joins. Python or SQL preferred. o Intermediate/advanced data visualization o Analytical programming languages o Report and process automation* **Knowledge or Skill in:** o Process flow o Project management o Google Cloud technologies and tools o Navigation of data warehouse and/or data supply chain o Utilizing Generative AI and agentic technologies to automate reporting processes, accelerate analytics, improve data discovery, generate business insights, and optimize operational workflows while maintaining data governance and regulatory compliance EXPECTED COMPETENCIES: * **Communication**: Solid written and verbal communication skills; organizes material for brevity, persuasiveness, and impact; Effectively communicates key points to respective stakeholders, with the right amount of detail; Proactively shares information beyond those at the table who may have a need to know; Comfortable in situations where conflict is present; Demonstrated presentation development and delivery skills; Ability to create presentations that include the right data/information and tell the right story * **Leadership**: Emerging leader across team; Serves as a role model – may coach and develop others; Provides direction / mentorship to junior staff * **Partnering / Influencing**: Proven relationship building ability; Strong interpersonal skills; Can lead the conversation with business partners; Sought out to by business partners and team members; May coach and develop relationship building skills in others; Developing comfort with influencing and consulting typically with mid\-level leaders * **Business Acumen**: Understands assigned LOB strategy; Knows our industry, competition, and competitive environment; Possesses intellectual curiosity; Understands key drivers of financial results and business impact; Developing understanding of how business works * **Critical Thinking / Problem Solving**: Leverages critical thinking and business acumen to provide solutions to increasingly more complex problems; Ties work with understanding of impacts / intersections with other business partners / LOB; Aware of potential pitfalls with each recommended solution; thoroughly vets and thinks through options before making a decision **Core Competencies** * All KeyBank employees are expected to demonstrate Key’s Values and abide by Key’s Code of Conduct. **Physical Demands** * General Office \- Prolonged sitting, ability to communicate face to face in person or on the phone with teammates and clients, frequent use of PC/laptop, occasional lifting/pushing/pulling of backpacks, computer bags up to 10 lbs. **Work Location Category** * Hybrid (2\+ days) COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS This position is eligible to earn a base salary in the range of $80,000\.00 \- $150,000\.00 annually. jobs.title: Senior Offensive Security Engineer (Red Team)
jobs.description: **Location:** 4910 Tiedeman Road, Brooklyn Ohio**Position Summary** -------------------- Our Cyber Adversary and Exposure Management team rolls up into Key’s broader Cyber Defense function within Corporate Information Security. Cyber Defense’s mission is simple: We aim to Deter, Detect, Deny, and Disrupt adversaries through proactive threat\-centric defense. The Senior Offensive Security Engineer serves as the technical and operational lead for the Cyber Defense Red Team and is responsible for guiding team execution, capability development, operational maturity, and offensive security strategy. The role is responsible for advancing the maturity, consistency, and effectiveness of adversarial simulation, red team, and penetration testing capabilities while providing day\-to\-day leadership for team execution. The role establishes testing strategy and standards, guides engagement planning and quality, coordinates priorities and resources, mentors team members, and drives measurable improvement across the offensive security program. The role also supports Continuous Threat Exposure Management (CTEM) objectives by validating prioritized exposures, assessing attack paths, and measuring the effectiveness of remediation activities against realistic adversary scenarios. The role also simulates advanced cyber adversaries and emulates real\-world adversaries to assess and improve KeyBank’s detection, response, and resilience capabilities. This work goes beyond traditional red teaming and penetration testing by incorporating threat intelligence, custom tooling, and stealthy tradecraft to test the effectiveness of security controls and incident response processes. The ideal candidate will bring significant experience directing adversary emulation, red team engagements, and offensive security operations across enterprise on\-premises and cloud environments, with experience leading or participating in physical security assessments. The role demands exceptional technical proficiency, strategic leadership, operational discipline, and the ability to clearly articulate complex security findings and risk implications to audiences ranging from engineers to senior executives. **Key Responsibilities** ------------------------ ### **Team Leadership \& Operational Management** * Provide day\-to\-day technical and operational team leadership for the Red Team, reporting to the CAEM manager, including work prioritization, engagement assignments, execution oversight, issue escalation, and coordination of team deliverables. * Coach and mentor team members, facilitate knowledge sharing, identify capability gaps, and support development of technical depth and leadership readiness across the team. * Provide third\-party vendor support, dependencies, and stakeholder communications to keep engagements on track and ensure risks, blockers, and decisions are elevated promptly. * Provide hands\-on technical guidance during complex engagements and reinforce safe, responsible, and repeatable adversarial tradecraft. * Partner with Detection Engineering, Security Operations, Threat Intelligence, and Incident Response teams to conduct purple team exercises that validate control effectiveness, detection coverage, and response capabilities against real\-world adversary behaviors. ### **Red Team Strategy, Governance \& Program Maturity** * Lead the development and execution of a maturity roadmap for adversarial simulation, red team, and penetration testing capabilities, including repeatable methodologies, standards, tooling, automation, and quality assurance practices. * Establish and maintain a risk\-based testing strategy and engagement pipeline aligned with enterprise threats, critical assets, regulatory expectations, and stakeholder priorities. * Define and report program metrics that demonstrate coverage, execution quality, remediation outcomes, control validation, and progress against the offensive security maturity roadmap. * Use program metrics and engagement outcomes to identify trends, communicate risk, and prioritize improvements to testing coverage and team capabilities. * Drive continuous improvement of adversarial emulation methodologies, tooling, documentation, and operating practices. * Present offensive security program metrics, engagement outcomes, risk themes, and strategic recommendations to cybersecurity leadership, governance forums, and executive stakeholders. * Align adversarial testing activities with exposure management priorities by validating remediation efforts, identifying exploitable attack paths, and measuring reductions in organizational exposure. ### **Adversarial Simulation \& Red Team Operations** * Lead and execute adversary emulation engagements using intelligence\-driven threat scenarios aligned with frameworks such as MITRE ATT\&CK. * Design and conduct full\-scope red team operations, including initial access, lateral movement, privilege escalation, and data exfiltration simulation. * Conduct physical, external/i oficiency with Red Team tools and Command\-and\-Control (C2\) frameworks. * Advanced networking knowledge and experience with attack simulation. * Deep understanding of the MITRE ATT\&CK framework and adversary TTPs. * Deep understanding of one or more penetration testing methodologies, such as PTES, ISECOM, ISSAF, or OSSTMM. * Demonstrated knowledge of AI security risks and adversarial testing techniques, including experience evaluating generative AI applications, model and agent integrations, data exposure, prompt\-based attacks, excessive agency, and other emerging AI threat scenarios. ### **Technical \& Platform Knowledge** * Strong scripting and programming skills in PowerShell, Python, JavaScript, Bash, Golang, or similar languages. * Deep understanding of Windows, Linux, Kali Linux, and macOS operating systems. * Direct experience with one or more cloud platforms: + Microsoft Azure + AWS + Google Cloud Platform (GCP) ### **Research, Analysis \& Communication** * Strong research and reporting skills. * Ability to translate technical findings into actionable recommendations for technical and executive audiences. ### **Leadership \& Program Management** * Strong team leadership, coaching, prioritization, stakeholder management, and executive communication skills. * Experience presenting offensive security findings, program metrics, and strategic recommendations to executive leadership, governance committees, audit stakeholders, and technical teams. * Experience defining strategy, establishing standards, measuring performance, and driving continuous improvement of offensive security capabilities. * Ability and willingness to travel for on\-site assessments. **Preferred Qualifications** ---------------------------- * Experience leading purple team engagements. * Experience validating security controls through adversarial simulation. * Experience supporting Continuous Threat Exposure Management (CTEM) or attack path analysis programs. * Experience assessing generative AI and agentic AI platforms. **Preferred Certifications** ---------------------------- * Offensive Security Certified Professional (OSCP) * Offensive Security Certified Expert (OSCE) * Offensive Security Experienced Penetration Tester (OSEP) * Certified Red Team Professional (CRTP) * Certified Red Team Operator (CRTO) * Certified Red Team Operator II (CRTO II) * GIAC Penetration Tester (GPEN) * GIAC Web Application Penetration Tester (GWAPT) * GIAC Exploit Researcher and Advanced Penetration Tester (GXPN) * CREST Registered Penetration Tester / CBEST Qualifications * Certified Azure Red Team Professional (CARTP) * Certified Azure Red Team Expert (CARTE) COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS This position is eligible to earn a base salary in the range of $96,000\.00 \- $181,000\.00 annually. Placement within the pay range may differ based upon various factors, including but not limited to skills, experience and geographic location. Compensation for this role also includes eligibility for incentive compensation which may include production, commission, and/or discretionary incentives. jobs.description: *At Klaviyo, we value the unique backgrounds, experiences and perspectives each Klaviyo (we call ourselves Klaviyos) brings to our workplace each and every day. We believe everyone deserves a fair shot at success and appreciate the experiences each person brings beyond the traditional job requirements. If you're a close but not exact match with the description, we hope you'll still consider applying. Want to learn more about life at Klaviyo? Visit* *klaviyo.com/careers* *to see how we empower creators to own their own destiny.* Klaviyo is growing fast and we have openings for all skill levels across all of our teams. Learn more about our engineering culture at https://klaviyo.tech We love tackling tough engineering problems and look for Engineers who specialize in certain areas but are passionate about building, owning \& scaling features end to end from scratch and breaking through any obstacle or technical challenge in their way. We push each other to move out of our comfort zone, learn new technologies and work hard to ensure each day is better than the last. Klaviyo operates a real\-time data platform built for massive scale on Amazon Web Services (AWS). Engineers come to Klaviyo with experience in a variety of languages and from a number of disciplines. **Responsibilities** -------------------- Klaviyo operates a real\-time data analytics platform written primarily in Python that is built for massive scale and hosted on Amazon Web Services (AWS). The Data Platform team builds tooling and establishes best practices and technology choices that help enable the Data Platform area to power core Klaviyo functionality and generate data\-driven insights. As an engineer on this team, you will be responsible for designing, building, and maintaining our mission critical data and analytics infrastructure. You will work with a cross functional team to write technical design documents, create system infrastructure, write high quality code, and operate large scale systems in production. You will also review other engineer's designs and code, and provide technical mentorship to other engineers on the team and in the broader engineering organization. **Team Tech Stack** ------------------- * AWS * Terraform * Python * Kubernetes * Clickhouse * DynamoDB * MySQL * Kafka * Spark * Flink * Iceberg * Airflow * DataHub **Required Skills** ------------------- * BA or BS Degree in Computer Science, related field, or equivalent experience * 7\+ years of experience in a software engineering discipline * Highly skilled in using at least one modern programming language * Experience provisioning infrastructure using Terraform or a similar infrastructure as code tool * Experience designing, building, and operating distributed systems in a cloud computing environment * Experience using Linux operating systems * Experience with OLTP and OLAP databases * Experience with high volume data processing and storage systems * Able to communicate well, both verbally and in writing * Able to work with others on a team * Able to learn continuously and adapt to a high growth environment * Able to stick with and solve difficult problems *This role may require up to 10% travel for purposes such as new hire onboarding, client or partner work if applicable, team meetings, and industry events. Travel is coordinated in advance.* **Get to Know Klaviyo** We're Klaviyo (pronounced clay\-vee\-oh). We empower creators to own their destiny by making first\-party data accessible and actionable like never before. We see limitless potential for the technology we're developing to nurture personalized experiences in ecommerce and beyond. To reach our goals, we need our own crew of remarkable creators—ambitious and collaborative teammates who stay focused on our north star: delighting our customers. If you're ready to do the best work of your career, where you'll be welcomed as your whole self from day one and supported with generous benefits, we hope you'll join us. *AI fluency at Klaviyo includes responsible use of AI (including privacy, security, bias awareness, and human\-in\-the\-loop). We provide accommodations as needed.* *By participating in Klaviyo's interview process, you acknowledge that you have read, understood, and will adhere to our* *Guidelines for using AI in the Klaviyo interview Process**. For more information about how we process your personal data, see our* *Job Applicant Privacy Notice**.* *Klaviyo is committed to a policy of equal opportunity and non\-discrimination. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, ethnicity, citizenship, national origin, color, religion or religious creed, age, sex (including pregnancy), gender identity, sexual orientation, physical or mental disability, veteran or active military status, marital status, criminal record, genetics, retaliation, sexual harassment or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.* *IMPORTANT NOTICE: Our company takes the security and privacy of job applicants very seriously. We will never ask for payment, bank details, or personal financial information as part of the application process. All our legitimate job postings can be found on our official career site. Please be cautious of job offers that come from non\-company email addresses (@klaviyo.com), instant messaging platforms, or unsolicited calls.* **By clicking "Submit Application" you consent to Klaviyo processing your Personal Data in accordance with our Job Applicant Privacy Notice. jobs.description: **Shape the Future of Mining with Komatsu Mining Technology Solutions:** At Komatsu Mining Technology Solutions, we're not just talking about progress and innovation \- we're making it happen. These are not simulations. These are not prototypes. These are production autonomous systems operating 24/7 in harsh, dynamic environments where safety, reliability, and performance matter. We are looking for a Software Architect to help shape the future of FrontRunner, the world's leading autonomous haulage platform. We are looking for someone who can define and evolve the architecture of large\-scale systems while balancing technical excellence, operational realities, and long\-term business needs. **Job architectures that support current and future business needs. * Partner with engineering leaders, product management, and domain experts to translate strategic objectives into technical direction. * technical risks before they become operational challenges. * Evaluate emerging technologies, frameworks, and design patterns to improve system capabilities and developer productivity. * Mentor **Required Qualifications** --------------------------- * Demonstrated experience architecting large\-scale distributed software systems that have been successfully deployed and operated in production architecture, distributed systems, scalability, reliability, and performance engineering. * Strong software development background, including experience with Java and modern software development jobs.title: Lead Platform Engineer
jobs.description: Founding CTO / Lead Platform Engineer **Role Type:** Full\-Time (Remote, Africa\-based preferred) **Compensation:** Equity\-first (5% equity, 4\-year vest, 1\-year cliff) **About the Role** You will own the entire backend architecture of LogWare, including the evidence pipeline, multi\-tenant security model, engine infrastructure, and integrations. Your primary responsibility is turning our Knowledge Base specifications into a production\-grade reality. **What You'll Build** * **Evidence Collection Engine:** Normalize, classify, deduplicate, and canonicalize security evidence from AWS, Okta, GitHub, Jira, and manual uploads. * **Evidence Intelligence Engine:** Validate evidence type, source, freshness, and integrity, ensuring generic logs never satisfy controls requiring specific evidence. * **Trust \& Integrity Engine:** Implement SHA\-256 hashing at collection time, chain of custody tracking, and tamper detection. * **Control Validation \& Compliance Engines:** Map evidence to NDPR, CBN, POPIA, Kenya DPA, ISO 27001, SOC 2, PCI\-DSS, NIST CSF, and GDPR, while computing real\-time framework readiness scores. * **Continuous Assurance Engine:** Build the heartbeat that re\-validates controls on schedule and emits events during status changes. * **Infrastructure:** Develop an event\-driven architecture using the LogWare Event Bus, enforce multi\-tenant database isolation, and build CI/CD pipelines with automated tenant isolation tests. **Requirements** * 3\+ years Node.js backend experience in security\-sensitive production systems (not just CRUD APIs). * Deep MongoDB expertise involving schema design, aggregation pipelines, indexing, and multi\-tenant data isolation. * Experience building event\-driven architectures where engines communicate via events. * Security\-first mindset with an understanding of cross\-tenant attacks, privilege escalation, and input injection. * Test\-driven approach including writing attack case tests alongside happy path scenarios. Work Location: Remote Work Location: Remote

jobs.description: ##### **The Security Engineer is a hands\-on technical role responsible for designing, implementing, operating, and continuously improving security controls across cloud, identity, endpoint, email, network, data, and hybrid infrastructure. coordination, root\-cause analysis, and follow\-through.** * ##### **Consistent security review of technology changes, firewall requests, cloud deployments, identity changes, and production releases.** * ##### **Automation that reduces manual effort, improves data quality, and strengthens repeatability without compromising control or auditability.** * ##### **Clear technical ownership, current documentation, defensible change records, and measurable operational health.** ##### **Security Engineering and Architecture** * ##### **Design, implement, maintain, and improve security ##### **Document investigative steps, queries, screenshots, findings, decisions, affected assets, communications, and remediation actions in the designated incident record.** * ##### **Lead or support high\-severity incidents and after\-action reviews, including lessons learned, detection improvements, procedure updates, and assigned follow\-up actions.** * ##### **Participate in an on\-call or Sentinel, Microsoft Defender XDR, CrowdStrike Falcon, Microsoft Entra ID, Microsoft Purview, Mimecast, Palo Alto Networks firewalls and Panorama, and related security technologies.** * ##### **Monitor platform health, integration status, licensing or capacity constraints, pr tation, Audit Support and Collaboration** * ##### **Create and maintain security architecture records, standards, procedures, notes, evidence packages, and status updates that can withstand operational and audit review.** * ##### **Support internal and external assessments involving PCI DSS, SOX, NIST, privacy obligations, jobs.title: Principal Engineer Data Network Planning
jobs.description: About Lightpath Lightpath is building the fiber infrastructure the digital economy depends on \- owning, operating, and expanding dense, high\-performance networks for enterprises, public institutions, carriers, and cloud innovators. Our all\-fiber network supports mission\-critical environments, from financial markets and healthcare systems to AI platforms and next\-generation cloud architectures. As we expand across the Northeast and into high\-growth markets nationwide, we invest ahead of demand \- building infrastructure with precision, resilience, and accountability. To support that growth, we’re building a team of people who take ownership, think long\-term, and take pride in tackling complex work with care and integrity. At Lightpath, every role contributes to infrastructure that powers critical systems and real\-world outcomes. We look for individuals who value precision, accountability, and collaboration and who want to help build networks, processes, and partnerships that are engineered to last. **Job Summary** The Principal Engineer Data Network Planning at Lightpath plays a critical role in shaping and executing network strategies to optimize the company's next\-generation fiber\-optic network. This role requires a blend of technical expertise, strategic vision, and leadership skills to oversee the design, architecture, and implementation of scalable and secure network solutions. Key responsibilities include developing and enforcing network policies, leading network platform decisions, and ensuring the network meets performance and reliability standards. The role also involves collaborating closely with various business units, including Sales Engineering, Product, and Operations, to design and deliver custom network solutions that exceed customer expectations. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in telecommunications, with extensive knowledge of network protocols (such as MP\-BGP, OSPF, LDP, ISIS, SR and MPLS), experience with network devices and services, and a proven track record in managing large\-scale network projects. They will also possess strong project management skills and the capability to stay ahead of industry trends and technological advancements. The Principal Engineer will be instrumental in ensuring that Lightpath’s network infrastructure is robust, scalable, and aligned with the company’s strategic objectives, all while maintaining a focus on cost\-effective solutions and continuous improvement. **Responsibilities** * Develop and execute network strategies that align with Lightpath’s business goals, focusing on expanding and optimizing our next\-generation fiber\-optic network. * Analyze and drive key decisions regarding network platforms, ensuring alignment with Lightpath’s strategic goals. * Oversee the design and architecture of network solutions, ensuring they are scalable, secure, and capable of meeting the demands of diverse customer needs. * Experience configuring, deploying, and integrating network devices and services. * Establish and enforce network policies, technical standards, and configuration protocols to maintain network integrity and security. * Collaborate with the sales and customer service teams to design and deliver custom network solutions that exceed customer expectations. * Stay abreast of the latest industry trends and emerging technologies and integrate innovative solutions into Lightpath’s network infrastructure. * Develop and manage Capital Expenditure (CapEx) budgets, ensuring cost\-effective deployment of network infrastructure. * Assess the functionality of hardware, software, and tools, ensuring they meet the network’s performance and reliability standards. * Oversee the certification process for hardware and software systems and lead the selection of new tools and technologies to support network operations. * Evaluate new products, manage RFI/RFP processes, and oversee new feature testing to ensure compatibility with existing network infrastructure. * Lead proof of concept initiatives and remediation testing to validate new technologies and resolve any issues before full\-scale deployment. * Develop and maintain relationships with equipment suppliers and industry research departments to keep up knowledge on technological roadmaps. * Responsible for the support of legacy technologies and alternative replacement when needed. * Develop and project manage programmed circuit migrations to improve the state of the core network. * Prepare Engineering Cost and Planning estimates \& Projections for Large Scale Projects and Customer Solutions. **Qualifications** * BS Degree – Engineering, Telecommunication or Computer Science or equivalent experience. Masters preferred. * 7\-10\+ Years of telecommunications experience **Technology and Hardware Knowledge** * Extensive and demonstrable knowledge of MP\-BGP, OSPF, LDP, ISIS, SR, MPLS, TCP/IP in a service provider/carrier network required. * Proficient troubleshooting L2/L3 skills required. * Adept understanding of internet routing security techniques and tools including IRR and RPKI required. * Knowledge of QoS/CoS including traffic classification, marking, policing and shaping, queuing and hardware/software buffers required. * Working knowledge and experience with Cisco ASR and NCS platforms, IOS\-XE and IOS\-XR are preferred. Knowledge of Juniper Junos and Arisa EOS is a plus. * Extensive and demonstrable knowledge of MEF Carrier Ethernet products and standards, OAM tools including Y.1731 statistics collection, Interconnection, and Wholesale Mobile Backhaul required. * Understanding of various service testing methodologies (RFC2544, Y.1564, RFC6349\), and their key use cases and differences required * Experience with field\-based work in POPs, carrier hotels, data centers, cable head ends, and telco central office environments preferred. * Understanding of active and passive xWDM transport systems, colored and tunable transceivers, DOM/DDM diagnostics, power and thermal management, and troubleshooting preferred * Network lab test equipment (Keysight, Ixia, Spirent) experience desired. * Optical circuit switch/cross\-connect (OCC/OXC) experience desired. * On\-premises DDOS mitigation technology (Radware, Corero, etc.) knowledge and experience desired * SD\-WAN (Meraki, Versa, etc.) knowledge and experience desired * Azure ExpressRoute, AWS Direct Connect, Google GCP, Oracle OCI as a service provider/carrier knowledge and experience desired. * Python, Bash, Golang, Perl, API scripting language experience desired **Systems and Software Knowledge** * Experience with Netcracker or similar Planning and Provisioning tool * Knowledge and working experience with network orchestration tools. * Knowledge of performance management tools * Strong working knowledge of Microsoft Office, Google Maps, Streets \& Trips, Visio \& various operational Support Systems for internal and external presentations and complex network schematics. * This position will also accept qualified applicants who live throughout the United States. Lightpath is an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to recruiting, hiring and promoting qualified people of all backgrounds regardless of gender, race, color, creed, national origin, religion, age, marital status, pregnancy, physical or mental disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, military or veteran status, or any other basis protected by federal, state, or local law. This information is collected for employment purposes, including identification, work authorization, FCRA\-compliant background screening, human resource administration and compliance with federal, state and local law. jobs.title: Member of Technical Staff — Network Engineer (Software)
jobs.description: **The Role** ------------ The network is where AI verification becomes real. Lucid Computing, in partnership with the Research Institutes of Sweden (RISE), is building and operating an adversarial testbed for developing and red\-teaming AI compute verification solutions. The premise of the project is that verification claims — where AI compute runs, how it is used, what model is loaded — are only as good as the adversarial attacks they can withstand. Our job is to build verification solutions that can survive such attacks. Network devices and network code form the backbone of these solutions, including designs like: * **Traffic shaping for workload classification** — bandwidth\-constrained pod uplinks, telemetry aggregation, and randomized inference routers/load balancers designed to make covert frontier training economically infeasible, without inspecting or retaining traffic contents. * **Network taps and the evidence plane** — line\-rate traffic capture and hashing, cryptographic commitment of network telemetry (rather than traffic contents), and the software that lets programmable NICs (FlexNICs) and traffic shapers constrain and observe the I/O path of GPU servers. * **Assurance and receipt infrastructure** — software that cross\-checks network telemetry against signed job manifests, evaluates policy, and emits chained, verifiable receipts. The devices you build must remain trustworthy when the adversary is the operator of the network itself — potentially a well\-resourced, nation\-state\-class actor. Requirements like "never mirror or retain full traffic," "commit only to pre\-agreed evidence," and "assume every component around you may be hostile" reshape familiar network designs in unfamiliar ways, and many of the right answers haven't been invented yet. You'll help invent them: contributing to threat models, proposing new security protocols and device designs, defending them in design reviews, and then hardening and remediating them when the red team publishes what it broke. You'll work alongside hardware/FPGA engineers (DC\-SCM, FlexNIC prototypes), security engineers, and verification researchers, and your work will directly shape open, published reference architectures intended to be reused by frontier labs, governments, and future compute agreements. **What We're Looking For (Required)** ------------------------------------- * Real\-world experience writing **production software for network devices** (e.g., switches, routers, NICs/SmartNICs, load balancers, firewalls, taps/packet brokers) **and/or network\-focused software for large\-scale network\-based applications** (e.g., VPNs, traffic management, load balancing, packet processing, or telemetry systems serving significant real\-world traffic). * **Hands\-on network security experience** — this is a hard requirement, and depth here is heavily weighted. Examples: secure device design, hardened network protocols, traffic analysis and anomaly detection, DDoS mitigation, network access control, or security\-focused code and design review of networked systems. * Strong **networking fundamentals**: L2–L4 protocols, routing and switching behavior, network topologies, load balancing, QoS/traffic shaping, and performance characteristics of real networks under load. * Strong **systems programming** skills in languages appropriate to the data plane and control plane (e.g., C, C\+\+, Rust, Go) and deep familiarity with the Linux networking stack. * A track record of building **robust, reliable software at scale** — the bigger and more demanding the networks and devices you've shipped for, the better. * **Creative, outside\-the\-box thinking.** You should be excited (not exhausted) by problems with no established playbook, comfortable reasoning about adversaries, and able to originate and defend novel protocol and device designs — then revise them honestly when the red team proves you wrong. * Ability to work effectively in a small, fast\-moving team spanning software, hardware, and security, and to communicate designs clearly in writing. **Nice\-to\-Haves (the more, the better)** ------------------------------------------ * **Experience developing network device hardware** (switch/NIC/appliance hardware, embedded network systems, or close collaboration with hardware teams on device bring\-up) — a strong plus. * **Experience physically securing network devices** — tamper\-evident/tamper\-resistant design, secure installation and cabling assurance, physical security assessments of network infrastructure — a strong plus. * Data\-plane programming: **DPDK, XDP/eBPF, P4**, or programmable switch/SmartNIC/DPU platforms. * **FPGA experience**: working with or writing software for FPGA\-based network appliances, or comfort collaborating with RTL/firmware engineers. * Applied **cryptography and attestation**: hashing/signing at line rate, hash\-chained logs, certificate/key management, TPM/TEE attestation flows. * **Offensive security or red\-team experience** with networked systems; familiarity with covert channels and side channels in networks. * Familiarity with **AI/ML infrastructure**: GPU cluster networking (InfiniBand/RoCE, NVLink\-scale fabrics), inference\-serving architectures, or the traffic patterns of training vs. inference workloads. * Experience with **telemetry and observability** systems: packet capture at line rate, flow monitoring, high\-throughput time\-series pipelines. * Contributions to **open\-source networking projects or open standards** (IETF, OCP, etc.). * Interest in **AI safety, security, and governance** — our work exists to make high\-stakes agreements about AI verifiable, and caring about that mission helps. **What You'll Get** ------------------- * Ownership of a critical layer of a first\-of\-its\-kind system: verification infrastructure installed in a production\-grade European datacenter and adversarially tested in public. * Your designs and code published as part of open reference architectures used across the AI verification field. * An elite, mission\-driven team, and direct collaboration with an independent government\-backed research institute. * Competitive compensation and benefits program. Compensation Range: $100K \- $450K
