jobs.description: ##### **About Peraton** Peraton is a next\-generation national security company that drives missions of consequence spanning the globe and extending to the farthest reaches of the galaxy. As the world’s leading mission capability integrator and transformative enterprise IT provider, we deliver trusted, highly differentiated solutions and technologies to protect our nation and allies. Peraton operates at the critical nexus between traditional and nontraditional threats across all domains: land, sea, space, air, and cyberspace. The company serves as a valued partner to essential government agencies and supports every branch of the U.S. armed forces. Each day, our employees solve the most daunting challenges that our customers face. Visit peraton.com to learn how we’re keeping people around the world safe and secure. ##### **About The Role** Peraton is seeking an experienced Information System Audit Engineer to serve as the program's primary expert on financial audit readiness, information systems audit compliance, and internal controls oversight for the BASIS program. This is a senior advisory role with a primary focus on supporting and leading DoD financial audits — including FIAR, FISCAM, ICOFR, DHA MERHCF, and OMB Circular A\-123 engagements — while also developing, implementing, and maintaining the internal processes, procedures, and compliance frameworks necessary to sustain continuous audit readiness across the DEERS application portfolio. The selected candidate will serve as the principal liaison between the program team, Government stakeholders, and external audit bodies, ensuring all financial and information systems audit activities are executed with rigor, completeness, and timeliness. This individual will own the program's Compliance Audit Support Plan, lead Corrective Action Plan (CAP) development and remediation tracking, and provide actionable advisory recommendations to senior leadership and Government customers on audit findings, business process improvements, and internal control enhancements. The position will be responsible for the following but not limited too: This position is remote. Responsibilities * Serve as the senior advisor and primary point of contact for all DoD financial audit engagements, including DHA MERHCF, DoD CIO ICOFR, FIAR (Financial Improvement and Audit Readiness), and SSAE (Statement on Standards for Attestation Engagements). * Provide comprehensive material and personnel support during anticipated external audit examinations, producing all required digital artifacts and deliverables per established audit criteria and timelines. * Respond comprehensively to Provided By Client (PBC) data calls issued by external auditors, including the OIG (Office of Inspector General), GAO (Government Accountability Office), OUSD(C) (Office of the Under Secretary of Defense, Comptroller), and other external audit bodies. * Actively demonstrate system controls to auditors to support DMDC application and systems control objectives during examination engagements. * Advise program leadership and the Government on strategies to address Notice of Findings and Recommendations (NFRs) and Notifications of Findings (NOFs); evaluate and provide recommendations for their adjudication. Continuous Audit Readiness \& Internal Controls * Proactively maintain continuous audit readiness by performing ongoing internal control (IC) assessments, business process analysis, and risk identification across the DEERS application portfolio. * Develop, execute, and maintain a comprehensive Compliance Audit Support Plan encompassing audit readiness methodology, policies, and procedural documentation in compliance with FISCAM and FFMIA requirements. * Ensure the application and compliance of Financial Management (FM) overlays to NIST SP 800\-53 Rev 5 security controls, including ICAM (Identity, Credential, and Access Management) onboarding requirements, as they relate to financial internal control objectives. * Support and provide advisory expertise for OMB Circular A\-123, FISCAM, and RMF audit activities, ensuring alignment between IT general controls and financial management objectives. * Coordinate with Product Managers and technical leads to identify system areas with potential vulnerabilities or compliance violations that may create audit exposure. Internal Process \& Procedure Development * Develop, document, and implement internal processes and procedures to ensure program\-wide compliance with all audit\-related deliverable requirements specified in the Performance Work Statement (PWS). * Establish and maintain an audit readiness methodology that standardizes how the program prepares for, executes, and follows up on audit engagements. * Develop and maintain FISCAM and FFMIA procedural documentation, ensuring alignment with current Federal standards and DoD audit requirements. * Create and enforce internal tracking mechanisms for audit deliverable deadlines, PBC data call responses, and corrective action  systems audit, financial audit readiness, or internal controls in DoD or Federal government environments. * In\-depth knowledge and hands\-on experience with FIAR, FISCAM, FFMIA, OMB Circular A\-123, and ICOFR frameworks and their application within DoD IT systems. * Experience supporting or leading external DoD financial audits involving the OIG, GAO, OUSD(C), DHA, or equivalent audit bodies. * Demonstrated experience developing and maintaining Corrective Action Plans (CAPs) and managing audit findings remediation from identification through closure. * Experience responding to PBC (Provided By Client) data calls and preparing audit artifacts and system control demonstrations for external examiners. * Ability to develop and implement internal processes, procedures, and compliance frameworks to support program\-wide audit readiness. * Working knowledge of NIST SP 800\-53 Rev 5, including Financial Management (FM) overlays, and how IT general controls map to financial management objectives. * Strong analytical, written, and oral communication skills with the ability to brief senior leadership and Government stakeholders clearly and concisely. \- Preferred Qualifications * Active Public Trust clearance. * CPA (Certified Public Accountant), CISA (Certified Information Systems Auditor), CGFM (Certified Government Financial Manager), or CGAP (Certified Government Auditing Professional) certification strongly preferred. * Prior experience supporting DHA MERHCF, DoD CIO ICOFR, or FIAR/SSAE audit engagements specifically. * Familiarity with DEERS, TRICARE, or other large\-scale DoD healthcare/benefits financial systems. * Experience with ICAM (Identity, Credential, and Access Management) onboarding as it relates to FM overlay compliance. * Knowledge of RMF (Risk Management Framework) and eMASS as they intersect with financial audit and internal controls requirements. * Experience working within Agile / DevSecOps program environments and embedding audit compliance considerations into iterative delivery cycles. * Familiarity with CMMC (Cybersecurity Maturity Model Certification) and its relationship to internal controls and audit readiness. * Working knowledge of ServiceNow, JIRA, and SharePoint in an audit tracking and program management context. ##### **Details** **Target Salary Range:** $104,000 \- $166,000\. Salary is determined by various factors, including but not limited to, the scope and responsibilities of the position, the individual’s experience, education, knowledge, skills, and competencies, as well as geographic location and business and contract considerations. jobs.description: #### **What is PerfectServe?** PerfectServe is a leading provider of clinical communication and physician scheduling solutions in the health IT space. PerfectServe now has 400\+ employees, 30,000\+ customers — spanning medical practices, hospitals, and health systems — and $100 million\+ in annual revenue. PerfectServe's mission is to accelerate speed to care by optimizing provider schedules and routing communications — including messages, pages, calls, and alerts — to the right place at the right time in any care setting. This is a hands\-on engineering role for someone who can translate business needs into well\-engineered, tested, and maintainable data products. development practices, including peer review, controlled environment promotion, production monitoring, and incident resolution. * Ability to work directly with non\-technical stakeholders, ask the questions needed to clarify ambiguous requirements, and validate that delivered data supports the intended business use. * Bachelor's degree in a relevant technical field or equivalent practical movement. jobs.title: INIT Office Coordinator
jobs.description: **Read this first.** After reading the full job description, if you believe you’re a fit for this position, send an email to **reachus@reachhomeloans.com** with the subject line **“InIt Ops — \[Your Name]”** telling us why. Include one recurring process you personally built or fixed at a previous job and what changed because of it. Applications that come through any other channel, or that skip the subject line, will not be read. That’s the first test. **The one\-line version** You run the entire back end of a fast\-growing coaching company: the CRM, the billing, the payroll, the community, and the events. The Head of INIT sales and coaches. You make sure everything else happens, on time, every week, without being asked. **Who we are** InIt Coaching teaches loan officers how to turn social media into real business. Our core message is simple: *you are the business.* We take LOs from zero visibility to leads, relationships, and closed deals, and we do it through a live, high\-touch program: a weekly coaching call, a members\-only community, and multi\-day masterclasses that pull in hundreds of loan officers at a time. We’re the sister company to Reach Home Loans and share an office and a team in Boca Raton. Our founder, Brandon Brotsky, is one of the most\-followed mortgage creators in the country. We are small, we move fast, and we are building the systems that let us serve hundreds of members without breaking. **This is a high\-paced environment.** Members are paying real money, events are live, and payments either clear or they don’t. If you need a slow, predictable desk job, this isn’t it. If you like owning a system and being the reason it runs, keep going. **What you’ll ownThe CRM (Go High Level)** * You are the administrator of our CRM and community platform. Contacts, tags, segments, pipelines, workflows, calendars, automations, user accounts. * New\-member onboarding: portal access, community access, segment tagging, welcome sequence * Onboarding new sales reps: users, calendars, permissions * When something in the system breaks, you’re the first person who looks, and you fix most of it yourself **Billing** * Daily Stripe payment check at 9:00 AM. A failed payment gets caught the same day, not Friday. * Subscription changes, pauses, cancellations, refunds, and the save process for members who want out * Weekly Stripe\-to\-QuickBooks reconciliation with discrepancies flagged to leadership **Payroll** * Run InIt payroll and sales commissions on schedule, reconciled against Stripe, with zero surprises * Maintain the commissions dashboard and flag anything that doesn’t tie out before money moves **The community** * You manage the coaching community as a whole: the member experience from the day they join to the day they renew * Weekly member newsletter: draft from the Core replay, finalize, confirm segments, schedule * The Core replay chain every week: download, trim, upload, post to both course shells * Member questions and support, batched into two daily ops windows * You know who’s engaged, who’s gone quiet, and who’s about to churn, and you say so before it happens **Events** * Zoom setup for the weekly Core call, masterclasses, and coaching events: links, host rights, recording, breakouts * Live masterclass logistics: registrant reminders, chat, CTA links, replay posting, community management during and after * In\-office events for InIt and Reach: planning and running them end to end * Class scheduling and internal calendar invites **Team support and projects** * Asana board and weekly project status * Weekly rep scorecard built from call transcripts for the Head of InIt’s Friday review * Roughly 10–15 hours a week is protected for improvement work: automating the manual steps between Stripe and GHL, building the onboarding Loom library, whatever’s next **How we work here** We’re direct about this because it’s what decides whether someone succeeds or struggles in this seat. * **The week is fixed.** Recurring work lives on a calendar, not a to\-do list. You walk in Monday already knowing the week. * **You plan tomorrow tonight.** The last 15 minutes of the day are for writing the next day’s plan. 9:00 AM is for reading it. * **Checklists, not memory.** Every repeatable chain is written down. You never re\-decide the steps, and you improve the checklist when it breaks. * **Two ops windows a day.** Requests, tickets, and email batch at 11:30 and 5:30\. Nothing else interrupts a work block unless it’s genuinely on fire. * **15\-minute escalation.** If a tech or vendor problem isn’t solved in 15 minutes, it goes to the vendor or the owner. It does not eat your afternoon. * **AI is part of the job.** We use Claude and other AI tools across the company for drafting, transcripts, reconciliation, and building small automations. You don’t need to be an engineer. You need to be technical enough to learn a new tool in a weekend and curious enough to want to. * **How you do anything is how you do everything.** Your calendar, your inbox, your application email. We notice. **Who you are** * 2\+ years in operations and office management, or program/community management, ideally in a coaching, education, membership, or agency business * **Very familiar with CRMs.** You’ve administered one day to day, not just used one. Go High Level is a strong plus; HubSpot, Kajabi, Skool, Keap, or similar counts. * **Technical.** You’re comfortable in Stripe, QuickBooks Online, Zoom, Asana, and spreadsheets, and you’ve connected tools together with Zapier, n8n, or native integrations. You read the help docs before you ask. * You’ve run or helped run payroll and billing and you understand that one wrong number is a real problem for a real person * You’ve run live events, virtual or in person, and stayed calm when the link was wrong and 300 people were waiting * You default to writing things down. You’ve built a checklist or SOP because you got tired of re\-deciding. * You’re the person who catches the failed payment, the broken link, the missing invite, before anyone else notices * You like being in an office with a team, and you’re in Boca Raton or ready to be **Nice to have:** mortgage or real estate exposure; experience supporting a sales team; basic video editing; hands\-on time with Claude, ChatGPT, n8n, or Zapier. **Don’t apply if** * You want to be told what to do each morning * You’ve never owned a number that had to be right * You need work to stay inside 9 to 6 on a live\-event day * You think “the system did it” is an explanation **What success looks like** * **30 days:** You run every recurring chain on your own from the checklists. Zero missed Core replays, newsletters, or payroll dates. * **60 days:** The calendar is yours. Payment issues are caught same day. The Head of InIt hasn’t touched a member\-ops, billing, or event task in a month. * **90 days:** You’ve shipped at least one improvement that gives the team hours back every week, and documented it so anyone could run it. **Details** * **Location:** Boca Raton, FL. In office, Monday through Friday. * **Hours:** 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM, with flex on live\-event days * **Type:** Full time, W\-2 * **Reports to:** Head of InIt Coaching * **Compensation:** $70,000 per year plus performance bonus * **Start:** As soon as we find the right person **How to apply** Same as the top, because it matters: email **reachus@reachhomeloans.com**, subject line **“InIt Ops — \[Your Name]”**, and tell us why you’re the fit. Include one process you built or fixed and what changed because of it. If you’ve looked at what Brandon and InIt are doing and have a thought about it, say so. We read every one ourselves. Pay: $60,000\.00 \- $70,000\.00 per year Ability to Commute: * Boca Raton, FL 33432 (Required) Work Location: In person

jobs.description: Recognized as the No. 1 site trusted by real estate professionals, Realtor.com® has been at the forefront of online real estate for over 25 years, connecting buyers, sellers, and renters with trusted insights and expert guidance to find their perfect home. Through its robust suite of tools, Realtor.com® not only makes a significant impact on the real estate industry at large, but for consumers, navigating the biggest purchase they will make in their life, by providing a user experience that is easy to use, easy to understand, and most of all, easy to make decisions. Join us on our mission to empower more people to find their way home by breaking barriers to entry, making the right connections, and building confidence through expert guidance. Who We Are Realtor.com connects tens of millions of home buyers, sellers, and renters with the listings, insights, and tools they need to make one of the biggest decisions of their lives. The Content \& Industry Services team is the engine behind that data — we ingest, process, and publish content from thousands of sources that powers every search, listing, and recommendation on the platform. About The Role Data is the vital lifeblood upon which all of our tools and experiences are built. Content is an enabler and a multiplier that allows us to personalize our products, make better decisions and manage our risks. We have an exciting and unique opportunity for a motivated and energetic Senior Software Engineer to join the Realtor.com Content team. In this position, you will help make valuable data easily accessible for everyone. You will work across the full stack developing and operating mission critical systems that integrate with thousands of data sources and process millions of records daily. jobs.title: Senior AI Product Manager, Data Platform & Ontologies | Growth & Transformation
jobs.description: **This role is not open to visa sponsorship or transfer of visa sponsorship including those on H1\-B, F\-1, OPT, STEM\-OPT, or TN visa, nor is it available to work corp\-to\-corp.** **This role requires a hybrid schedule and will be based in our South Charlotte, NC office (Tuesday through Thursday) and optional remote days on Mondays and Fridays each week.** Our Growth and Transformation team (RVGT) is looking for a **Senior AI Product Manager** to own Data Platform \& Ontologies — the data and context layer of RVGT's unified, governed agentic platform that every RV business builds production AI workflows on. RVGT is Red Ventures' client division, delivering growth and transformative solutions across customer acquisition, conversion, transactions, and relationship deepening. We partner with some of the largest brands across financial services, home services, and higher education \- helping consumers get connected with products and services that are right for them on behalf of our clients. In this role, you'll own Proteus, the ontology, retrieval, and entity\-resolution layer that determines whether an agent starts with the right business context or a blank prompt and Data Ingestion, the pipelines, connectors, and contracts that get partner and internal data into Proteus reliably and safely. You'll also own the data\-platform components of Red Platform, RV's data and test\-optimization platform, with scope ramping as the core surfaces stabilize. We work with some of the largest brands in the world, and they trust us with their data — partner\-data isolation, audit trails, and human\-in\-the\-loop gating are designed in from the start, not bolted on after. Above any specific line on a résumé, we're hiring for relentless curiosity and deep ownership: someone who is pulled toward the parts of the system they don't yet understand, teaches themselves what they need, and treats Data Platform \& Ontologies as theirs to make great. Curious how Growth and Transformation fits into Red Ventures? Click here. **The Impact You'll Make** * *Own the Data \& Context Layer:* Drive ontology, retrieval, and entity\-resolution quality so every agent built on our unified agentic platform starts with the right business context, with retrieval precision and recall gated in CI the way a test suite gates code. * *Architect Reliable, Governed Ingestion:* Design the pipelines, connectors, and data contracts — schema, freshness, lineage, and quality SLAs — that get partner and internal data into Proteus safely and within SOC2, PII, and GLBA constraints. You'll create the vision and system design and work with the team to implement it. * *Close the Data Flywheel:* Make agent corrections and human overrides demonstrably improve next\-run retrieval, reading the data yourself every week and turning what you see into the next set of bets. * *Extend Impact to Red Platform:* Go deep on Red Platform's data and contract surfaces and act as a systems\-thinking partner to the Red Platform EM as the two platforms converge into one. * *Mentor \& Influence:* Manage and develop junior AI Product Managers while serving as the day\-to\-day lead on a strategic, high\-visibility initiative for senior stakeholders across the organization. **What We're Looking For** * *Retrieval \& Data Product Depth:* 6\+ years as a data\-product or ML\-product PM, having shipped a retrieval, RAG, search, or knowledge\-graph product at scale, fluent in ontology design and retrieval evaluation (precision/recall, MRR, faithfulness). * *Ingestion \& Pipeline Experience:* You've owned or worked closely on data ingestion — schemas, contracts, lineage, freshness, and data quality — alongside data engineering or data science as a peer, not over it. * *Governance Literacy:* You reason fluently about HITL gating, identity propagation, audit trails, partner\-data isolation, and SOC2 controls, and treat governance as architecture rather than a checklist. * *Curiosity \& Ownership:* You ask "why" and "how" more than "what," chase down ambiguous edges yourself, and take problems all the way to resolution rather than handing them back half\-solved. * *Execution Mindset:* You'd rather prototype and measure than write a spec and hand it off. You measure everything and use the feedback loop to optimize your product offering. *Cross\-Functional Literacy: You're able to earn the trust of and coordinate amongst engineers, data scientists, data engineers, and business counterparts.* * *Bonus Points:* Background in semantic search, knowledge graphs, or vector databases; experience building a labeled\-data feedback flywheel; FinServ data\-handling experience (PII, GLBA); or a background as a software engineer, data scientist, or data engineer before moving into product. **Compensation:** Total Cash Compensation Range: $155,000\-$220,000 *This role is also eligible for Equity, which is offered separately from the total cash compensation listed above. Actual compensation varies based on location,  itionally, the following benefits are provided by Red Ventures, subject to eligibility requirements. * Health Insurance Coverage (medical, dental, and vision) * Life Insurance * Short and Long\-Term Disability Insurance * Flexible Spending Accounts * Paid Time Off * Holiday Pay * 401(k) with match * Employee Assistance Program * Paid Parental Bonding Benefit Program **Who We Are:** Founded in 2000, Red Ventures (RV) is home to a diverse portfolio of industry\-leading brands and businesses, strategic partnerships and proprietary technology – including Bankrate, Lonely Planet, The Points Guy, BestColleges and more. Together, RV helps millions of people worldwide make life's most important decisions, accelerates digital adaptation, and innovates the online consumer experience by improving every step of the consumer journey – from first discovery of information, throughout the decision\-making process, to transactions. Headquartered south of Charlotte, NC, Red Ventures employs thousands of people across the US and Puerto Rico, with international offices in the UK and Brazil. For more information, visit https://redventures.com and follow @RedVentures on social platforms. At Red Ventures, we believe diverse, inclusive teams are better. To help you better understand our core values and beliefs, we encourage you to watch this brief YouTube video: **Our Belief Statements**. This will give you insight into the principles that guide our work and our commitment to fostering an inclusive environment. We offer competitive salaries and a comprehensive benefits program for full\-time employees, including medical, dental and vision coverage, paid time off, life insurance, disability coverage, employee assistance program, 401(k) plan and a paid parental leave program. Red Ventures is an equal opportunity employer that does not discriminate against any employee or applicant because of race, creed, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, national origin, disability, age, genetic information, veteran status, marital status, pregnancy or any other basis protected by law. Employment at Red Ventures is based solely on a person's merit and qualifications. We are committed to providing equal employment opportunities to qualified individuals with disabilities. This includes providing reasonable accommodation where appropriate. Should you require a reasonable accommodation to apply or participate in the job application or interview process, please contact accommodation@redventures.com. If you are based in California, we encourage you to read this important information for California residents linked here. At Red Ventures, we believe in real human connection. That's why we do not hire someone through text, social media, or email only. As part of the hiring process, you should expect live conversations with RV teammates before any offer is made. Also, keep an eye on the sender: we only use official @redventures.com email addresses at the portfolio level or business specific email addresses (e.g., @thepointsguy.com), not ones like "redventurescareer.com." We will never ask candidates to send money, buy equipment, or share financial account info during your journey with us. You can always find our open roles on redventures.com— if you receive a message that seems suspicious, please use redventures.com to verify the opportunity. For more, the U.S. Federal Trade Commission has published helpful articles to help individuals learn more about protecting themselves from recruiter scams. If you think you've been targeted, feel free to report it to your local authorities. Stay safe out there! \#LI\-HYBRID Click here for more details regarding the employee privacy policy: https://www.redventures.com/legal/us\-emp\-privacy\-notice Questions about this Privacy Notice can be directed to employeerights@redventures.com. Alternatively, you may raise any questions or concerns to your manager, HR Business Partner, or through the Privacy Team.

jobs.title: GNC Performance Engineer II
jobs.description: At Relativity Space, we're building rockets to serve today's needs and tomorrow's breakthroughs. Our Terran R vehicle will deliver customer payloads to orbit, meeting the growing demand for launch capacity. But that's just the start. Achieving commercial success with Terran R will unlock new opportunities to advance science, exploration, and innovation, pioneering progress that reaches beyond the known. Joining Relativity means becoming part of something where autonomy, ownership, and impact exist at every level. Here, you're not just executing tasks; you're solving problems that haven't been solved before, helping develop a rocket, a factory, and a business from the ground up. Whether you're in propulsion, manufacturing, software, avionics, or a corporate function, you'll collaborate across teams, shape decisions, and see your work come to life in record time. Relativity is a place where creativity and technical rigor go hand in hand, and your voice will help define the stories we're writing together. Now is a unique moment in time where it's early enough to leave your mark on the product, the process, and the culture, but far enough along that Terran R is tangible and picking up momentum. The most meaningful work of your career is waiting. Join us. **About the Team:** The Integrated Performance team owns the holistic view of how Terran R comes together, ensuring that every system on the vehicle and ground is capable of achieving our ambitious objectives. The team works across the full launch system, from trajectory design and aerodynamics to reliability analysis and beyond, with direct influence on all parts of the product lifecycle, from conceptual design to post\-flight data review. Beyond analysis, team members engage hands\-on with hardware and operations, with the mission and authority to drive meaningful programmatic change. With a unique organizational structure, the integrated performance team spans multiple technical domains and embeds directly with partner teams to solve the hardest multi\-disciplinary problems. The team operates with a rare scale: large enough to support complex development, yet small enough that individual contributors have meaningful impact. **About the Role:** * Closely collaborate with key design teams to integrate the latest design data into full simulations of customer missions * Develop and leverage software tooling to optimize launch and orbital trajectories across key customer missions * Lead interdisciplinary design trade analyses to inform critical decisions about the vehicle, mission trajectories, and ConOps * Define and maintain high\-level vehicle and trajectory design requirements to inform the overall design process * Implement, maintain, and improve software tooling across a variety of languages, from core simulation capabilities to peripheral analysis utilities * Establish and lead cross\-functional collaboration with key teams across Vehicle Engineering **About You:** * An undergraduate or graduate degree (BS/MS/PhD) in Engineering, Computer Science, Physics, or a related field * 1\+ years of relevant full\-time work experience with demonstrated ability to solve complex problems from first principles * Direct experience on rocketry, space systems, or equally complex hardware systems * Strong proficiency in high\-level programming languages (e.g. Python, Julia, MATLAB) and setting up complex simulation processes * Ability to complete projects with end\-to\-end ownership and a high degree of independence * Comfortable working in a fast\-paced and intense startup environment **Nice to haves but not required:** * Familiarity with launch vehicle trajectory design and optimization * Have previously been a leading contributor on complex multi\-disciplinary engineering analysis projects * Prior work in a startup environment * Experience working with advanced software development practices such as Docker, Continuous Integration/Continuous Deployment (CI/CD), and dependency management **We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.** ***If you need a reasonable accommodation, please contact us at*** ***accommodations@relativityspace.com******.*** ***Please note: Relativity Space does not accept unsolicited resumes, candidate profiles, or referrals from recruitment agencies or search firms. Any unsolicited submission \- via email, our website, social media, or directly to an employee \- will be deemed the property of Relativity Space, and no fee will be owed absent a current, fully executed agreement with Talent Acquisition that specifically authorizes submissions for the applicable role.***

jobs.title: Imaging Service Engineer
jobs.description: **Why Renovo?** Renovo Solutions is a nationwide healthcare technology management company that is private equity backed by Water Street Healthcare Partners. We offer a range of opportunities for technicians to grow within the company. With a presence in 40\+ states, we provide comprehensive solutions for managing \& maintaining healthcare technologies. We prioritize investing in our employees' development, offering various phases and advancement paths. Through ongoing training, mentorship programs, and a supportive work environment, we foster professional growth and promote from within. Join our team to make a difference in healthcare while advancing your career with Renovo. **Summary** This position is responsible for performing planned maintenance, inspections, calibrations, troubleshooting, repairs, and installations on a wide range of clinical biomedical equipment and diagnostic imaging systems. The role ensures mechanical, electrical, and radiation safety, functionality, and compliance with manufacturer specifications, hospital standards, and regulatory requirements. The technician supports clinical staff in a hospital environment and demonstrates familiarity with both general patient care devices and advanced imaging modalities. **What you will do**: **Equipment Service \& Maintenance** * Troubleshoot, repair, and perform calibrations on general biomedical equipment (e.g., infusion pumps, patient monitors, defibrillators, respiratory equipment, beds, EKG machines, anesthesia machines, operating room equipment) and diagnostic imaging systems various imaging modalities (e.g., X\-ray, CT, MRI, ultrasound, fluoroscopy) at the block circuit and component levels * Conduct general troubleshooting independently and under supervision, including installations, incoming inspections, performance assurance, and planned maintenance in accordance with manufacturer and service management guidelines * Interpret signal flow using blueprints, schematics, wiring diagrams, and diagnostic software; utilize strong system\-level troubleshooting skills * Demonstrate understanding of clinical applications, image quality standards, and underlying principles of medical imaging equipment as well as general patient care devices * Manage OEM\-mandated updates, upgrades, and field modifications; accurately document all work in RENOVO’s CMMS (RenovoLive) * Properly use test equipment and tools including multimeters, dosimeters, oscilloscopes, service software/keys, invasive \& non\-invasive imaging test devices, phantoms, AC line analyzers, hand/power tools * Assist with or perform major repairs on complex equipment in collaboration with senior technicians **Compliance, Documentation \& Safety** * Ensure full compliance with regulatory bodies (TJC, DNV, CAP, DOH) and internal Medical Equipment Management Plans (MEMP) * Follow all OSHA and facility safety guidelines related to bloodborne pathogens, airborne pathogens, radiation, sharp instruments/tools, hazardous liquids/materials, and device operation * Adhere to ISO/IEC 27001 and ISO 13485 QMS policies, procedures, and documentation standards * Complete safety training assignments on time and maintain a safe working environment for self and others **Customer Support \& Communication** * Develop and maintain strong working relationships with clinical leadership, facility staff, and teammates * Provide clear, timely updates on equipment status, service action plans, progress, and timelines * Demonstrate a “customer\-first” mentality by actively listening to feedback, prioritizing requests, and enhancing customer satisfaction * Communicate equipment status and service information professionally in both verbal and written forms **Additional Responsibilities** * Support inventory control through audits, asset tracking, and updates to performance assurance schedules * Participate in special projects, upgrades, shift scheduling, and reasonable travel as required * Perform after\-hours and emergency service calls (including weekends) when needed * Carry out other duties as assigned by Supervisor **Qualifications** * Associate’s degree in Biomedical Engineering Technology, Electronics Technology, or equivalent preferred; equivalent military or field experience considered * Minimum 3 years of hands\-on experience servicing and maintaining medical equipment in a hospital or clinical setting (experience with both general biomedical and imaging equipment strongly preferred) * Successful completion of Basic Level I and Level II Imaging Equipment Service Training through an accredited Independent Training Organization, OEM, or equivalent military program preferred * Proficient with electromechanical devices, computerized biomedical systems, diagnostic imaging equipment, error code interpretation, and service software * Strong troubleshooting, problem\-solving, organizational, and priority\-setting skills * Excellent written and verbal communication skills **Required Competencies** * Accountability – Takes ownership of assigned work and follows through to completion * Communication – Clearly expresses thoughts and ideas verbally and in writing; provides timely information * Financial Acumen – Considers financial impact of decisions * Integrity – Admits mistakes, is direct and truthful * Customer Service – Demonstrates a “customer\-first” mentality; meets customer needs and captures feedback for improvement * Priority Setting – Prioritizes schedules and workload effectively * Team Building – Mentors newer technicians, facilitates team communication, shows care and respect for colleagues * Regulatory – Understands accrediting agencies (TJC, DNV, CAP, DOH) and Medical Equipment Management Plan compliance **Safety \& Physical Requirements** * Must have sensory ability to distinguish hot/cold temperatures, surfaces, colors; fine motor skills and manual dexterity * Ability to routinely carry or lift up to 50 pounds * Hospital/clinical environment; must abide by host site safety rules **Travel Requirements** Travel may be required (reasonable amounts); after\-hours and weekend availability for emergency calls as needed. **Classification:** FLSA: Non\-exempt **\*\*Note:** This position description does not list every activity, duty, and responsibility of the position and may be altered by RENOVO at any time. **EEO Statement** RENOVO Solutions provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, or genetics. jobs.title: Go-to-Market Engineer
jobs.description: **\*\*This role requires 4\-days a week in office at the Denver location** **Say hello to opportunities.** If you’re looking to be part of what’s next in communication, you’re in the right place. At RingCentral, we believe the best customer experiences happen when humans and AI work together. Our agentic voice AI portfolio—AIR, AVA, and ACE—brings together automation, assistance, and insights across the entire conversation lifecycle. The result? More seamless, intelligent experiences for businesses everywhere. With $2\.5B\+ in ARR and $250M invested in R\&D annually, we’re building the future of AI\-powered business communications. **This is where you and your skills come in. We’re currently looking for:** a Go\-to\-Market Engineer to own the optimization and automation of our outbound pipeline generation engine and inbound lead optimization. This role sits at the intersection of sales, marketing, and operations—responsible for building the technical infrastructure, tooling, and processes that drive sustainable increases in outbound pipeline. As the technical architect for our outbound motion, you will build automated workflows, orchestrate data flows, and align sales strategy with scalable technical systems. Centralizing optimization across 55 XDRs, you will maximize tech stack ROI (Pocus, Clay, n8n, SEPs), accelerate pipeline growth, and bridge cross\-functional silos to drive sustainable company growth. In your first 90 days, you will audit the GTM stack, ship 2\-3 sales plays, align marketing cover with account scoring, and set baseline reporting. Over your first year, you will increase meeting set rates (from 1\.48% to 2%\+), generate $10M\+ in incremental pipeline, reduce rep workload, and advance our modern GTM execution. **Job Responsibilities:** **Outbound Pipe Generation (50%)** ---------------------------------- * **Campaign Execution:** Ship and evaluate 20\+ high\-intent outbound campaigns per quarter. * **Tech Stack \& Automation:** Manage and optimize GTM tools (Pocus/Apollo, Clay, n8n, Claude, SEP); build automated account engagement, routing, and play workflows. * **Integrations \& Scoring:** Implement low\-code cross\-system integrations and build custom account scoring models based on intent, firmographics, and engagement. * **Experimentation:** Continuously test and iterate on outbound plays to improve conversion rates. **Inbound Funnel Orchestration (30%)** -------------------------------------- * **Inbound Lifecycle \& Routing:** Automate capture, scoring, and SLA routing of inbound leads (form, chat, visitor intent) to reps or AI agents. * **Marketing Alignment:** Align campaign timing/targeting with scoring models to convert air\-cover spend into qualified pipeline. * **Tracking \& Reporting:** Monitor speed\-to\-lead cadences, build stage\-by\-stage conversion reporting (MQL to SQL to opp), and resolve handoff stalls. * **Feedback Loops:** Connect inbound conversion data with outbound play design for bi\-directional optimization. **Reporting \& Business Impact (20%)** -------------------------------------- * **Analytics \& Dashboards:** Build reporting infrastructure to track performance metrics (conversion, pipeline contribution, efficiency) and show incremental value. * **Experiments \& Insights:** Run tooling/process experiments and provide data\-driven recommendations to leadership on resource allocation. **To succeed in this role you must have experience in:** * **Experience \& Track Record:** 3\-5\+ years in B2B SaaS GTM systems/RevOps/SalesOps; proven success building outbound pipeline engines that impact revenue. * **GTM Tooling:** Proficiency in Clay, Claude Code, n8n (or similar workflow platforms), and Apollo (or similar SEP/data layers). * **Technical \& CRM Chops:** Strong proficiency with APIs, webhooks, low\-code/data transformation, lead scoring, account segmentation, MCP servers for AI workflows, and Salesforce/CRM architecture. * **Evaluation \& Financial Modeling:** Ability to rapidly evaluate GTM tools and model basic financials (ROI, pipeline forecasting). * **Preferred Background:** Scaling outbound from $10M to $100M\+ ARR; background in data science, analytics, or engineering; exposure to Snowflake, BigQuery, Census/Hightouch, and AI prompt engineering. **What we offer:** * Comprehensive medical, dental, vision, disability, life insurance * Health Savings Account (HSA), Flexible Spending Account (FSAs) and Commuter benefits * 401K match and ESPP * Paid time off and paid sick leave * Paid parental and pregnancy leave * Family\-forming benefits (IVF, Preservation, Adoption etc.) * Emergency backup care (Child/Adult/Pets) * Employee Assistance Program (EAP) with counseling sessions available 24/7 * Free legal services that provide legal advice, document creation and estate planning * Employee bonus referral program * Debt refinancing assistance * Employee perks and discounts program RingCentral’s work culture is the backbone of our success. And don’t just take our word for it: we are recognized as a Best Place to Work by BuiltIn, the Top Work Culture by Comparably and hold local BPTW awards in every major location. Bottom line: We are committed to hiring and retaining great people because we know you power our success. **About RingCentral** RingCentral is a global leader in agentic voice AI–powered business communications, delivering an integrated platform for business phone, SMS, contact center, workforce engagement management, video collaboration, and messaging. As the communications layer connecting businesses and customers, RingCentral is the front door of business communication and is in the advantageous position to apply AI at every phase of the conversation journey — before, during, and after each interaction. Our agentic AI portfolio includes autonomous voice\-first AI agents that automate calls, assist in the moment, and analyze every interaction – enabling businesses to work smarter, respond faster, and connect more meaningfully with their customers. Visit ringcentral.com to learn more. RingCentral is an equal opportunity employer that truly values diversity. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for individuals with disabilities during our application and interview process. If you require such accommodations, please click on the following link to learn more about how we can assist you. If you are hired in Colorado or California, the compensation range for this position is between $145,000 and $225,000 for full\-time employees, in addition to eligibility for variable pay, equity, and benefits. Benefits may include, but are not limited to, health and wellness, 401k, ESPP, vacation, parental leave, and more! The salary may vary depending on your location, skills, and experience. This role has an application deadline of November 30th. Please apply prior to the deadline to be considered for the role. \#LI\-JW1

jobs.title: Engineering Manager, Digital Assets
jobs.description: At Ripple, we're building a world where value moves like information does today. It's big, it's bold, and we're already doing it. Through our crypto solutions for financial institutions, businesses, governments and developers, we are improving the global financial system and creating greater economic fairness and opportunity for more people, in more places around the world. And we get to do the best work of our career and grow our skills surrounded by colleagues who have our backs. If you're ready to see your impact and unlock incredible career growth opportunities, join us, and build real world value. **The Opportunity** ------------------- This solution does not yet exist. Corporate treasury teams must choose between old treasury platforms that fail to support digital assets and crypto\-native tools that lack fundamental enterprise treasury elements. You will head the engineering effort to remove this choice by incorporating Ripple's digital asset abilities into the Ripple Treasury platform in close partnership with Ripple's core digital assets team. This is a greenfield role. You will join forces with a seasoned infrastructure engineer and a product lead, forming a team of up to four full\-stack developers. The direction may change day\-to\-day as the team finds what works best. There is no guidebook and no comparable market solution. You will determine how digital assets fit into corporate treasury workflows — and through this, help establish a new category of enterprise software. **What You'll Do** ------------------ * Manage the engineering process for digital asset integration by building and designing systems that join Ripple's digital asset functions (XRP, RLUSD, tokenized assets, custody, cross\-border settlement) with Ripple Treasury's enterprise platform. * Build and manage a group of up to four full\-stack .NET developers, recruiting, mentoring, and developing engineers while staying actively involved in coding. * Ship working software daily — lead a fast\-paced Kanban workflow where the team builds, presents, iterates, and adapts direction based on findings and collaborator feedback. * Work closely with Ripple's core digital assets team to grasp protocol capabilities, integration points, and roadmap alignment. * Design full\-stack solutions spanning .NET backend services and Angular or React frontends, ensuring enterprise\-grade reliability, security, and auditability. * Navigate ambiguity with confidence — make sound engineering decisions with incomplete information, course\-correct quickly, and keep the team productive through rapid pivots. * Partner with product, compliance, and treasury domain experts to translate emerging requirements into shippable features that meet the needs of Fortune 500 CFOs and treasurers. * Define engineering practices for the team — establish coding standards, review processes, testing strategies, and deployment patterns appropriate for a fast\-moving, pioneering effort. **What You Bring** ------------------ * 7\+ years of software engineering experience with a strong full\-stack background in .NET and modern frontend frameworks (Angular, React, or equivalent) * Over 2 years of experience in leading engineering teams, encompassing recruitment, mentoring, and development of engineering groups * Demonstrated ability to ship software in fast\-paced, ambiguous environments — you have built products where requirements were unclear or changing rapidly * Production background in fintech, digital assets, or blockchain — you have delivered systems managing actual financial transactions or digital asset activities * Comfort with pioneering work — you thrive when the playbook hasn't been written yet and find energy in defining new approaches * Strong communication and collaboration skills — ability to work closely with cross\-functional partners including product managers, compliance teams, and external engineering teams * Hands\-on leadership orientation — willingness and ability to write production code alongside your team, especially in the early stages of team building **Nice to Have** ---------------- * Deep familiarity with blockchain protocols, digital asset custody, tokenization, or cross\-border settlement systems * Experience with XRP Ledger, RLUSD, or Ripple's product ecosystem * Background in corporate treasury, treasury management systems, or enterprise financial software * Experience integrating traditional financial infrastructure with digital asset platforms * Familiarity with regulatory requirements for digital asset products in financial services **WHO WE ARE:** Do Your Best Work * The opportunity to build in a fast\-paced start\-up environment with experienced industry leaders * A learning environment where you can dive deep into the latest technologies and make an impact. A professional development budget to support other modes of learning. * Thrive in an environment where no matter what race, ethnicity, gender, origin, or culture they identify with, every employee is a respected, valued, and empowered part of the team. * In\-office collaboration for moments that matter is important to our culture, and we give managers and teams the flexibility to decide which 10\+ days a month they come in. * Bi\-weekly all\-company meeting \- business updates and ask me anything style discussion with our Leadership Team * We come together for moments that matter which include team offsites, team bonding activities, happy hours and more! Take Control of Your Finances * Competitive salary, bonuses, and equity * Competitive benefits that cover physical and mental healthcare, retirement, family forming, and family support * Employee giving match * Mobile phone stipend Take Care of Yourself * R\&R days so you can rest and recharge * Generous wellness reimbursement and weekly onsite \& virtual programming * Generous vacation policy \- work with your manager to take time off when you need it * Industry\-leading parental leave policies. Family planning benefits. * Catered lunches, fully\-stocked kitchens with premium snacks/beverages, and plenty of fun events *Benefits listed above are for full\-time employees.* *Ripple is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We're committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. We do not discriminate against qualified employees or applicants because of race, color, religion, gender identity, sex, sexual identity, pregnancy, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, marital status, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, military status, or any other characteristic protected by local law or ordinance.* *Please find our* *UK/EU Applicant Privacy Notice* *and our* *California Applicant Privacy Notice* *for reference.*

jobs.title: Mid-Market Sales Manager, AI & Data Cloud
jobs.description: **About Rippling** ------------------ Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system. Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third\-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds. Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1\.4B\+ from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes. We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses. **About the role** ------------------ As our Founding Data Cloud \& Rippling Solutions Sales Manager, you will lead and develop a team of MM Account Executives for a fast\-paced, high\-growth company. Your leadership will have a direct impact on the growth of the Data Cloud sales team, the training and development of your team, and you’ll be an integral part of Rippling’s growth. This position reports to our Senior Director of IT Sales. **What you will do** -------------------- * Manage, coach and scale a team of Account Executives * Assist your team throughout their strategic sales cycles by deeply understanding customers needs and mapping them to the value of Rippling Data Cloud \& Rippling Solutions * Monitor sales performance: activity, pipelines, monthly forecasts, and closed\-deals to ensure quota attainment * Regularly report on team and individual results through pipeline management and forecasting * Identify and make recommendations for improvement in the areas of process, efficiency and productivity * Lead team to achieve and exceed monthly targets * Participate in hiring and interviewing process, as well as training and ramp\-up of new team members **What you will need** ---------------------- * An experienced sales manager with 3\-5 years manager experience in tech sales * A top performer with a consistent track record of exceeding targets as an individual contributor * Ability to collaborate extensively with Solutions Engineers (SEs), Professional Services, or Forward Deployed Engineers to bridge the gap between "vision" and "execution". * Able to accurately forecast team performance * Motivated with a desire to learn and have a strong work ethic * Ability to thrive in a fast paced environment **Additional Information** -------------------------- Rippling is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce and do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, sexual orientation, veteran or military status, or any other legally protected characteristics, Rippling is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities who need assistance during the hiring process. To request a reasonable accommodation, please email accomodations@rippling.com Rippling highly values having employees working in\-office to foster a collaborative work environment and company culture. For office\-based employees (employees who live within a 40 mile radius of a Rippling office), Rippling considers working in the office, at least three days a week under current policy, to be an essential function of the employee's role. The On\-Target Earnings\* US\-based employees will be 50/50 commission split for base/variable pay for the range listed below. jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Motion Planning, Autonomy
jobs.description: We are seeking Senior Software Engineers to play a pivotal role in the development of our Large Driving Model (LDM). In this role, you will take ownership of the data pipelines and curation strategies that fuel our models. You will be responsible for building miners that surface high\-value examples, refining evaluation benchmarks, and collaborating directly with modeling teams to accelerate performance. If you are a strong individual contributor with a deep background in Python, a passion for autonomous systems, and the ability to navigate complex data challenges independently, we want to hear from you. * Develop and maintain scalable data mining pipelines to extract rare and critical driving scenarios from massive fleet datasets. * Lead the curation and analysis of large\-scale training sets to improve the robustness and generalization of the LDM. * Design and implement rigorous evaluation frameworks to measure model performance against real\-world baselines. * Provide technical guidance and code reviews for junior and mid\-level engineers, ensuring high standards for code quality and system design. * Partner closely with modeling engineers to define data requirements and iterate on rapid experimental loops. * Identify trends, anomalies, and data distribution shifts that impact model training and validation. * Contribute to the design of data infrastructure, making informed decisions on tradeoffs between data quality, scale, and compute efficiency. * Transition experimental data strategies * B.S. or M.S. in Computer Science, Data Science, Robotics, Engineering, or a related field. * 3\+ years of experience as a Software Engineer, Data Analytics Engineer, Machine Learning Engineer, or Motion Planning Engineer. * Advanced proficiency in Python and SQL is required, with a proven track record of building production\-grade data products. * Hands\-on experience with distributed data processing frameworks (e.g., Spark, Ray) and cloud infrastructure. * Solid understanding of data\-centric AI, dataset curation strategies, and model evaluation methodologies. * Experience handling large\-scale sensor data or complex robotics telemetry. * Demonstrated ability to work autonomously, taking projects from a vague concept to a verified, high performing product. * Strong ability to communicate technical trade\-offs and collaborate effectively within a fast\-paced team environment.

This role builds on the existing scope of owning testing for new features, test infrastructure, internal tooling, CI/CD, and automation across Consumer Applications, while adding senior\-level expectations for technical leadership, strategy, and domain ownership. As a senior member of the team, you will define test strategy, lead and mentor junior engineers, and act as a force multiplier across the organization. and end\-to\-end test coverage across mobile, cloud, infotainment, vehicle access systems, and related services. * Lead technical decisions for test architecture, test selection, parallelization, infrastructure. **Team leadership and multiplier impact** * Lead junior team members through technical guidance, mentoring, reviews, and day\-to\-day collaboration. * Raise the effectiveness of the broader team by standardizing best practices, improving tooling, removing blockers, and sharing expertise broadly. * Be a multiplier for the organization by improving systems and processes in ways infrastructure and pipelines. * Analyze test results and pipeline behavior to identify bottlenecks, flaky areas, coverage gaps, and high\-value automation investments. * Continuously improve the reliability and stability of test assets supporting both manual and automated testing across teams. **Qualifications** ================== * Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field. * 5\+ years in software test engineering, including automation, test infrastructure, and CI/CD systems. * Proven ability to develop and execute test strategies across We are building a trusted enterprise data and AI platform that brings together critical information across People, Finance, Privacy, and Legal. Our goal is to move beyond fragmented reports and dashboards toward a unified experience where leaders can explore certified data, understand the context behind key metrics, and ask complex business questions using natural language. The team owns the data foundations, semantic models, AI capabilities, and analytical experiences that make this possible. **About the Role** ------------------ We are looking for a Staff Data Engineer to provide technical leadership for our enterprise data and AI platform. You will design and build trusted data products, establish architecture and engineering standards, and solve complex problems spanning ingestion, transformation, semantic modeling, governance, and AI\-powered analytics. You will remain hands\-on while setting the technical direction for initiatives that cross multiple business domains and systems. This role requires more than building pipelines. You write clean, idiomatic TypeScript, you have experience building LLM\-powered features in production, and you know the difference between accepting model output and directing it toward high\-quality results. **What You'll Do** ------------------ ### **Hands\-On Engineering** * Design and build features across our AI platform: agent tool systems, prompt pipelines, integration APIs, patterns, evaluation frameworks, and observability for LLM\-powered systems * Integrate ML model outputs via API layers, collaborating with Data Scientists to understand model requirements and design clean integration boundaries * Contribute to the design of the Stord Agent Platform: agent orchestration, skill registries, and human\-in\-the\-loop patterns ### **Technical Growth \& Influence** * Contribute to architectural decisions through design docs, code reviews, and technical discussions — forming well\-reasoned opinions and defending them constructively * Provide mentorship and guidance to junior and mid\-level engineers on the team * Identify technical risks, propose improvements, and advocate for quality — don't wait to be assigned a ticket * Create leverage through clear code, well\-documented decisions, and reusable patterns that make others faster * Use AI coding tools effectively, maintaining a strong independent technical POV and producing high\-quality results rather than accepting raw model output uncritically ### **Cross\-Functional Collaboration** * Collaborate closely with Product Management and Design on feature development, providing technical perspective on feasibility and trade\-offs * Support other product engineering teams in adopting AI capabilities within their domains * Participate in sprint planning, design reviews, and cross\-team syncs **What significant portions of a TypeScript codebase. This is the primary language of the AI platform. * **AI/LLM Application Development** — You have built and shipped LLM\-powered or agentic features in production.
