jobs.description: **Job Description** **Software Engineer, Public Records and Derived Authorities** Are you ready to shape the future of AI\-driven content technology while leading cutting\-edge innovation in a mission\-critical role? Do you thrive in environments where your technical expertise can directly impact how the world's leading professionals' access and utilize information? We are seeking a talented Software Engineer to join our Public Records Publishing and Derived Authorities team. As a Software Engineer, Public Records and Derived Authorities, you will: * Play a role in development of cutting\-edge data platform. * Develop across the entire publishing stack, from content ingestion and storage through to efficient delivery to downstream systems. * You will collaborate with stakeholders, product leadership, and cross\-functional teams to design, build, and scale enterprise\-grade data systems that transform how our organization delivers value to customers. * You will work closely with Product Management, Technology, and our Labs teams to enable our customers to build successful features and products to take their business to the next level. * You will be developing and implementing solutions using Java, Python, Snowflake, AWS cloud infrastructure, and modern data engineering practices. **Key Responsibilities** * Develop large‑scale, cloud‑native data pipelines and publishing systems—processing billions of records using Snowflake, Python, and AWS services. * Participate in technical innovation, evaluating emerging data engineering techniques, leading proofs of concept, and shaping long‑term data platform roadmaps. * Ensure data quality, observability, and operational excellence through testing frameworks, performance optimization, monitoring, and governance for security/compliance. * Collaboration with cross\-functional teams including with Product, Engineering, and Labs teams to translate data capabilities into application features and market‑ready content workflows. **Required Qualifications** **The Ideal Candidate Profile:** We're seeking an engineer with strong hands\-on development skills who has worked with large datasets and modern data platforms. You should be comfortable writing Python code, developing stored procedures, optimizing data pipelines, and designing scalable data architectures. Strong software engineering fundamentals, data modeling expertise, and production data platform experience are essential. You are a fit for the position if your background includes: * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science/Engineering * Proven hands‑on engineering background with expertise in Python, data pipelines, and production\-grade ETL/ELT systems. * Demonstrated experience delivering production‑grade software through the full Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC), including requirements definition, design, implementation, testing, deployment, and ongoing maintenance. * Proficiency with AI\-assisted development tools, including Cursor and/or Claude, is required * Capabilities in SQL, data modeling, distributed data processing, data quality frameworks, and cloud cost/performance optimization. * Solid software engineering fundamentals including API development, testing, design patterns, Git workflows; bonus for Docker/Kubernetes/Terraform. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience with data publishing workflows and content delivery systems * Domain expertise in legal, tax, accounting, or other regulated industries, particularly with investigative platforms or systems that search and analyze large\-scale public and proprietary records * Experience with infrastructure as code (Terraform, CloudFormation) \#LI\-SB1 **What’s in it For You?** * **Hybrid Work Model:** We’ve adopted a flexible hybrid working environment for our office\-based roles while delivering a seamless experience that is digitally and physically connected. * **Flexibility \& Work\-Life Balance:** Flex My Way is a set of supportive workplace policies designed to help manage personal and professional responsibilities, whether caring for family, giving back to the community, or finding time to refresh and reset. This builds upon our flexible work arrangements, including work from anywhere for up to 8 weeks per year, empowering employees to achieve a better work\-life balance. * **Career Development and Growth:** By fostering a culture of continuous learning and skill development, we prepare our talent to tackle tomorrow’s challenges and deliver real\-world solutions. Our Grow My Way programming and skills\-first approach ensures you have the tools and knowledge to grow, lead, and thrive in an AI\-enabled future. * **Industry Competitive Benefits:** We offer comprehensive benefit plans to include flexible vacation, two company\-wide Mental Health Days off, access to the Headspace app, retirement savings, tuition reimbursement, employee incentive programs, and resources for mental, physical, and financial wellbeing. * **Culture:** Globally recognized, award\  two company mental health days off), parental leave, sabbatical leave. Finally, Thomson Reuters offers the following additional benefits: optional hospital, accident and sickness insurance paid 100% by the employee; optional life and AD\&D insurance paid 100% by the employee; Flexible Spending and Health Savings Accounts; fitness reimbursement; access to Employee Assistance Program; Group Legal Identity Theft Protection benefit paid 100% by employee; access to 529 Plan; commuter benefits; Adoption \& Surrogacy Assistance; Tuition Reimbursement; and access to Employee Stock Purchase Plan. jobs.title: FRONT END DEVELOPER
jobs.description: **COMPANY OVERVIEW** ThreatLocker® is a leader in endpoint protection technologies, providing enterprise\-level cybersecurity tools to improve the security of servers and endpoints. The ThreatLocker® platform with Application Allowlisting, Ringfencing™, Storage Control, Elevation Control, Endpoint Network Control, Configuration Management, and Operational Alert solutions are leading the cybersecurity market toward a more secure approach of blocking the exploits of application vulnerabilities. **POSITION OVERVIEW** We’re looking for an experienced Front\-End Web Developer with deep, hands\-on expertise in Webflow to own and maintain a high\-traffic, enterprise\-grade website. This role is ideal for someone who understands that great websites balance performance, SEO, usability, and reliability—and knows how to execute all four in Webflow. You’ll be responsible for day\-to\-day site management, performance optimization, UX improvements, and technical SEO, with occasional after\-hours or weekend support for urgent website issues. **The role will be based in Orlando, FL and is an in\-office position.** **JOB SCOPE** * Own and maintain a large\-scale Webflow CMS site used by a global audience * Build, update, and optimize pages using Webflow Designer, CMS Collections, and Components * Manage and optimize Webflow CMS architecture (Collections, fields, references, conditional visibility) * Ensure fast, reliable performance through page load optimization, asset management, and clean structure * Implement and maintain technical SEO best practices, including: + Page speed optimization (Core Web Vitals) + Image optimization and lazy loading + Clean URL structures and redirects + Schema markup (via custom code) + Meta tags, Open Graph, and sitemap management * Maintain Webflow interactions and animations with performance in mind * Work with custom code embeds (HTML, CSS, JavaScript, HubSpot) to extend Webflow functionality * Manage Webflow hosting, publishing, backups, and staging environments * Monitor site health, uptime, and performance; quickly troubleshoot and resolve issues * Collaborate with marketing, design, and content teams to improve UX and conversion paths * Ensure accessibility, consistency, and usability across devices and browsers * Provide occasional after\-hours or weekend support for critical site issues, launches, or outages **REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS** * 3\+ years managing a production Webflow website for a mid\-size to large organization * Proven experience maintaining high\-traffic, enterprise\-level Webflow sites * Strong understanding of Webflow CMS, Editor, and Designer workflows * Hands\-on experience with: + Custom code embeds + Responsive design in Webflow + CMS\-driven templates and dynamic content + Webflow hosting and publishing processes * Deep knowledge of technical SEO and website performance optimization * Strong UX instincts—able to balance design, usability, and speed * Solid understanding of HTML, CSS, and JavaScript (even when working inside Webflow) * Experience debugging layout, performance, or publishing issues under time pressure **PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS** * Experience with enterprise marketing sites (security, SaaS, B2B preferred) * Familiarity with: + Google Lighthouse, PageSpeed Insights, Search Console + Analytics tools (GA4, Hotjar, etc.) + Webflow localization or multi\-language setups * Experience collaborating with designers using Figma or similar tools *What success looks like* * Pages load fast and score well on Core Web Vitals * SEO foundations are strong, consistent, and scalable * The site is stable, secure, and easy for teams to update * No (surprise) issues with page layout from one type of device to another * UX improvements translate into measurable engagement and conversion gains * Website issues are resolved quickly—even outside normal business hours **WORKING CONDITIONS** The duties described below are representative of those encountered while performing the essential functions of this position. If necessary, reasonable accommodation may be requested and will be evaluated for its relationship to the essential functions that must be performed. * Job will generally be performed in an office environment but may require travel to visit company offices and/or property locations. * While performing duties of this job, would occasionally require to stand, walk, sit, reach with hands and arms, climb or balance, stoop or kneel, talk and hear, and use fingers and hands to feel objects and tools. * Must occasionally lift and/or move up to 25 pounds. * Specific vision abilities required include close vision, distance vision, depth perceptions, and the ability to adjust focus. ***A background check and drug/substance screening are required after a conditional offer. Employment will proceed only upon receiving clear results from both.*** ***ThreatLocker also conducts randomized drug and substance testing approximately every 60 days, in line with the same screening standards.***

experience within database and project management systems a plus: i.e.: NetSuite, Jira or similar. * Excellent written and oral communication skills * Process\-oriented and strong collaborator with ability to communicate and manage well at all levels of the organization and across various departments * Strong organizational and time management skills; ability to multitask and prioritize * Highly adaptable with strong problem\-solving and critical thinking skills; ability to exercise good judgment and make sound data\-backed decisions * High level of integrity and dependability with a strong sense of urgency and results\-orientation * Views customer care as high priority; To successfully perform the essential functions of this job, team member must be able to: * Work and commute in all weather conditions * Able to effectively communicate, listen, detect, converse with, discern, convey, express oneself and exchange information * Able to walk, bend, twist, turn, stoop, climb steps, reach with hands, use hands to fingers * Work in a fast\-paced environment where they will often multitask * Move about inside the office to access standard office equipment * Constantly operate a computer and other office productivity machinery such as keyboard, copy machine and printer * Remain in a stationary position 50%\+ of the time, alternating between sitting and standing * Ability to move and lift up to 30 pounds * Drive between company locations and/or vendors or suppliers as needed while on job **Overview of Tommy’s Family of Companies:** Tommy's Express is an international franchise for outstanding car washes and car care services. jobs.description: Topgolf is looking for a Senior Unity Developer to join our Games team and help lead the next generation of interactive experiences played by millions of Guests across our venues. This role sits at the intersection of game development, real\-world sports, connected venues, and large\-scale entertainment technology. You will lead the design and architecture of Unity\-based games and experiences that run in Topgolf bays, using ball\-tracking data, venue systems, real\-time scoring, and engaging game mechanics to create fun, social, competitive gameplay. You will lead a small group of engineer’s day to day, partner closely with game designers, artists, UX/UI designers, QA, product owners, and platform engineers, and act as the primary technical voice for the Games team, from roadmap through national rollout. **Responsibilities** -------------------- * Architect, develop, and optimize Unity games and interactive experiences for Topgolf venues, making key technical decisions for the systems you own. * Design gameplay systems, UI, animation, scoring, camera behavior, effects, and game\-state logic that other engineers can build on. * Lead integration of Unity games with internal Topgolf services, APIs, tracking systems, configuration tools, and venue hardware. * Partner with designers and product owners to translate ambiguous game concepts into playable prototypes and production\-ready experiences, shaping technical feasibility early. * Collaborate with artists and technical artists on asset pipelines, shaders, VFX, animations, and performance\-conscious visuals, and set technical standards for quality. * Drive down defect rates by improving testability, diagnosing hard\-to\-reproduce issues, and coaching others on debugging complex venue and platform issues. * Write clean, maintainable, well\-structured C\# code and set the bar in code reviews. * Own and improve build, deployment, and development workflows across the Games team. * Drive performance optimization strategy for venue hardware and ensure games run reliably in a live entertainment environment at scale. * Lead technical planning, estimation, and sprint ceremonies; help break down ambiguous initiatives into shippable work. * Mentor mid\-level and junior engineers, and help maintain existing game titles while driving architecture for new product initiatives. **Required Skills and Experience** ---------------------------------- * 6\+ years of professional experience developing games or interactive applications in Unity, including experience owning systems and technical direction end to end. * Strong, demonstrated C\# programming skills and a track record of shipping production\-quality code. * Deep experience building gameplay systems, UI flows, game\-state machines, and real\-time interactive features. * Strong understanding of Unity performance optimization, profiling, memory management, and build configuration, including diagnosing subtle performance regressions at scale. * Experience leading or informally leading engineers: assigning work, reviewing code, and being accountable for a team's technical output. * Proven ability to set technical direction and make architecture decisions that other engineers build on. * Extensive experience with version control systems such as Git, including branching strategy and release management for a team. * Excellent communication skills and the ability to represent technical tradeoffs to designers, artists, QA, product, and leadership stakeholders. * A practical, delivery\-focused mindset with strong ownership of quality, stability, and maintainability across the codebase. **Preferred Qualifications** ---------------------------- * Experience shipping commercial games, location\-based entertainment, arcade games, sports games, or multiplayer/social games at scale. * Experience architecting integrations between Unity applications and REST APIs, backend services, or external hardware systems. * Experience with Linux\-based Unity builds in production. * Experience designing or owning automated build pipelines, CI/CD, or build tooling for a team. * Deep familiarity with game telemetry, analytics, live\-ops, or configuration\-driven content. * Experience with physics\-driven gameplay, ball tracking, projectile systems, or sports simulation. * Experience supporting and operating games in production environments, including incident response and on\-call leadership. * Advanced knowledge of Unity addressables, asset bundles, localization, input systems, or custom editor tooling. * Prior experience as a lead, tech lead, or staff\-level engineer on a games or interactive entertainment team. **What Success Looks Like** --------------------------- * Your team ships reliable, polished Unity features and systems that are fun for Guests and easy to maintain and extend. * You lead collaboration with design, art, QA, and product to move games from ambiguous concept to confident release. * You raise technical quality across the portfolio by setting standards and multiplying your impact through mentorship and delegation. * You understand that Topgolf games run in real venues, so stability, clarity, and operational reliability matter as much as gameplay, and you hold the team to that discipline. * You bring clarity to ambiguous problems, make sound technical calls under pressure, and help the team ship better games faster. BENEFITS Free Play \& 1/2 price food! Health, dental, vision, 401(k) team member match, free mental well\-being platform – and that’s just for starters for those who qualify. jobs.title: Mechanical Engineer I/II
jobs.description: ### **About Torus** Torus is headquartered in Utah and is expanding manufacturing at our 545,000\-square\-foot facility in Salt Lake City called GigaOne. **We are** **the world’s first mesh energy infrastructure, uniting communities through resilient, sustainable, and intelligent power.** We design, engineer, manufacture, install, and support our systems end\-to\-end, standing behind them throughout their lifecycle. Torus systems help reduce costs, lower emissions, and protect facilities from outages, while strengthening the security and reliability of the broader utility grid. Torus is committed to American manufacturing, engineering excellence, and building energy systems that last. Torus has raised over $267 million from investors like Magnetar, Mercado, ICONIQ and Origin Ventures. The investments are helping to accelerate deployment of modular power plants across utilities, data centers, and industrial sectors. This investor confidence reflects the strength of our team, technology as well as the scale of the problem we are solving. At Torus, you will be part of something larger than a single product or technology. Your work will help build energy infrastructure that supports and strengthens our electrical grid, critical systems, industry, and communities for decades to come. We value accountability, collaboration, and clear thinking. We are looking for people who want to solve hard problems and build things that matter. #### **About the Role** At Torus, we're building the world's first mesh energy infrastructure — systems that protect communities, reduce costs, and strengthen the grid for decades to come. Nova Pulse, our Battery Energy Storage System, is at the heart of that mission. As a **Mechanical Engineer**, you'll design, validate, and bring to life the sub\-systems that make resilient energy storage possible. This role sits at a critical handoff, where great engineering becomes great manufacturing. And your work will directly shape how quickly and reliably we scale. May require occasional onsite work at our South Salt Lake HQ Warehouse and/or Springville R\&D Warehouse (air\-conditioned and non air\-conditioned). **Schedule** Full\-Time, Salaried **Compensation** $80,000\-120,000 (Note: We have the flexibility to hire at different levels, which may impact the corresponding pay range.) **Work Authorization** Applicants must already have the legal authorization to work in the US without requiring any employer sponsorship. **Physical Requirements** * Must have the ability to safely lift and move objects weighing up to 50 lbs. * Must be capable of standing, bending, and executing repetitive tasks for prolonged periods of time. * Ability to read, identify, observe and recognize details, color\-coding and fine print at close range on associated engineering drawings. * Ability to don personal protective equipment to include, but not limited to, respiratory protective equipment with proper seal, coveralls, ear protection, gloves, eye protection \& safety helmet. * Ability to observe, detect and respond to audible and visual machine malfunction warnings. * Ability to communicate information so others can understand. Must be able to exchange accurate information in these situations. * Must report to work reliably and with the ability to use full and unimpaired skills and judgment to safely execute your job. * Proficiency in reading, writing, and speaking English required. ### **Our Perks \& Benefits** Benefits eligibility is based on employment status. Financial * Employee Rewards Package including equity * 401(k) Retirement Savings Plan * Torus paid life and AD\&D Insurance with options to purchase additional coverage * Voluntary short\- and long\-term disability insurance Health \& Wellness * Health Benefits Package: Choice between traditional PPO or HSA\-eligible medical plans with Torus covering 50% of medical premiums; Dental insurance; and Vision insurance * Plan participants have access to telehealth services, mental health support and coaching, and exclusive discounts on brands, dining, entertainment, and more. Time Off * Unlimited discretionary PTO * 10 paid company holidays * Waiting period\-free 100% paid parental leave Culture \& Community * Regular company\-wide offsites to showcase our progress and learnings. A time to step back, think strategically, and work on the business together. * Team members receive Torus branded gear * Peer Recognition Program * Fully stocked break rooms with free snacks and drinks. Because great work deserves great fuel. Torus is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. jobs.title: Lead Software Engineer
jobs.description: Toshiba Global Commerce Solutions is seeking a hands\-on Lead Software Engineer to drive end\-to\-end solution delivery for major retail platforms. In this role, you will own hands\-on implementation (feature development, technical design, code reviews), engagement leadership (client\-facing technical lead, trade\-off decisions, mentoring), and operational ownership (delivery sign\-off, post\-release support) of high\-impact solutions, translating business requirements into working software you help build. You will drive Dual\-Track Agile processes, contributing to the Discovery Track through rapid prototyping and feasibility validation, and leading the Delivery Track to ensure quality, traceability, and measurable outcomes. The ideal candidate is a senior software engineer who codes daily, prototypes proactively, and integrates AI/agent workflows across the software lifecycle—from analysis and design to testing, documentation, and code generation—while bringing the technical leadership to drive client engagements forward. You will mentor teams, make critical technical trade\-offs, and take full accountability for delivery sign\-off and post\-release support. This role requires strong retail platform domain knowledge (POS systems, store operations), cloud\-native development experience, and fluency with generative and agentic AI tools to accelerate delivery while preserving code quality and architectural integrity. You will be a key driver of engineering excellence, ensuring solutions are both innovative and operationally robust. **Key Responsibilities** * Instrument and leverage AI/agentic workflows in your daily development to accelerate design, prototyping, code generation, test\-case creation, specification drafting, and automated validation across the software lifecycle. * Apply AI\-assisted development practices in your own work, model best practices for the team, and ensure ethical compliance and responsible integration of generative AI tools. * Own end\-to\-end solution delivery across Discovery and Delivery Tracks, personally building validated prototypes, contributing to formal designs, decomposing work into deliverables, and shipping accepted technical implementations. * Drive the Discovery Track under Dual\-Track Agile by writing working prototypes and demoing solutions to validate feasibility and align stakeholders before full implementation. * Translate discovery outcomes into delivery backlog items and partner with implementation teams to ensure design intent, code quality standards, and non\-functional requirements are preserved throughout delivery. * Contribute to technical design across products and integrations: produce ADRs, interface contracts, data models, sequencing diagrams, migration/rollback plans, and traceability matrices, partnering with architects on broader governance. * Serve as the primary technical lead in client engagements: facilitate workshops, present technical solutions, make trade\-off decisions, drive approvals, and act as a subject\-matter expert for assigned platform areas. * Personally implement critical components and complex features in modern retail platform stacks, set the bar for code quality through your own work, and review and approve deliverables from implementation teams. * Apply and reinforce engineering standards, reusable integration patterns, and non\-functional requirements (security, scalability, observability) across client solutions. * Mentor and upskill engineers on AI\-assisted development, Dual\-Track workflows, specification\-driven design, and platform best practices, primarily through pair programming, code reviews, and example\-driven leadership. * Contribute to platform and product strategy, identifying reusable assets, API\-first designs, and technical gaps requiring investment. * Own risk analysis and mitigation for technical decisions, including backward compatibility, data integrity, and compliance constraints. **Must\-Have Qualifications** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent experience. * Applying and utilizing AI\-assisted tools and workflows (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code) for design, coding, test generation, and documentation. * 8\+ years of professional software development experience with current, daily hands\-on coding and prototyping in modern technology stacks. * 5\+ years building cloud\-native, microservices, or event\-driven systems, with experience in Azure or equivalent cloud platforms. * Strong proficiency in technology stacks such as Java/Spring Boot, TypeScript, React/Vue. * Proven experience owning end\-to\-end solution delivery, including design, implementation, and post\-release operational accountability for medium\-to\-large projects. * Track record of building production code, prototypes, and reference implementations to validate solution feasibility. * Strong experience with REST/OpenAPI, messaging platforms, and relational/non\-relational databases (SQL/NoSQL). * Han  and engineering teams. * Proven leadership in mentoring engineers, conducting thorough code reviews, and championing engineering best practices across teams. **Preferred Qualifications** * Strong retail platform domain knowledge (POS systems, store operations) is highly desirable. * Certifications such as Azure Developer Associate, Azure Solutions Architect, or equivalent cloud credentials. * Strong understanding of advanced security best practices and compliance requirements in enterprise systems. * Experience leading Dual\-Track Agile processes, managing both Discovery and Delivery Tracks, and translating discovery outcomes into actionable backlog items. * Experience contributing to platform strategy, reusable assets, and API\-first designs. * Expertise in formal or machine\-readable specifications (OpenAPI, UML\+OCL, TLA\+, or equivalent) to guide implementation and enable automated validation. About Toshiba Global Commerce Solutions Toshiba Global Commerce Solutions is a dynamic billion\-dollar global company based in Research Triangle Park, NC, providing retail store solutions to your favorite brands. Have you ever been in a hurry and made use of the self\-checkout at Lowe's Foods, earned fuel rewards at Kroger, or just paid for purchases at retailers such as Walmart, Michaels, Carrefour, The Gap, Calvin Klein, Boots, Cencosud, BJ's, or Costco? These are just a few examples of our in\-store solutions and impressive customer base that made us the world's installed market share leader. The nature of retail is changing quickly, so if you share our 'Together Commerce' vision of a seamless two\-way, participatory shopping experience, let's get together to drive the new economy. Toshiba Global Commerce Solutions, Inc. offers a competitive salary and generous benefits package including the following: * Bonus: Eligible for up to 8% performance\-based bonus (individual and company performance) * Group health coverage (medical, dental, \& vision) * Employee Assistance Programs * Pre\-tax spending accounts * 401(k) plan (with company match) * Company provided life insurance * Pet Insurance * Employee discounts * Generous paid holiday schedule, paid vacation \& sick/personal days Compensation: * Base Salary Range: $140,000\-$165,000 * The above annual salary range is a general guideline. Multiple factors are taken into consideration to arrive at the final annual salary to be offered to the selected candidate. Factors include, but are not limited to, the scope and responsibilities of the role, the selected candidate's work experience, education and training, the work location as well as market and business considerations. + Discretionary Bonus Plan: Eligible for up to 8% annual performance\-based bonus (individual and company performance) EEO: Toshiba Global Commerce Solutions is an equal opportunity/affirmative action employer that evaluates qualified applicants without regard to age, ancestry, color, religious creed, disability, marital status, medical condition, genetic information, military or veteran status, national origin, race, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression and sexual orientation or any other protected factor. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. Individuals who need a reasonable accommodation because of a disability for any part of the employment process should email benefits@toshibagcs.com to request an accommodation DIVERSITY, EQUITY \& INCLUSION: We at Toshiba Global Commerce Solutions firmly believe that our people are an integral part to the success of our customers. Furthermore, we're committed to Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion for all our people as highlighted by our 5 Core Principles (Create Outreach, Foster Belonging, Unleash Opportunity, Diverse Cultural Engagement and Culture of Transparency). We're passionate about our customers the retail industry and becoming a more responsible company as we help create a brighter future.

jobs.title: Software Engineer Intern (Summer 2027)
jobs.description: Tower Research Capital is a leading quantitative trading firm founded in 1998\. Tower has built its business on a high\-performance platform and independent trading teams. We have a 25\+ year track record of innovation and a reputation for discovering unique market opportunities. Tower is home to some of the world's best systematic trading and engineering talent. We empower portfolio managers to build their teams and strategies independently while providing the economies of scale that come from a large, global organization. Engineers thrive at Tower while developing electronic trading infrastructure at a world class level. Our engineers solve challenging problems in the realms of low\-latency programming, FPGA technology, hardware acceleration and machine learning. Our ongoing investment in top engineering talent and technology ensures our platform remains unmatched in terms of functionality, scalability and performance. At Tower, every employee plays a role in our success. Our Business Support teams are essential to building and maintaining the platform that powers everything we do — combining market access, data, compute, and research infrastructure with risk management, compliance, and a full suite of business services. Our Business Support teams enable our trading and engineering teams to perform at their best. At Tower, employees will find a stimulating, results\-oriented environment where highly intelligent and motivated colleagues inspire each other to reach their greatest potential. Responsibilities: * Optimizing systems by using network and systems programming, as well as other advanced techniques to minimize latency * Designing, building, and leveraging systems to collect, analyze, and visualize large amounts of data * Building data pipelines to capture reference and market data and developing systems that provide fast and easy access to them * Building trading systems for algo trading * Enhancing the efficiency of trading operations by developing (AI assisted) automation solutions and products Qualifications: * Bachelor's, Master's, or PhD student * Majoring in computer science or related fields * Deep knowledge of programming concepts and object\-oriented programming * Knowledge of development languages (including C\+\+, Golang, Java, JavaScript, Python, or Rust) * Knowledge of SQL and relational databases * Working knowledge of Linux * Strong problem\-solving abilities and communication skills * Interest in financial markets Anticipated weekly base salary range $3,500\-$4,200\. Benefits: Tower's headquarters are in the historic Equitable Building, right in the heart of NYC's Financial District and our impact is global, with over a dozen offices around the world. At Tower, we believe work should be both challenging and enjoyable. That is why we foster a culture where smart, driven people thrive – without the egos. Our open concept workplace, casual dress code, and well\-stocked kitchens reflect the value we place on a friendly, collaborative environment where everyone is respected, and great ideas win. Our benefits include: * Competitive compensation package * Housing accommodation * Free breakfast, lunch, and snacks daily * Exciting networking and social events (e.g. Broadway shows, escape rooms, cooking classes) * Opportunities to learn from senior management across the firm * Mentors from your alma mater and other top institutions At Tower, you'll find a collaborative and welcoming culture, a diverse team and a workplace that values both performance and enjoyment. No unnecessary hierarchy. No ego. Just great people doing great work – together. Tower Research Capital is an equal opportunity employer.

jobs.title: Systems Enrichment Leader
jobs.description: Be a part of our mission! As a world leader in creating comfortable, sustainable, and efficient climate solutions for buildings, homes and transportation, it's our responsibility to put the planet first. For us at Trane Technologies, and through our businesses including Trane® and Thermo King, sustainability is not just how we do business—it is our business. Do you dare to look at the world's challenges and see impactful possibilities? Do you want to contribute to making a better future? If the answer is yes, we invite you to consider joining us in boldly challenging what's possible for a sustainable world. Learn about our benefits designed for you to Thrive at work and at home. We boldly go. **Where is the work:** On\-Site (5 days) Job Summary Trane is hiring a Systems Enrichment Lead. We are seeking a motivated engineer with experience in process automation, manufacturing systems, and digital tools to support and improve operations in a fast\-paced manufacturing environment. This role will help bridge operational technology (OT) and information technology (IT) by developing, supporting, and optimizing automation solutions across manufacturing and business systems. The ideal candidate will have experience with platforms such as Ignition, SharePoint/Power Platform, and MES tools such as Apriso, with exposure to data analytics, Python, SQL, or AI\-enabled solutions considered a plus. Responsibilities * Liaison with Apriso developers to implement changes and or Upgrades to shop floor systems. * Support the development and implementation of digital and automation solutions for manufacturing operations. * Design, maintain, and improve automation workflows that increase efficiency, quality, and reliability. * Assist with integration between shop\-floor systems, MES platforms, business applications, and reporting tools. * Implement and support MES solutions, including work order management, traceability, quality tracking, and production data collection. * Build and support solutions using tools such as Ignition, SharePoint/Power Platform, SQL, Python, REST APIs, and related technologies. * Work with operations, engineering, IT, and other cross\-functional teams to identify automation opportunities and deliver practical solutions. * Troubleshoot automation and system issues, perform root\-cause analysis, and implement corrective actions. * Help maintain system security, user access, documentation, and backup/recovery processes. * Create and maintain technical documentation, standard operating procedures, and user training materials. * Train operators and team members on implemented systems and process improvements. * Support continuous improvement efforts through data analysis, reporting, and process optimization. * Stay informed on emerging digital and automation technologies, including AI\-enabled tools, and evaluate opportunities for future use. Qualifications * Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Systems, Industrial Technology, or a related technical field preferred. Will consider experience in lieu of a degree. * 3\+ years of Manufacturing Engineer experience * Relevant experience in manufacturing automation, controls, MES, industrial systems, or related areas may be considered in place of a degree, where appropriate. * Experience with one or more of the following is preferred: Ignition, Apriso, SharePoint, Power Platform, SQL, Python, or other automation/reporting tools. * Familiarity with industrial communication protocols such as OPC UA, MQTT, or Modbus is a plus. * Understanding of networking fundamentals such as IP addressing, subnetting, and port management is preferred. * Exposure to data analytics, scripting, or AI/ML concepts is a plus, but not required. * Relevant AI certifications, along with proven knowledge and practical application of AI capabilities, are strongly preferred. Key Competencies * Demonstrates a strong commitment to safety. * Strong problem\-solving and analytical skills. * Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines. * Effective written and verbal communication skills. * Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a team environment. * Willingness to learn new tools, systems, and technologies. * Customer\-focused and results\-driven mindset. **Annual Base Salary Range or Hourly Base Pay Range:** $83,600\.00 \- $151,479\.99 **Compensation Type:** Salary **Incentive Eligible:** No **Sales Commission Eligible:** No **Disclaimer:** We strive to provide competitive compensation for this position, tailored to a variety of factors. The actual compensation will depend on elements such as seniority, merit, geographic location, education, experience, travel requirements, and union designation. Our compensation range is generally based on the national average for the country. Additionally, benefits may vary depending on the region, business alignment, union involvement, and employee status. **Thrive at work and at home:** * Benefits kick in on DAY ONE for you and your family, including health insurance and holistic wellness programs that include generous incentives – WE DARE TO CARE! * Family building benefits include fertility coverage and adoption/surrogacy assistance. * Paid time off includes up to 15 vacation days, paid holidays, sick leave, and additional options to support volunteer and parental leave. * 401K match up, educational and training opportunities through company programs along with tuition assistance and student debt support. **Disclaimer:** Benefit offerings may vary by site as well as Collective Bargaining Agreements and local/state regulations **Safety Sensitive Role:** YesThe company designates certain roles as Safety Sensitive. Safety Sensitive roles may require that you pass additional drug screening. We offer competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits and programs. We are an equal opportunity employer; all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, pregnancy, age, marital status, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any legally protected status.

jobs.title: Identity and Access Management Operations Engineer
jobs.description: **Who Are We?** Taking care of our customers, our communities and each other. That’s the Travelers Promise. By honoring this commitment, we have maintained our reputation as one of the best property casualty insurers in the industry for over 170 years. Join us to discover a culture that is rooted in innovation and thrives on collaboration. Imagine loving what you do and where you do it. **Compensation Overview** The annual base salary range provided for this position is a nationwide market range and represents a broad range of salaries for this role across the country. The actual salary for this position will be determined by a number of factors, including the scope, complexity and location of the role; the skills, education, training, credentials and experience of the candidate; and other conditions of employment. As part of our comprehensive compensation and benefits program, employees are also eligible for performance\-based cash incentive awards. **Salary Range** $126,500\.00 \- $208,700\.00**Target Openings** 1**What Is the Opportunity?** Identity and Access Management (IAM) team within Travelers Cybersecurity organization is seeking IAM Operations Engineer to join the IAM Operations support team. Responsible for reviewing servers and applications performance metrics to identify bottlenecks, address issues and enhance efficiency. Works across organization with diverse engineering teams and lines of business to quickly troubleshoot, identify and resolve business impacting incidents. Remains organized, focused and cool\-headed while working under immense pressure. Participates in 24/7 critical applications support occasionally working after hours and weekends to implement changes or troubleshoot and resolve issues. Possesses great communication skills (written and oral) handling sometimes difficult conversations with customers. Ability to multi\-task in an environment of changing priorities This position requires a technical, self\-driven, self\-learning, people\-oriented individual that will thrive under quickly changing challenging situations.**What Will You Do?** Under general supervision, demonstrates a general understanding of the activities performed related to Identity and Access Management support. Plans at an operational level designing and developing technology solutions interfacing with appropriate customers, management, and technical resources. Facilities and/or participates in the design, development, and implementation of technology solutions supporting one or more business and/or technology area. Ability to multi\-task in an environment of changing priorities. This job does not manage others. * Provide production support to various Web Access Management services supported by IAM, including, SiteMinder, Access Gateway, Okta, Profile Abstraction data provisioning, SSO certificates renewal. * Provide production support for Identity Management services supported by IAM including Sailpoint IIQ, SailPoint nightly batch processes checkout, MFA. * Setup and support Autosys batch jobs. * Coordinate with different teams to close open issues by doing continuous follow ups. * Provide support for all Identity \& Access Management services by setting up changes, resolving incidents, investigating problem and complete service requests. * Coordinate and communicate LOB impacting changes at cross LOB meetings. * Implement changes during application change windows adhering to ECRM guidelines. **What Will Our Ideal Candidate Have?** * Working experience of Identity \& Access Management skills like Okta SSO and SailPoint ISC * Working experience of jobs.title: Sr. Staff Software Engineer- Eng
jobs.description: Job description Company and benefits Job ID SRSTA020040 Employment Type Regular Work Style on\-site Location Sunrise,FL,United States Role Sr. Staff Software Engineer\- Eng Why UKG: At UKG, the work you do matters. The code you ship, the decisions you make, and the care you show a customer all add up to real impact. Today, tens of millions of workers start and end their days with our workforce operating platform. Helping people get paid, grow in their careers, and shape the future of their industries. That’s what we do. We never stop learning. We never stop challenging the norm. We push for better, and we celebrate the wins along the way. Here, you’ll get flexibility that’s real, benefits you can count on, and a team that succeeds together. Because at UKG, your work matters—and so do you. About the Role We are seeking a Sr. Staff Software Engineer to set the technical direction for agentic AI at UKG and scale it across the organization. You will define how UKG builds agents on Google’s Agent Development Kit (ADK) and other enterprise agentic platforms, own the reference architecture that consuming teams build on, and turn ambiguous business problems into technical charters that multiple teams execute against. You will operate ahead of the current roadmap, make platform bets and defend them to senior engineering and product leadership, and raise the ceiling of what the organization is capable of building. As a Sr. Staff Software Engineer, you will be responsible for the design, development, testing, deployment, and maintenance of highly complex agentic systems. Duties and Responsibilities Technical Strategy and Direction: Own the technical strategy and vision for agentic AI across the Agentic Acceleration Group and its consuming value streams, ensuring alignment with business goals and industry best practices. Set the 12–24 month direction for how UKG builds agents: platform selection, orchestration standards, and evaluation methodology. Make build\-vs\-buy and platform\-bet calls, and defend them to senior engineering and product leadership. Drive multi\-team initiatives where no roadmap exists yet. Frame ambiguous business problems into agentic technical charters, partition them across teams, and keep independently\-owned workstreams converging. Operate with no guidance on scope, escalating only on org\-level tradeoffs. Communicate complex agent architectures to non\-technical stakeholders, anticipate potential objections, and influence others to adopt a point of view. Play a pivotal role in the R.I.D.E. (Recommend, Inform, Decide, Execute) framework. Architectural Excellence: Own the reference architecture for agentic systems at UKG: multi\-agent coordination patterns, task delegation workflows, agent communication protocols, and the shared tool and MCP layers reused across teams. Set the patterns other teams build on, not just the ones your team uses, ensuring high standards of performance, scalability, and reliability. Partner with architects on mid\-level and high\-level design, and on enterprise alignment across value streams. Agent Development and Platform Integration: Design, build, and deploy production\-grade AI agents using Google ADK and other agentic platforms (LangGraph, N8N, Temporal, etc.). Write clean, maintainable, and efficient code for agent workflows, tool integrations, and multi\-agent orchestration. Stay hands\-on with code, remaining credible in design reviews and able to unblock the hardest problems yourself. Build agents that integrate with enterprise systems through tools, APIs, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers. Design and implement custom tools, skills, and plugins that extend agent capabilities across UKG’s HCM platform, built for reuse by other teams rather than for a single use case. Operational Excellence and Cost Ownership: Ensure the health and quality of agent\-powered services, proactively identifying and addressing issues. Utilize service health indicators, agent performance metrics (task success rates, latency, cost), and telemetry for action. Conduct thorough root cause analysis for agent failures and implement measures to prevent future recurrences. Oversee agent deployment, monitoring, and lifecycle management. Establish best practices for agent versioning, cost monitoring, performance optimization, and iterative improvement. Build observability into agent workflows including execution tracing, decision logging, and failure analysis. Own the economics of agentic systems. Set token and inference budgets, define model\-tier routing policy, and measure agent ROI against the manual workflows they replace. Make the case for spend to engineering leadership and finance. Agent Safety and Governance: Define the organization’s guardrail standards for autonomous action on customer payroll and HR data: permission boundaries, human\-in\-the\-loop thresholds, audit trails, and blast\-radius limits. Partner with Security, Legal, and Privacy to make those standards enforceab re and design patterns, including the ability to design and implement scalable, reliable agentic systems in a DevOps model. Proven track record of leading and delivering large\-scale, complex software projects including agentic AI initiatives. Strong understanding of cloud technologies and DevOps principles, including GCP (Vertex AI, Google ADK), Azure (Azure OpenAI), or AWS (Bedrock), and version control systems like GitHub. Excellent problem\-solving skills and attention to detail, with a commitment to delivering high\-quality agent\-powered solutions. Excellent communication and leadership skills, with a demonstrated ability to influence and drive agentic AI technical decisions across the organization and translate agent capabilities to non\-technical stakeholders. Preferred Qualifications Master’s degree or PhD in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field. Demonstrated ability to define evaluation and safety standards that other teams adopted. Experience owning inference cost and model\-selection strategy at scale. Proficiency in building telemetry and observability for agentic systems (execution tracing, decision logging, cost monitoring, success rate tracking). Experience building or contributing to MCP servers and reusable tool layers consumed by other teams. Understanding of RAG patterns, context engineering, and agentic workflow design. Experience shaping vendor or platform partner roadmaps through early\-access or design\-partner programs. Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and automation tools. Knowledge of agile development methodologies. Experience in a complex, matrixed organization. Demonstrated commitment to diversity and inclusion initiatives. Familiarity with developing accessible technologies. Company Overview: UKG is the Workforce Operating Platform that puts workforce understanding to work. With the world's largest collection of workforce insights, and people\-first AI, our ability to reveal unseen ways to build trust, amplify productivity, and empower talent, is unmatched. It's this expertise that equips our customers with the intelligence to solve any challenge in any industry — because great organizations know their workforce is their competitive edge. Learn more at ukg.com. Equal Opportunity Employer UKG is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, color, disability, religion, sex, age, national origin, veteran status, genetic information, and other legally protected categories. View The EEO Know Your Rights poster UKG participates in E\-Verify. It is unlawful in Massachusetts to require or administer a lie detector test as a condition of employment or continued employment. An employer who violates this law shall be subject to criminal penalties and civil liability. Disability Accommodation in the Application and Interview Process For individuals with disabilities that need additional assistance at any point in the application and interview process, please email UKGCareers@ukg.com. The pay range for this position is $145,600 to $209,300\. The actual base pay offered may vary depending on skills, experience, job\-related knowledge and work location. In addition to base pay, employees may be eligible to participate in a performance\-based bonus plan and to receive restricted stock unit awards as part of total compensation. Learn more about UKG’s benefits and rewards at https://www.ukg.com/about\-us/careers/benefits NOTICE ON HIRING SCAMS UKG will never ask you for a copy of your driver’s license, social security card, or passport during a job inter ABOUT OUR JOB DESCRIPTIONS All job descriptions are written to accurately reflect the open job and include general work responsibilities. They do not present a comprehensive, detailed inventory of all duties, responsibilities, and qualifications required for the job. Management reserves the right to revise the job or require that other or different tasks be performed if or when circumstances change.

jobs.title: Product Manager (Salesforce)
jobs.description: **About the role:** Unison is looking for a Product Manager to own the operations technology platform that runs our lending, servicing, and customer experience business. This role owns the Salesforce ecosystem including core CRM, workflow automation, the integration layer that connects Salesforce to our origination, servicing, and data systems, Marketing Cloud, and the emerging layer of AI agents. The ideal candidate is technical enough to read an API spec, debug an integration payload, reason about the Salesforce data model, and analytical enough to look across a queue of competing requests and identify the highest priority opportunities. Lead the effort to ensure the grounding data, guardrails, human\-in\-the\-loop checkpoints, evaluation criteria, and success metrics are well\-defined. * Partner with business stakeholders across Operations, Underwriting, Fulfillment, Servicing, Customer Service, Marketing, and Compliance to understand needs, refine requirements, and prioritize competing demands under tight timelines. * Translate business requirements into well\-defined user stories with clear acceptance criteria, and run agile delivery with Salesforce developers, admins, and platform engineering. * Establish the right metrics, instrument them, and iterate on the basis of what they show. * Identify new technology opportunities and lead build\-versus\-buy\-versus\-configure efforts, and communicate trade\-offs clearly so business priorities and technical delivery stay aligned. **About you:** * 4\-7\+ years of product management experience with demonstrated success building internal tools, business systems, or B2B SaaS products. * Deep, hands\-on Salesforce experience and understanding of the data model, security and sharing. Salesforce certifications are a plus. * Real integration fluency: REST APIs, webhooks, middleware (MuleSoft, Workato, Tray, or similar), and event\-driven architecture. You can read an API spec and hold a credible design conversation with an engineer. * Proven track record in workflow automation and process design, process mapping, SLA definition, and documented, measurable reductions in cycle time or manual effort. * Experience with Marketing Cloud lifecycle journeys, segmentation, consent and preference management, and the compliance constraints on outbound email and SMS. * Direct experience in loan origination, mortgage lending, servicing, or adjacent financial services, with a working understanding of compliance requirements and industry workflows. * Proven ability to thrive in ambiguity and fast\-paced environments where business priorities shift frequently, making data\-driven decisions with incomplete information. * Hands\-on experience running agile delivery: writing user stories, grooming backlogs, and leading sprint planning and retrospectives with a focus on iterative delivery. * Comfort working with SQL or report\-builder proficiency and experience building dashboards to size problems and verify that a shipped change actually worked. * Experience working with business stakeholders at all levels, translating operational pain points into product requirements and managing expectations through clear communication. We recognize that people come with experience and talent beyond just the technical requirements of a job. If your experience is close to what you see listed here, please still consider applying. Diversity of experience and skills combined with passion is a key to innovation and excellence. Therefore, we encourage people from all backgrounds to apply to our positions. Please let us know if you require accommodations during the interview process. **Why join us?** The Unison team draws on a deep and wide range of talent across several disciplines. Visionaries in investment management, product development, and financial technology are joined by innovative real estate and consumer finance experts creating a unique culture. Perks of the Unison employee include: competitive salaries, 100% paid medical and dental benefits, generous PTO policy, paid parental leave program, and fantastic downtown SF and Omaha locations, as well as being an integral part of a well\-funded market leader with incredible momentum. **About us:** Unison is a San Francisco\-based company that is pioneering a smarter, better way to own your home. Until now, the only way to finance a home was by taking on debt. Through the Unison Agreement, we help homeowners access their equity flexibly with no monthly payments or interest. We enhance home affordability, reduce debt, and deliver a less risky way for homeowners, investors, and society to think about their most important asset \- the home. For additional information, visit www.unison.com or follow us on Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, Twitter and YouTube. The last few years have been record breaking for Unison. We expanded our offering to 30 states, surpassed the $5B mark in real estate investments and partnered with over 7K customers through our HomeBuyer and HomeOwner programs. This tremendous growth was recognized by the Deloitte Technology Fast500 awards two years in a row as well as being included in the most recent Forbes Fintech50\. jobs.title: Software Engineer II - Engineer
jobs.description: **About the Role** We are hiring a Software Engineer II for the Login Services Platform Engineering team within Core Security Engineering. Our mission is to build the foundational identity platform that Uber's security and infrastructure organization runs on \- spanning how we govern non\-human identities, how we model identity and access as queryable knowledge, and how we authenticate and authorize both people and autonomous agents at scale. You'll work across three interconnected platform programs: Non\-Human Identity (NHI) Governance, the Security Knowledge Graph, and uSSO / Agentic R\&D. Each is foundational infrastructure that other security and engineering teams build on top of \- which means the systems you write need to be correct, observable, and safe to depend on. **What You'll Do** **Non\-Human Identity Governance** \- Build the tooling and detection logic that governs the sprawling web of permissions between personnel, workloads, agents, service accounts, and infrastructure. Develop inventory and risk\-identification pipelines that surface dangerous patterns \- runaway group membership, over\-privileged service accounts \- before they become incidents. Contribute to eliminating personnel misuse of non\-human identities by migrating credentials to secretless patterns and onboarding privileged access management (PAM) enforcement. **Security Knowledge Graph** \- Help build a single, queryable knowledge graph of identity, assets, ownership, and access controls that is becoming foundational to Uber's security infrastructure strategy. Design and ship the ingestion framework, CI/CD pipeline, and self\-service tooling (schema browsing, query benchmarking, scaffolding) that let any security or infra team onboard their own data sources without bespoke integration work. Build toward near\-real\-time ingestion for high\-value signals like access and group\-membership changes, and extend the graph to support both human consumers (dashboards, investigation tools) and AI agents querying it directly. **uSSO / Agentic R\&D** \- Help evolve uSSO into an identity platform that works natively for both humans and autonomous agents, strengthening authentication as more of Uber's workload shifts to agentic systems acting on behalf of people and services. This means building the underlying platform to be robust and agent\-compatible, and defining how Uber issues, verifies, and scopes identity for agents \- establishing clear on\-behalf\-of relationships and policy standards for how agents can safely access production systems and SaaS. Diagnose and resolve complex distributed\-systems problems across these platforms under continuous, high\-volume, security\-critical traffic \- with a focus on correctness, latency, and operational resilience. **Basic Qualifications** 4\+ years of professional experience as a Software Engineer, with experience designing, building, and operating distributed systems in a production environment. Ability to take ownership of a well\-scoped technical problem, break it into concrete steps, and drive it to completion with appropriate urgency. Working knowledge of backend infrastructure fundamentals: service architecture, data stores, caching, and asynchronous/event\-driven messaging. **Preferred Qualifications** Experience with graph data models and query languages (e.g., Cypher), or with streaming/near\-real\-time data pipelines (e.g., Kafka, Flink). Experience with identity and access management concepts: service accounts, privileged access management, non\-human identity, OAuth, or SSO. Interest or experience in emerging problems around AI agent identity and authorization \- how autonomous systems should be authenticated, scoped, and audited. Familiarity with Golang and with modernizing legacy backend systems. For San Francisco, CA\-based roles: The base salary range for this role is USD $171,000 per year \- USD $190,000 per year. You will be eligible to participate in Uber's bonus program, and may be offered an equity award \& other types of comp. All full\-time employees are eligible to participate in a 401(k) plan. You will also be eligible for various benefits. **Ready to Ride?** This isn't the kind of place where you follow a playbook \- it's where you help write one. If you're driven by impact, energized by challenge, and ready to shape how the world moves \- we'd love to hear from you. You may be eligible for bonuses, equity, and other compensation, as well as a range of benefits. Explore our benefits. Offices remain key to collaboration and Uber's culture. jobs.title: Staff Software Developer
jobs.description: **The opportunity** ------------------- **AI has made coding and prototyping faster. Game asset production and integration have not seen equivalent gains across images, 3D models, audio, and animation. The AI Generators team is building a platform for developers to create, modify, and incorporate high\-quality assets into games through natural language, reusable tools, and APIs. This gives creators the convenience, artistic control, and interoperability their workflows need to bring their ideas to life.** **You will help shape how these tools evolve alongside advances in generative AI and agentic development. That means exposing new capabilities and evaluating quality in agentic loops with appropriate human\-in\-the\-loop oversight, so more people can build games and experts can realize their creative vision with less time and effort.** **You will own the shared API and SDK layer that Unity products consume, and work across the orchestration and partner integration layers that sit behind it. Unity is the engine behind a large share of the games people play. This platform defines how generative AI capabilities reach those creators inside the workflows they already use.** **What you'll be doing** ------------------------ * **Owning APIs and SDKs powering AI asset creation experiences through the entire lifecycle of design, delivery, and support.** * **Ensuring backend services are secure, reliable, and observable, and that they account for failure and recovery scenarios using infrastructure as code.** * **Developing and maintaining new integrations in tight collaboration with our partners to enable improvements to asset workflows.** * **Setting the patterns and practices for AI\-assisted development across the team, with appropriate guardrails, feedback loops, and architectural oversight to keep production code quality high as the team's velocity increases.** * **Supporting and improving the team’s CI, release, and incident management processes to drive continuous improvement into the system from classes of support issues.** * **Partnering with product, design, and engineering functions across Unity AI to shape the roadmap for appropriate investment in features vs. foundational health.** **What we're looking for** -------------------------- * **Extensive experience with C\# / .NET building production web APIs. Experience with TypeScript is a plus.** * **Comfort working at multiple levels of abstraction, from the high\-level architecture of a feature through developing and supporting the code for it.** * **Demonstrated technical leadership driving architectural decisions broader than a single team and raising the technical judgement of the engineers around you.** * **Track record of designing and evolving APIs and SDKs consumed by multiple teams or external developers, accounting for versioning lifecycle and compatibility validation.** * **Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with successful experience aligning multiple stakeholders to deliver complex solutions.** * **Expertise with cloud offerings including databases, publish\-subscribe systems, and observability stacks, plus familiarity with the application patterns where each is appropriate.** * **Proven expertise in debugging, profiling, and optimizing applications in a production environment, including evolving an existing service as scale or interaction complexity grows.** **You might also have** ----------------------- * **Experience with Azure or GCP cloud platforms and their offerings.** * **Familiarity with Unity or other 3D engines and game asset pipelines.** * **Experience with generative AI and related model capabilities, their evaluation and usage in game development.** * **Multi\-tenant enterprise platform experience: entitlements, metering, usage controls.** Base Salary Range: We determine the base salary range for this role based on your primary work location: Zone A: $157,800 \- $236,800 USD gross Zone B: $178,300 \- $267,500 USD gross Zone C: $200,400 \- $300,600 USD gross *This range reflects the anticipated base salary for this position. Beyond base salary, this role may be eligible for equity awards and participation in our company incentive plans (such as annual discretionary bonuses or sales commissions). The final offer amount will depend on several factors, including geographic location and the candidate’s relevant experience, professional background, and skill set.* **Benefits** At Unity, we want our team members to thrive. We offer a wide range of benefits designed to support well\-being and work\-life balance. Please note: Benefits eligibility, specific offerings, and coverage vary based on the country and employment status. Unity also enables teams across industries like automotive, manufacturing, and healthcare to design, simulate, and collaborate in 3D — closing the gap between ideas and reality. For more information, please visit www.unity.com. *Unity is a proud equal opportunity employer. jobs.title: Postdoctoral Associate
jobs.description: The Department of Neurosurgery at the University at Buffalo seeks a full\-time Postdoctoral Associate to support an interdisciplinary research program focused on image\-guided navigation for neurovascular interventions. The successful candidate will develop and evaluate medical robotic systems with artificial intelligence capabilities for vascular navigation using catheter and guidewire technologies guided by X\-ray fluoroscopy and digital subtraction angiography (DSA). The candidate will work closely with clinicians, engineers, and research collaborators to advance project objectives, validate methodologies, achieve project milestones, and disseminate findings through publications and presentations. Specific duties include, but are not limited to: * Develop robotic components and systems for catheter and guidewire shaping and manipulation. * Design, prototype, and evaluate electromechanical systems for endovascular navigation applications. * Develop and evaluate artificial intelligence and reinforcement learning approaches for autonomous guidewire shaping and control. * Design experiments, validation strategies, and quantitative performance metrics for robotic navigation and wire\-shaping systems. * Develop embedded control systems and software for robotic devices and supporting hardware. * Coordinate research objectives and technical requirements with clinicians, engineers, and multidisciplinary project teams. * Integrate information from medical imaging, vascular anatomy, device behavior, and robotic control systems to support system\-level navigation development. * Track progress toward defined project milestones and contribute to technical reports and project updates. * Prepare manuscripts, presentations, and other scientific materials describing research methods and findings. * Prepare materials for grant proposal submissions. The department of neurosurgery in the Jacobs School is actively recruiting for a laboratory technician. This individual will work closely with the Principal Investigator (PI) as the laboratory technician in the cerebrovascular lab. Job duties include: conducting experiments under supervision of professor (animal care and surgeries), writing and revising IACUC and IRB protocols, ordering lab supplies and maintaining the daily functions of the lab), assist undergraduate, graduate and medical students in their research (qPCR, RNA\-sequencing, cell culture), The University at Buffalo (UB) \#ubuffalo is one of America’s leading public research universities and a flagship of the State University of New York system, recognized for our excellence and our impact. UB is a premier, research\-intensive public university dedicated to academic excellence. Our research, creative activity and people positively impact the world. Like the city we call home, UB is distinguished by a culture of resilient optimism, resourceful thinking and pragmatic dreaming that enables us to reach others every day. Visit our website to learn more about the **University at Buffalo**. *Learn more:* * Our **benefits**, where we prioritize your well\-being and success to enhance every aspect of your life. * Being a part of the **University at Buffalo community.** As an Equal Opportunity / Affirmative Action employer, the Research Foundation will not discriminate in its employment practices due to an applicant’s race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin and veteran or disability status. **Minimum Qualifications** * PhD in Biomedical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Robotics, or a related engineering field. * Experience in robotics design, mechatronics, electromechanical systems, or robotic device development. * Experience in electronic circuit and printed circuit board (PCB) design. * Experience in embedded systems development and microcontroller programming (e.g., Arduino, STM32, Raspberry Pi, or similar platforms). * Experience with computer\-aided design (CAD) software and rapid prototyping techniques, including 3D printing. * Experience developing artificial intelligence and machine learning methods for research applications. * Proficiency in programming languages commonly used for robotics and AI development (e.g., Python, C/C\+\+, MATLAB). * Strong command of statistical methods and their application to biomedical and engineering research. * Demonstrated track record of peer\-reviewed publications. * Demonstrated ability to communicate scientific findings clearly and collaborate effectively within multidisciplinary research teams. **Preferred Qualifications** * Three or more years of experience working in a clinical, translational, or medical device research environment. * Experience collaborating with clinicians and coordinating research objectives across multidisciplinary teams. * Knowledge of neurovascular anatomy, cerebrovascular disease, and neurovascular interventions, with an emphasis on mechanical thrombectomy. * Experience developing robotic medical devices or image\-guided surgical/interventional systems. * Experience with X\-ray fluoroscopy and digital subtraction angiography (DSA) imaging. * Familiarity with reinforcement learning and autonomous robotic control. * Experience with ROS (Robot Operating System) or similar robotics software frameworks. * Experience providing guidance or mentorship to graduate students. **Our University Community** **Physical Demands** **Driving Requirements** This position will never drive a university owned vehicle. **Salary Range** 60000\.00 **Additional Salary Information** The salary range reflects our good faith and reasonable estimate of the possible compensation at the time of posting, the role and associated responsibilities, and the experience, education, and training of the selected candidate. **Work Hours** 40 **Campus** Gates Vascular Institute **Posting Alerts** **Special Instructions Summary** **Is a background check required for this posting?** No **Background Check Notification**
