jobs.title: Conversational AI Chatbot Developer
jobs.description: **Job Description** Chatbot Developer – Conversational AI PLEASE NOTE: All candidates should be pre\-vetted thoroughly and should have references to LinkedIn or GitHub repositories. Additional work specific references should be provided upon request (No Gmail/Personal mail) Role Overview We are seeking a talented and passionate Conversational AI Developer to play a pivotal role in managing current day chatbot implantations and designing, building, and optimizing our next\-generation conversational experiences. In this role, you will bridge the gap between classical NLU systems and modern Generative AI orchestrations. You will be responsible for maintaining our robust enterprise foundations while actively driving our migration strategy toward autonomous agent frameworks. The ideal candidate possesses a deep technical background in the Microsoft conversational ecosystem, a strong understanding of enterprise integration layers, and a passion for delivering seamless, human\-like, yet transparent user experiences. Key Responsibilities · End\-to\-End Development: Drive the full lifecycle development (from conversational design to production deployment) of scalable chatbots, virtual assistants, and AI agents. · Architecture Migration: Maintain and optimize our current Azure Bot Framework SDK v4 stack while actively participating in the architectural migration toward Microsoft Foundry and Agents 365 Azure SDK. · Enterprise Integration: Design and implement robust API integrations using MuleSoft as the central enterprise service bus to orchestrate data exchange between conversational front ends and core backend systems, including PeopleSoft and Salesforce. · Omnichannel Dialog Management: Author and manage rich, dynamic conversational interfaces using Microsoft Dynamics Adaptive Cards, Knowledge Management systems, and Automation Flows across web, mobile, and messaging channels. · Live Chat and Case Management: Build seamless escalation protocols, including live agent handoffs to Salesforce Live Chat and automated ticket routing via Salesforce Case Management APIs. · NLU and LLM Orchestration: Integrate Hybrid AI strategies by combining classical NLU (Azure Conversational Language Understanding/CLU) with Large Language Models (Azure OpenAI/GPT) for intelligent intent routing, fallback handling, and contextual content generation. · Performance Optimization: Analyze conversation logs, containment rates, and intent accuracy metrics using data visualization tools to continuously optimize conversational flows and minimize hallucinations. · Cross\-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with Product Managers, UX Designers, and business stakeholders to translate complex business logic into intuitive user stories and turn technical constraints into delightful user experiences. Technical \& Professional Qualifications Required Experience · 3\+ years of dedicated experience in software development with a specialized focus on Conversational AI, NLP/NLU, or LLM agent development. · Microsoft Bot Stack Expertise: Deep, hands\-on proficiency with Azure Bot Framework SDK v4 (including Waterfall Dialogs, custom middleware, and state management) alongside experience or strong theoretical knowledge of Copilot Studio / Agents 365\. · Core Backend Skills: Strong programming fundamentals with advanced proficiency in C\#, .NET, and JavaScript, combined with frontend capabilities (HTML/CSS) for custom web\-chat styling and Adaptive Card rendering. · Enterprise Systems Integration: Direct experience working with MuleSoft layers to pull/push data from legacy enterprise platforms like PeopleSoft and CRM systems like Salesforce. Preferred Qualifications · Data and State Management: Experience configuring and querying Azure Cosmos DB for storing conversation state, user context, and telemetry logs. · Analytics Driven: Familiarity utilizing Power BI or Azure Application Insights to analyze drop\-off points, intent confusion matrices, and chatbot containment metrics. · Modern DevOps: Experience defining and maintaining CI/CD pipelines for conversational assets across Dev, Test, and Production environments. · Industry Context: Experience implementing conversational solutions within Higher Education or complex, multi\-stakeholder enterprise environments is a plus. · Soft Skills: Exceptional communication skills with the ability to articulate technical AI constraints to non\-technical business stakeholders. Benefits \& Culture · Cutting\-Edge Innovation: Be part of a forward\-thinking team actively reshaping the digital student and staff experience through advanced AI and Agentic workflows. · Impact\-Driven Work: Build tools that directly solve user pain points, handling high\-volume transactions with immediate real\-world impact. · Professional Growth: Work in a fast\-paced environment that actively supports upskilling in Generative AI, LLM orchestration, and next\-generation Microsoft AI technologies. jobs.title: Staff Backend Engineer, Integrations
jobs.description: Streaming TV is no longer just a brand awareness channel. It’s becoming a core part of the performance marketing mix, alongside search and social. Vibe.co is building the platform that makes TV work like the rest of the acquisition stack: targeted, measurable, and optimized for results. Vibe.co is an **Audience First Streaming TV Advertising platform** that gives marketers the tools to reach the right audiences, optimize campaigns in real time, and understand what’s actually driving business outcomes. With hyper\-targeted segmentation, AI\-powered recommendations, real\-time optimization, and incrementality measurement, Vibe brings the precision and accountability of digital advertising to the biggest screen in the house. Today, more than 12,000 brands use Vibe.co to reach 120 million\+ households. And in August 2026, Vibe.co became a Walmart company, opening up a new chapter for the business and the industry. With Walmart’s first\-party data and purchase signals now part of the Vibe platform, advertisers can connect TV advertising to real\-world transactions and measure the impact of CTV with a level of precision previously associated with platforms like Google and Meta. **This is a unique moment to join Vibe.** With Walmart’s scale, data, and reach behind us, we’re building the next generation of TV advertising and creating a more measurable, performance\-driven future for the channel. **About the Role** ------------------ You'll join the Integrations team, the connective tissue of Vibe's platform, reporting to the Engineering Manager. The team owns everything flowing in and out of Vibe: measurement and attribution integrations, audience connections from CRMs and CDPs, and reporting pipelines. This role exists because we're building a first\-class Developer Platform: opening Vibe's full capabilities as a public API so external partners can build on top of us. Criteo is the first partner live on it. Three reasons to want this: * You'll be one of the most senior engineers on Integrations, setting technical direction for a team that's still small enough for one person's decisions to shape it * You'll own the foundational architecture for a platform external partners are already building against * AI\-augmented development is the expectation here, not the experiment **What You'll Do** ------------------ **Build and ship integrations** * Design and implement production\-grade integrations with external platforms: CRMs, CDPs, measurement vendors, data partners * Own integration projects end to end, from scoping through production, with full accountability for outcomes * Work directly with external partners to define, validate, and evolve data contracts **Developer Platform** * Drive the architecture of Vibe's public API: account, advertiser, and campaign management endpoints built to scale * Build the documentation, monitoring, and tooling that makes the developer experience genuinely good * Contribute to the MCP gateway and authentication layers that expose Vibe's capabilities externally **Reliability and scale** * Find the weak points in existing pipelines and lead the rebuild * Set the standard for code quality on the team: your reviews move the bar, not just the diff * Use AI tooling to accelerate your own output and raise the team's **Technical leadership** * Set engineering norms and technical direction as the Integrations team grows * Weigh in on architecture decisions across the team, not just your own projects * Partner with the Engineering Manager on technical direction and hiring calibration **What You Need** ----------------- * 8\+ years building production backend systems: APIs, data pipelines, distributed services at scale * Strong TypeScript backend experience * Direct ownership of a major project, start to finish, not just a contributor role on someone else's * AWS and Terraform experience, with real architectural decision\-making, not just implementation * A high\-ownership background: startup, scale\-up, or anywhere you couldn't hand the hard problems to someone else **Nice to Haves** ----------------- * Third\-party integrations experience: ETL, webhooks, REST/GraphQL APIs * Python/C\+\+/Rust, alongside your TS work * Experience designing or contributing to developer\-facing platforms or public APIs * Startup experience (\~300 people or fewer), current or past. Doesn't need to be your most recent role **Our Values** -------------- At Vibe, we run on three values: Impact, Ambition, and Urgency. We tie every goal to a real business outcome, think 10x rather than settling for good enough, and move daily rather than waiting for perfect conditions. You'll thrive here if you own outcomes without needing direction, default to action, and hold yourself to results, not effort. This is a high\-performance environment with high\-performance rewards: you'll work alongside people who push you, with real ownership over hard problems in a market that's moving fast. If that sounds like the best version of your career, we want to meet you. **What We Offer** ----------------- *For candidates in New York, NY, the pay range for this role is $195,000–$265,000\.* At Vibe, we want you to build something, own something, and grow fast. Here's how we back that up: * **Variable pay** based on objectives you hit. No arbitrary targets. * **Hybrid flexibility.** We're in NYC's Flatiron District and our team is in 3x a week. * **Full health coverage.** Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance. * **401(k) with matching.** We invest in your future, not just your output. * **Unlimited PTO.** Take the time you need. We measure results, not hours. * **Parental leave.** Paid leave for all parents. * **Annual offsite.** The whole team, once a year, somewhere worth the trip. **Our Interview Process** ------------------------- We respect your time. Here's exactly what to expect: no surprises, no ghosting. * **Recruiter screen.** 30 min. We'll share context; you'll share yours. * **Manager Interview.** 45 min with your future manager. Your experience, your projects, your approach. * **Product Interview.** 30 mins with the Product Manager for this team. We want to hear about how you've worked cross\-functionally in previous roles. * **Technical assessment.** 90 min. Code review exercise plus applied questions, including how you use AI in your workflow. Real problems, not tricks. * **Bar raiser.** 30 min with a senior leader to ensure we're holding a consistent, high bar. * **Offer.** Fast. We don't let good decisions sit. **Equal Opportunity** --------------------- Vibe is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate all applicants without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We believe the best ideas come from teams with different backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences. If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or interview process, please let us know. **Referral Instructions** ------------------------- Being referred? Ask your contact to submit your application directly on your behalf.

jobs.title: Research Engineer, Institute for Software Integrated Systems
jobs.description: The Research Engineer is part of the Institute for Software Integrated Systems at Vanderbilt University and is a key individual contributor responsible for assisting with the development, integration, and maintenance of discipline\-specific software systems, web\-based applications, and engineering tools to support project and research goals. This position involves engineering and software design, web application development, cloud integration, maintenance, and experimentation as directed by the Principal Investigator. Reporting directly to the Principal Investigator, the Research Engineer regularly collaborates with a multidisciplinary team including Research Engineers, Research Scientists, Graduate Students, and stakeholders to accomplish project\-specific goals. **About the Work Unit:** The Institute for Software Integrated Systems conducts basic and applied research in the area of systems and information science and engineering. jobs.title: Senior Firmware Engineer (FE)
jobs.description: **Senior Firmware Engineer(FE)** **Salary: $ 180,000\.00 \| Full\-Time \| Rancho Cordova, CA** We have partnered with a large Semiconductor Manufacturing and Technology Services in the Rancho Cordova, CA area to provide them with a Senior Firmware Engineer(FE). Please review the below description and let us know if you are interested. **Prioritized Must Have Skills for the** **Senior Firmware Engineer(FE):** \#1\. 3\+ years of experience in SSD controller and firmware development, with strong knowledge of NVMe protocol stack architecture. \#2\. Strong C/C\+\+ programming and data structures experience in embedded software/firmware development. \#3\. Hands\-on experience with NVMe command processing, Submission/Completion Queues, PCIe Gen5, and NVMe protocol compliance. \#4\. Strong experience with SMBus and/or I3C protocols, including command handling, data transfer, error detection, and recovery. \#5\. Hands\-on experience with firmware debugging and validation using JTAG/ICE debuggers, protocol analyzers, logic analyzers, and firmware logs. **Responsibilities of the Senior Firmware Engineer(FE):** * Protocol Stack Design and Maintenance + Design and maintain the NVMe protocol stack, including Admin and I/O command processing, and Submission/Completion Queue management. + Ensure full compliance with the latest NVMe specifications and PCIe Gen5 protocol requirements. + Design and implement SMBus and I3C communication protocols, ensuring reliable and accurate data exchange with the host controller. * Command Processing and Flow Control + Implement NVMe command parsing, data transfer mechanisms, and completion flows, supporting multi\-namespace operations. + Implement SMBus/I3C read/write commands and data flow, including status monitoring, temperature/voltage reporting, and control command handling. * Error Reporting and Recovery + Implement proper status code reporting, Asynchronous Event Notification (AEN), and error recovery flows to ensure host compatibility. + Handle timeout, abort, and reset scenarios to maintain system stability and minimize host impact. + Design SMBus/I3C error detection and retry mechanisms to prevent transmission errors from causing system failures. * Compliance and Interoperability + Verify compatibility with industry\-standard NVMe compliance tools and host platforms. + Validate SMBus and I3C communication against JEDEC/MIPI specifications to ensure broad interoperability with different host systems and controllers. * Debug and Validation + Capture and analyze PCIe/NVMe transactions using protocol analyzers, logic analyzers, and firmware logs. + Monitor SMBus/I3C transfers, analyze timing and error conditions, and ensure firmware implementation is stable and reliable. + Collaborate with validation teams to execute compliance, stress, and corner\-case tests, including hot\-plug, power management, error injection, and multi\-protocol concurrency tests. + Provide root\-cause analysis and implement fixes for protocol\-related issues found during validation or in customer systems. **Requirements of the Senior Firmware Engineer(FE):** * Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field. * At least 3 years of experience in software/firmware applications engineering. with version control software such as Git. * Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively within a small team. * Must be willing to learn quickly and work effectively as a team player. * jobs.title: Software Engineer (Front End)
jobs.description: **Company Description** System High is a wholly owned subsidiary of Veilant, delivering advanced protection and secrecy solutions that secure and strengthen critical missions, programs, and intelligence activities. We support some of the nation’s most sensitive efforts, and our team plays a direct role in protecting what matters most. As part of Veilant, System High combines deep mission expertise with the resources and capabilities of a broader organization focused on protecting and advancing critical national security missions. **Job Description** **Want to build instead of inherit?** System High is looking for a Software Engineer specializing in frontend development to take ownership of the user\-facing application layer of a new software product being built from the ground up. This is a true greenfield opportunity. You won’t be inheriting years of legacy frontend code or simply working through an established backlog. You’ll have the opportunity to help establish the frontend architecture, component patterns, development workflows, and technical standards that shape the application as it grows. We’re looking for an engineer who combines strong frontend development skills with broader software engineering fundamentals. You should be comfortable building modern web applications, integrating with APIs, working within GitHub and CI/CD workflows, and collaborating closely with backend engineers and other technical specialists. React is our preferred direction, but because the application is still being built, we value strong engineering fundamentals and experience with modern frontend frameworks over expertise in one narrowly defined stack. We also want someone who knows how to use modern AI\-assisted development tools effectively. AI should make you faster at tasks like documentation, testing, scaffolding, debugging, and repetitive development but it shouldn't replace your ability to understand the code, challenge the output, and make sound engineering decisions. If you're energized by a blank canvas, enjoy solving problems without having every step prescribed, and want to see your technical decisions directly influence a new product, this is an opportunity to make a meaningful impact. **What You’ll Do** * **Own the Frontend Application Layer:** Help design and build the frontend from the ground up, establishing scalable patterns for components, routing, state management, performance, accessibility, and maintainability. * **Build Production\-Ready Experiences:** Translate product requirements and UI/UX concepts into responsive, intuitive, high\-quality application features. * **Integrate with APIs:** Build reliable integrations between the frontend and backend services, confidently working with API contracts, data structures, payloads, application state, error handling, and asynchronous workflows. * **Shape Frontend Architecture:** Participate in technical decisions around frameworks, libraries, application structure, reusable components, testing strategies, and development standards. * **Work Across Engineering Boundaries:** Collaborate with backend development, AI/technical specialists, QA, and product leadership to solve problems that span multiple parts of the application. * **Build Efficient Development Workflows:** Work within GitHub, AWS/GIT\-based workflows, and CI/CD pipelines to support reliable development, testing, integration, and deployment. * **Use AI to Increase Engineering Velocity:** Apply AI\-assisted development tools to accelerate documentation, testing, debugging, code scaffolding, and repetitive engineering tasks while independently reviewing, validating, and improving generated output. * **Automate Where It Makes Sense:** Write lightweight scripts or utilities to eliminate repetitive tasks, manipulate data, support development environments, or improve engineering workflows. * **Deliver Iteratively:** Break complex requirements into manageable technical tasks and deliver working software through an Agile/Scrum development process. * **Contribute Beyond Your Code:** Participate in code reviews, technical discussions, sprint planning, estimation, and continuous improvement of the team's engineering practices. **What Success Looks Like** **Within your first six months, you will have:** * Helped establish the technical foundation and architecture of a new frontend application. * Built and delivered production\-ready features that turn product requirements into an intuitive user experience. * Established reliable integrations between the frontend and backend APIs. * Contributed reusable components, patterns, and development standards that make the application easier to extend and maintain. * Demonstrated the ability to independently troubleshoot issues across the frontend, API, data, and development workflow layers. * Integrated AI\-assisted development into your workflow in ways that measurably improve speed and efficiency without compromising engineering quality. * Become a trusted techni t. * Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to collaborate effectively in a remote engineering environment. **Nice to Haves** * Experience helping build a new application, product, or significant feature from the ground up. * Experience with React, Next.js, and TypeScript. * Familiarity with GIT/AWS development workflows, CI/CD pipelines, or cloud\-based application delivery. * Experience working across frontend/backend boundaries or collaborating closely with backend engineering teams. * Familiarity with scripting or automation using Node.js, Python, Bash, or similar technologies. * Experience establishing frontend architecture, component libraries, design systems, or engineering standards. * Experience with automated frontend or unit testing. * Exposure to applications incorporating AI/LLM capabilities or other intelligent application services. * Experience working in Agile/Scrum software development environments. **Who Will Thrive in This Role** You’re likely to enjoy this role if you like building more than maintaining. You don’t need someone else to define every implementation detail before you can get started. You’re comfortable taking a requirement, asking the right questions, evaluating different approaches, making a recommendation, and turning that recommendation into working software. You also recognize that modern engineering is changing. You’re interested in using AI and automation to remove repetitive work and increase your output, but you understand that engineering judgment still matters. You can explain your code, defend your technical decisions, identify when generated code is wrong, and improve a solution rather than accepting the first answer a tool provides. Most importantly, you want ownership. This is an opportunity to help establish something new rather than simply inherit what someone else already built. **Additional Information** **What is the Compensation Range for this role?** The salary range for this position is $100,000 \- $125,000 annually for full\-time status. Actual compensation within this range at Veilant is determined by numerous factors including but not limited to the candidate's qualifications, including experience, education, certifications, technical skills, as well as contract\-specific affordability and labor categories, the scope and responsibilities of the role, market and business considerations, and geographic location. **Here are some Perks at System High!** **Benefits That Support Your Life and Career** * Medical, dental, vision, and prescription coverage options. * Paid time off that grows with tenure, plus 11 paid holidays annually. * A 401(k) retirement savings plan and financial planning guidance. * Up to $5,250 annually in tuition assistance for approved coursework. * Support for professional training and certifications. * Company HSA contributions of $600 for individual coverage or $1,200 for family coverage, prorated. * Company paid life insurance, plus short term and long term disability coverage. **Physical Requirements:** * Must be able to remain in a stationary position 50% of the time. The person in this position needs to occasionally move about inside the office * Constantly work with computers and other information technology equipment * The ability to communicate information and ideas in a classroom style format, may stand at a podium for long periods of time *We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We are proud to be an equal opportunity workplace.* *If you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a position with Veilant through its online applicant system, please contact Veilant's Talent Management Department at (703\) 544\-2424 or contact us through e\-mail at* *contact\_us@**veilant.com*

Ideally will have expertise in the following technical areas aspects: ### **Requirements Gathering** Collaborates with the business and with data analysts to understand requirements and business objectives for relevant reports \& visualizations as well as underlying data model. Capable of identifying relevant data sources and attributes for use in model Proficient in using Excel at an intermediate level, comfortable with complex formulas, pivot tables, and data analysis. Ability to reverse engineer processes originally developed by business users, deconstructing existing formulas, pivot tables, and data analyses to interpret business requirements based on existing manual processes and suggest efficiency improvements and logic optimizations. ### **Data Modeling:** Designing and documenting efficient conceptual, logical, and physical data models to support business requirements. Familiarity with running tabular Editor Best Practice Analyzer for adhering to modeling and DAX best practices. Ensuring seamless data extraction and transformation. Calculated columns, measures, and custom calculations. ### **Report Creation:** Designing and developing interactive and visually appealing reports and dashboards. Incorporating slicers, visuals, and drill\-through functionality, including streaming and ArcGIS visuals. Capable of optimizing Power BI reports or making suggestions to underlying data model for performance, including the use of DAX Studio and built in Power BI performance tools. ### **Power BI Service \& Deployment:** Proficient in publishing reports to the Power BI Service, managing access controls, automating refresh schedules, and optimizing report performance for large datasets. ### **AI Familiarity:** Comfortable working with AI tools and leveraging AI technologies to enhance processes and optimize data analysis workflows. Experience with Google AI tools is a plus. It is expected that the developer will follow organizational patterns for source and version control for Power BI files and be able to utilize Azure DevOps as appropriate within that process. ### **Collaboration \& Communication Skills:** Experienced in collaborating with cross\-functional teams to gather requirements, explain technical concepts to non\-technical users, and deliver reports that align with business goals. Ability to present complex data insights and reports to non\-technical audiences and stakeholders, ensuring clarity and effective communication. Experienced in meeting preparation, screensharing and conducting working sessions which may include discussing backlog item statuses, and gathering additional requirements as they may change. jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description: **Summary** =========== Vital Services is seeking a talented and experienced Mid\-Level Software Engineer to join our growing Application Engineering department. This is an extraordinary opportunity to be a part of, and play an integral role in, the expansion of our Information Technology team. The core focus of this role is to write clean, secure, and highly efficient code that successfully implements functional requirements, ensuring rapid features delivery and high system reliability across active product and T\&M client queues. **Roles \& Responsibilities of the Software Engineer** ====================================================== * **Feature Implementation \& Delivery:** Writing well\-structured, testable, and maintainable application code that fulfills documented user stories and technical design specs. * **Defect Resolution \& Support Execution:** Investigating, triaging, and patching software bugs and performance issues efficiently across SaaS platforms and custom client applications. * **API \& Data Flow Execution:** Building and consuming secure web services, endpoints, and third\-party API extractions based on the patterns outlined by the Architect. * **Code Quality \& Testing Discipline:** Participating actively in peer code reviews, adhering to organizational standards, and writing comprehensive unit and integration tests. * **Sprint Hygiene \& Operational Visibility:** Estimating assigned tasks accurately, updating Jira tickets daily, and actively raising dependencies during sprint ceremonies to protect velocity. **Skills \& Experience of the Software Engineer** ================================================= * **Professional Core Experience:** 3\-6 years of verified full\-stack or backend software engineering experience operating within an agile team ecosystem (experience in multi\-client agency or SaaS environments is a plus). * **Technical Stack Proficiency:** Solid proficiency in C\# languages and core object\-oriented programming methodologies in a Microsoft tech stack environment. * **Database Conversance:** Clear comfort writing optimized queries and interacting with relational or non\-relational database engines (e.g., SQL/MySQL). * **Version Control Mastery:** Complete fluency with Git workflow mechanics, branching strategies, and handling merge conflicts cleanly. * **Implementation Mindset:** A strong track record of taking well\-defined, abstract functional requirements and successfully transforming them into live, working software capabilities without needing extensive architectural oversight. **Success Metrics of the Software Engineer** ============================================ * **Individual Sprint Say/Do Ratio:** \>\= 80% predictability on completing committed sprint tasks and feature points. * **Code Review Turnaround Time:** Review and provide actionable feedback on peer pull requests within an average of \< 24 hours to prevent pipeline blockages. * **Post\-Deployment Defect Leaks:** Maintain a threshold of \< 2 critical execution defects or breaking bugs introduced to production environments per quarter. * **Jira \& Time\-Tracking Accuracy:** 100% weekly compliance on task logging, feature estimations, and accurate time log entries. **Compensation \& Culture** =========================== * Salary Range: $95,000 – $115,000 (Mid\-Level) \- *Final offer will be commensurate with experience and technical assessment results.* * Hybrid Flexibility: We value our culture in our offices in Allen, TX and Oak Ridge, TN, but offer a flexible hybrid or remote schedule based on team project needs rather than a rigid clock\-in / in\-office requirement. * Growth Path: This position was created by a team member's promotion. We actively invest in our engineers' career trajectories into senior engineering or architecture roles.

jobs.title: Senior Engineer, Applications Engineering (APC)
jobs.description: **Company Description** At WD, our vision is to power global innovation and push the boundaries of technology to make what you thought was once impossible, possible. At our core, WD is a company of problem solvers. People achieve extraordinary things given the right technology. For decades, we’ve been doing just that—our technology helped people put a man on the moon and capture the first\-ever picture of a black hole. We offer an expansive portfolio of technologies, HDDs, and platforms for business, creative professionals, and consumers alike under our Western Digital®, WD®, and WD\_BLACK™. We are a key partner to some of the largest and highest\-growth organizations in the world. From enabling systems to make cities safer and more connected, to powering the data centers behind many of the world’s biggest companies and hyperscale cloud providers, to meeting the massive and ever\-growing data storage needs of the AI era, WD is fueling a brighter, smarter future. Today’s exceptional challenges require your unique skills. Together, we can build the future of data storage. **Job Description** The Senior Engineer,, Applications Engineering (APC) is responsible for developing, implementing, and sustaining Advanced Process Control (APC) systems—including run‑to‑run (R2R) control and fault detection \& classification (FDC)—to improve manufacturing yield, process capability, cycle time, and equipment productivity. The role requires close collaboration with process, equipment, and IT engineering teams to deploy scalable APC solutions, advance automation initiatives, and drive continuous improvement across wafer manufacturing operations. As part of the industry’s transition from traditional feedback‑based APC to AI‑augmented, model‑driven control, the Senior Engineer will help integrate predictive and data‑driven methods that more accurately identify process drift, reduce variability, and minimize scrap. These next‑generation APC capabilities leverage machine learning, virtual metrology, and advanced equipment analytics to enhance system stability and responsiveness. The Senior Engineer plays a critical role in enabling these AI‑enhanced manufacturing capabilities while ensuring stable, high‑quality, and efficient wafer production. **ESSENTIAL DUTIES \& RESPONSIBILITIES** * Implement APC solutions in collaboration with Process Engineering, Equipment Engineering, IT, and external partners. * Lead APC/automation projects through production release and quantify improvements against baseline metrics. * Perform data analysis to develop and optimize FDC models for real‑time fault detection. * Configure and deploy new control strategies and automation recipes; support recipe management and specification database setups. * Develop and tune R2R control models using feedback and feed‑forward algorithms. * Create advanced FDC models for scrap prevention, tool matching, predictive maintenance, and condition‑based maintenance. * Conduct system integration testing for R2R, FDC, and automation host systems. * Maintain R2R and FDC systems; monitor controller/model performance and initiate continuous improvement activities. * Increasing use of predictive maintenance and health‑monitoring models leveraging FDC \+ ML to identify faults earlier and reduce unplanned downtime. * Troubleshoot system issues and support system recovery during failures. * Participate in roadmap planning for future APC and automation capabilities. * Work effectively in a fast‑paced, cross‑functional environment and model continuous improvement behaviors. **Qualifications** **REQUIRED\-Must Have The Following** * **BS/MS in Engineering (Computer, Electrical, Chemical, Industrial, Mechanical), Applied Physics, Operations Research, Data Science or Statistics.** * **Experience with semiconductor R2R control and FDC systems.** * Strong analytical and programming skills; proficiency with statistical analysis and ML tools such as JMP, Python, and multivariate analysis platforms. * Knowledge of semiconductor processing technologies and equipment. * Solid understanding of IT systems, including: + Linux system administration and shell‑based workflow, + Windows OS, + SQL Server \& SQL queries, + Networking, + SECS/GEM communications, and + Data acquisition systems. SKILLS * Experience applying large language models (LLMs) or AI‑assisted engineering workflows for data analysis, troubleshooting support, automation scripting, documentation generation, or accelerating APC/FDC model development. * Effective verbal and written communication skills with project‑management experience. **Additional Information** Western Digital is committed to providing equal opportunities to all applicants and employees and will not discriminate against any applicant or employee based on their race, color, ancestry, religion (including religious dress and grooming standards), sex (including pregnancy, childbirth or related medical conditions, breastfeeding or related medical conditions), gender  re every individual can thrive through a sense of belonging, respect and contribution. Western Digital is committed to offering opportunities to applicants with disabilities and ensuring all candidates can successfully navigate our careers website and our hiring process. Please contact us at jobs.accommodations@wdc.com to advise us of your accommodation request. In your email, please include a description of the specific accommodation you are requesting as well as the job title and requisition number of the position for which you are applying. Based on our experience, we anticipate that the application deadline will be 12\-17\-2026 **(**3 months from posting), although we reserve the right to close the application process sooner if we hire an applicant for this position before the application deadline. If we are not able to hire someone from this role before the application deadline, we will update this posting with a new anticipated application deadline. \#Ll\-TD1 **Compensation \& Benefits Details** * An employee’s pay position within the salary range may be based on several factors including but not limited to (1\) relevant education; qualifications; certifications; and experience; (2\) skills, ability, knowledge of the job; (3\) performance, contribution and results; (4\) geographic location; (5\) shift; (6\) internal and external equity; and (7\) business and organizational needs. * The salary range is what we believe to be the range of possible compensation for this role at the time of this posting. We may ultimately pay more or less than the posted range and this range is only applicable for jobs to be performed in California, Colorado, New York or remote jobs that can be performed in California, Colorado and New York. This range may be modified in the future. * If your position is non\-exempt, you are eligible for overtime pay pursuant to company policy and applicable laws. You may also be eligible for shift differential pay, depending on the shift to which you are assigned. * You will be eligible to be considered for bonuses under **either** WD’s Short Term Incentive Plan (“STI Plan”) or the Sales Incentive Plan (“SIP”) which provides incentive awards based on Company and individual performance, depending on your role and your performance. jobs.title: Artificial Intelligence Solutions Director
jobs.description: **About this role:** Wells Fargo is seeking an Artificial Intelligence Solutions Director to lead the team that turns artificial intelligence opportunities into working capabilities for payments. This role sits at the intersection of artificial intelligence, data, payments, liquidity, and digital currencies. It is accountable for moving the organization beyond experimentation by building solutions that solve meaningful business problems, operate reliably in production, and deliver measurable value. The team operates in a forward deployed model. Engineers and solution leads embed directly with the businesses they support, work alongside product, operations, data, and technology partners to understand problems first\-hand, and design and deliver solutions with them. This Director will set the standard for that model by building the team, defining how it engages, establishing the technical and delivery expectations, and maintaining accountability for both speed and production quality. This is a transformational leadership role. We are looking for a leader with a growth mindset who has built and led technical teams close to the business, can operate effectively through ambiguity and rapid iteration, and is motivated by changing how work gets done rather than managing the current state. **In this role, you will:** * Build, lead, and develop a team of forward deployed engineers and solution leads who work directly with payments businesses to identify, design, and deliver artificial intelligence solutions * Define and lead the artificial intelligence solutions roadmap for payments, liquidity, and digital currencies, aligning near\-term delivery with longer\-term platform and capability investments * Establish the team's engagement model, including how opportunities are identified, evaluated, scoped, prioritized, staffed, delivered, and transitioned into production * Own a portfolio of concurrent artificial intelligence initiatives and make clear investment, sequencing, resource, and delivery decisions across the portfolio * Set technical and delivery direction across generative artificial intelligence, agentic solutions, applied machine learning, natural language processing, and intelligent automation * Ensure solutions move from prototype to production with appropriate engineering quality, evaluation, monitoring, documentation, human\-in\-the\-loop design, model risk practices, and data protection controls * Partner with business, product, technology, data, operations, risk, and control leaders to secure sponsorship, resolve obstacles, and ensure delivered solutions are adopted and sustained * Translate artificial intelligence capabilities, limitations, risks, and technical tradeoffs into clear business outcomes and investment decisions for senior leadership * Establish reusable standards, reference implementations, evaluation frameworks, delivery patterns, and controls that improve the speed and consistency of future engagements * Evaluate external capabilities and market developments to determine where the organization should build, buy, or partner * Manage people and financial resources for Artificial Intelligence Solutions to ensure delivery commitments and strategic objectives are met * Develop leaders and technical talent while building a culture of accountability, collaboration, engineering quality, rapid learning, and responsible innovation **Required Qualifications:** * 10\+ years of Artificial Intelligence solutions experience, or equivalent experience demonstrated through one or a combination of the following: work experience, training, military experience, education * 4\+ years of management or leadership experience **Desired Qualifications:** * Experience leading teams of forward deployed engineers, solution engineers, artificial intelligence engineers, or a comparable embedded technical delivery function that works directly with business teams * Track record of building and scaling a technical team into an established enterprise capability, including hiring, developing, organizing, and retaining engineering talent * Demonstrated ability to manage a portfolio of concurrent delivery engagements, make prioritization and resource decisions, and maintain accountability for outcomes * Hands\-on background in software engineering, data engineering, applied machine learning, or artificial intelligence solution delivery sufficient to set technical direction and maintain a strong quality bar * Experience taking generative artificial intelligence and agentic solutions into production in an enterprise environment, including evaluation, monitoring, human\-in\-the\-loop design, model risk, data protection, and operational support considerations * Working knowledge of modern cloud and data platforms such as Snowflake, Databricks, Amazon Web Services, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud, and experience integrating artificial intelligence into enterprise systems through APIs or event\-driven architectures * Experience   executives, business leaders, and risk and control partners, and to explain technical tradeoffs in business terms * Management consulting, client\-facing delivery, or comparable experience leading complex transformation within a large institution * Demonstrated success developing leaders, influencing across organizational boundaries, and building accountability in a multidisciplinary delivery environment **Job Expectations:** * Operate as a transformational leader by setting a clear agenda, building the team and operating model to deliver it, and maintaining a high bar for speed, quality, and measurable outcomes * Bring a growth mindset and develop it across the team as artificial intelligence technologies, delivery practices, and the payments landscape continue to evolve * Spend meaningful time with the businesses the team supports; proximity to users, workflows, and operational problems is central to the forward deployed model * Balance rapid delivery and experimentation with the risk, control, compliance, security, and production standards expected of the bank * Maintain clear accountability for the portfolio roadmap, investment priorities, team capacity, delivery dependencies, adoption, and sustained business value *\*\*\*Depending on applicant volume this role could be removed early\*\*\** **Pay Range** Reflected is the base pay range offered for this position. Pay may vary depending on factors including but not limited to demonstrated examples of prior performance, skills, experience, or work location. Employees may also be eligible for incentive opportunities. $215,000\.00 \- $355,000\.00**Benefits** Wells Fargo provides eligible employees with a comprehensive set of benefits, many of which are listed below. Visit Benefits \- Wells Fargo Jobs for an overview of the following benefit plans and programs offered to employees. * Health benefits * 401(k) Plan * Paid time off * Disability benefits * Life insurance, critical illness insurance, and accident insurance * Parental leave * Critical caregiving leave * Discounts and savings * Commuter benefits * Tuition reimbursement * Scholarships for dependent children * Adoption reimbursement **Posting End Date:** 24 Sep 2026* ***Job posting may come down early due to volume of applicants.*** **We Value Equal Opportunity** Wells Fargo is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other legally protected characteristic. Employees support our focus on building strong customer relationships balanced with a strong risk mitigating and compliance\-driven culture which firmly establishes those disciplines as critical to the success of our customers and company. They are accountable for execution of all applicable risk programs (Credit, Market, Financial Crimes, Operational, Regulatory Compliance), which includes effectively following and adhering to applicable Wells Fargo policies and procedures, appropriately fulfilling risk and compliance obligations, timely and effective escalation and remediation of issues, and making sound risk decisions. There is emphasis on proactive monitoring, governance, risk identification and escalation, as well as making sound risk decisions commensurate with the business unit’s risk appetite and all risk and compliance program requirements. **Applicants with Disabilities** To request a medical accommodation during the application or interview process, visit Disability Inclusion at Wells Fargo. **Drug and Alcohol Policy** Wells Fargo maintains a drug free workplace. Please see our Drug and Alcohol Policy to learn more. **Wells Fargo Recruitment and Hiring Requirements:** a. Third\-Party recordings are prohibited unless authorized by Wells Fargo. b. Wells Fargo requires you to directly represent your own experiences during the recruiting and hiring process.

jobs.title: Lead DLP Data Integration and Automation Information Security Engineer
jobs.description: **About this Role** **About this Role** Wells Fargo is seeking a Lead Information Security Engineer to join the DLP Data Integration and Automation Team within Cybersecurity Defense. This role is responsible for designing, developing, and automating data protection controls that ensure sensitive information is appropriately identified, classified, and protected across the enterprise. The ideal candidate will possess strong experience in **Data Loss Prevention (DLP), cybersecurity engineering, Python and Bash scripting, data integration, and enterprise security automation**. This individual will lead efforts to onboard and maintain critical data sources—including HR, customer, financial, and regulatory data—into DLP platforms to support data protection and regulatory compliance objectives. **In This Role, You Will** * Lead the design, implementation, and support of highly complex Data Loss Prevention (DLP) and data protection solutions. * Provide advanced application support for enterprise DLP platforms, including troubleshooting, configuration management, data onboarding, and operational support activities. * Support and maintain integrations between DLP platforms and upstream/downstream data sources to ensure accurate and reliable data classification and protection capabilities. * Design and maintain automated workflows that prepare, transform, and integrate sensitive data sources for enterprise DLP platforms. * Ensure DLP systems are receiving accurate and current data feeds, including HR, customer, PII, and other sensitive data classifications. * Provide cybersecurity consulting and technical guidance to business and technology partners to ensure compliance with enterprise security policies and standards. * Design, document, test, implement, and support security solutions across network, endpoint, cloud, application, and data protection domains. * Perform root\-cause analysis, technical troubleshooting, and resolution of complex security and integration issues. * Conduct security risk assessments and recommend remediation strategies for identified vulnerabilities. * Evaluate emerging technologies, perform proof\-of\-concept testing, and develop implementation plans for enterprise deployment. * Collaborate with engineers, architects, application teams, infrastructure partners, and security stakeholders across the organization. * Lead, mentor, and provide technical direction to junior engineers and other team members. * Drive continuous improvement initiatives focused on automation, operational efficiency, and security effectiveness. * Demonstrate proficiency in using AI‑assisted development and analysis tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot and approved code‑centric agents) * Leverage AI to accelerate system design, coding, testing, analysis, and troubleshooting * Apply strong technical judgment when validating and integrating AI‑assisted outputs into solutions * Understand and account for model limitations, security risks, and operational considerations * Apply AI responsibly in development and production environments * Ensure AI usage aligns with security, compliance, privacy, and jobs.title: Senior Lead Artificial Intelligence Solutions Consultant
jobs.description: **About this role:** Wells Fargo is seeking an Artificial Intelligence Solutions Director to lead the team that puts artificial intelligence to work in payments. This role sits at the forefront of AI and data for payments, working at the intersection of rapid advances in artificial intelligence and innovation in payments, liquidity, and digital currencies, and it is accountable for turning that intersection into working capability rather than experimentation. The team operates on a forward deployed model. Engineers and solution leads embed directly with the businesses they serve, work alongside product, operations, and technology partners to understand the problem first\-hand, and build and ship the solution with them. This Director sets the standard for that model: hiring and developing forward deployed engineers, shaping how the team engages, and holding the bar on what gets built and how quickly it reaches production. This is a transformational role. We are looking for a transformational leader with a growth mindset: someone who has built and led technical teams close to the business, is comfortable with ambiguity and rapid iteration, and is more interested in changing how the work gets done than in managing it as it is. **In this role, you will:** * Embed with payments, liquidity, and digital currency teams to identify high\-value artificial intelligence opportunities and translate business problems into solutions that can be built * Lead artificial intelligence initiatives end to end, including opportunity framing, scoping, technical design, prototyping, testing, deployment, monitoring, documentation, and handover * Write production code and build on enterprise artificial intelligence, data, and cloud platforms using large structured and unstructured datasets * Design and deploy generative artificial intelligence and agentic solutions, including retrieval, evaluation, human\-in\-the\-loop workflows, and appropriate safeguards * Assess technological readiness, data availability, delivery dependencies, and resources required to execute proposed solutions * Prototype quickly with users, incorporate feedback, and engineering fundamentals, including production coding experience in Python, TypeScript, or comparable languages * Hands\-on experience building and deploying generative artificial intelligence and large language model solutions in production, including prompt engineering, retrieval, evaluation, and agentic patterns * Experience working with modern cloud and data platforms such as Snowflake, Please note, this position is not currently considering new graduates. **Essential Job Functions:** * Support field investigations or assessments. * Perform design engineering calculations. * Assist in the design of various types of water and stormwater infrastructure. * Provide data collection, analysis, and reporting. * Participate with the writing and the production of project reports. * Work under the direct guidance and mentorship of senior engineers. **Required Experience:** * BS Degree in Civil Engineering, Environmental Engineering, or Water Resource Engineering from an EAC/ABET\-accredited college or university. Masters degrees will receive due consideration. * EIT Certification (i.e., passed Fundamentals of Engineering (FE) exam). * 2\+ year(s) of relevant experience, preferably in construction plan production, design calculations, and/or technical writing * Knowledge in the use of Autodesk (e.g., AutoCAD, Civil3D) or Bentley (e.g., Microstation, InRoads) design platforms is a plus. * Experience with commercial engineering modeling software such as WaterCAD, SewerCAD, StormCAD, and USACE HEC programs is a plus. * Geographical Information Systems (GIS) working experience is a plus. **Please note that Wilson \& Company is not currently sponsoring applicants for work visas.** **Annual Salary Range: $75,000 \- $90,000\+ depending on experience** **About Us:** For nearly a century, Wilson \& Company, Inc., Engineers \& Architects, has provided award\-winning engineering, architecture, planning, environmental, surveying, geospatial, and construction management services. With employees across multiple offices in the Midwest, Southwest, Rocky Mountain, and Western regions in the United States, we bring people together to practice their craft, create value, and accomplish great things. Guided by our purpose, we help clients move from concept to completion, transforming unused spaces into productive places, underutilized facilities into efficient ones, and rural or urban challenges into achievable solutions. By employing our core values—discipline, intensity, collaboration, shared ownership, and solutions—we create genuine experiences and lasting connections for our clients, employees, and communities. We support our employees’ success and well\-being with a comprehensive benefits package, including options for health insurance, life insurance, disability coverage, paid time off, and retirement savings plans. We are proud to be an EEO employer and maintain a drug\-free workplace, conducting pre\-employment background checks. Join us and be part of a culture committed to helping you achieve personal and professional success.

jobs.title: Sr Technical Account Manager - North America
jobs.description: Salary: \- * Austin Company Description Wise is a global technology company, building the best way to move and manage the world’s money. **Min fees. Max ease. Full speed.** Whether people and businesses are sending money to another country, spending abroad, or making and receiving international payments, Wise is on a mission to make their lives easier and save them money. As part of our team, you will be helping us create an entirely new network for the world's money. **For everyone, everywhere.** More about **our mission** and **what we offer**. Job Description **As a Senior Technical Account Manager (TAM) with** **Wise Platform****, you'll play a key role in helping our partners grow and get the most out of our infrastructure, setting the standard for technical excellence. You’ll work closely with our partners' technical teams, as well as internal product, account managers, engineering, and commercial stakeholders to ensure long\-term success.** **Your Mission** * Act as the dedicated technical relationship owner for key Wise Platform partners post\-launch, specifically Tier 1 partners (indicatively $1M\+ ARR), working alongside the Account Manager as the technical layer of the account team. * Build a deep understanding of each partner’s integration, architecture and technical roadmap, proactively identifying risks, technical debt and opportunities to improve integration health. * Investigate and help resolve complex technical blockers across APIs, webhooks, authentication, data flows and existing integrations, using logs, monitoring tools, documentation and data to identify root causes and determine the right path forward. * Partner closely with our Integration Support and Engineering teams during complex incidents, then own the partner\-specific technical follow\-through, preventative actions and improvements through to resolution. * Support partners to successfully adopt the latest updates to Wise’s technical integration through a change management process. * Own the ongoing technical health of your accounts, including SLA adherence, monitoring performance, troubleshooting issues and ensuring best practices are followed. * Advocate for your partners internally by surfacing feedback and influencing product roadmaps. * Collaborate with Product Managers, Engineers, Customer Success Managers and Account Managers to drive improvements and resolve complex issues. * Work with partners to drive adoption of the latest technical specification and identify opportunities for new features and use cases. * Contribute to documentation, tooling and scalable processes that improve the experience for all partners. * Help shape and scale how Technical Account Management operates at Wise Platform, creating repeatable processes, tooling and best practices as the function grows. Qualifications * **Have 8\+ years of experience in technical account management, solutions engineering, technical customer success, post\-sales engineering, or a related customer\-facing technical role, including experience supporting complex enterprise or strategic accounts.** * Have experience owning the technical health of complex enterprise customers over time, beyond implementation or initial go\-live. * Are comfortable working with APIs, webhooks, authentication, databases and modern integration standards. * Have hands\-on experience troubleshooting API\-based integrations using logs, monitoring tools, API documentation and data to identify root causes and drive issues toward resolution. * Have experience leading customers through technical change, such as API migrations, authentication changes, platform updates, deprecations or new feature adoption. * Can build credibility with senior technical stakeholders and influence decisions across customer engineering teams, Product and Engineering without direct authority. * Can clearly explain complex technical topics to both engineers and non\-technical stakeholders. * Take a proactive approach to technical account health, identifying risks, integration health issues and improvement opportunities before they escalate. * Have strong stakeholder management capabilities and can prioritize effectively across multiple high\-value accounts, balancing immediate technical needs with longer\-term strategic work. * Make decisions and build conviction leveraging data insights. * Have a strong sense of ownership and thrive in fast\-moving environments. * Value transparency, humility and a customer\-first approach. Additional Information **It’ll Be Valuable If You** * Have experience in payments, fintech, banking, financial infrastructure or another API\-first technology environment. * Have experience with SQL or database querying and observability or monitoring tools such as Kibana, Looker, Prometheus or similar. * Have coding or scripting experience and are comfortable reading technical implementations to understand how systems behave. * Have experience troubleshooting back\-end service issues, including basic database experience such as navigating production logs. * Understand system architectures, data flows and back\-end fundamentals. * Have experience supporting high\-scale, business\-critical enterprise integrations with defined SLAs. * Have experience working across globally distributed Product and Engineering teams. jobs.title: Software Development Engineer - AI Tools
jobs.description: **Your work days are brighter here.** We’re obsessed with making hard work pay off, for our people, our customers, and the world around us. As a Fortune 500 company and a leading AI platform for managing people, money, and agents, we’re shaping the future of work so teams can reach their potential and focus on what matters most. The minute you join, you’ll feel it. Not just in the products we build, but in how we show up for each other. Our culture is rooted in integrity, empathy, and shared enthusiasm. We’re in this together, tackling big challenges with bold ideas and genuine care. We look for curious minds and courageous collaborators who bring sun\-drenched optimism and drive. Whether you're building smarter solutions, supporting customers, or creating a space where everyone belongs, you’ll do meaningful work with Workmates who’ve got your back. In return, we’ll give you the trust to take risks, the tools to grow, the skills to develop and the support of a company invested in you for the long haul. So, if you want to inspire a brighter work day for everyone, including yourself, you’ve found a match in Workday, and we hope to be a match for you too. **About the Team** Welcome to the AI Tools team at Workday! We identify, deploy, and scale AI\-powered tools that eliminate friction from the developer experience \- and extend those capabilities to the broader organization as they mature. We build the AI platform layer that powers code generation, AI\-assisted code review, agentic workflows, and enterprise\-wide developer tooling. We own the MCP registry and gateway that connects Workday's developers to AI capabilities, and we build the technical guardrails that operationalize how AI is used responsibly across the company. If you want to do high\-impact AI infrastructure work in enterprise software, we'd love to hear from you. **About the Role** The Workday AI Tools team is looking for a senior engineer who thrives at the intersection of AI, platform engineering, and developer experience. You'll design and build systems that thousands of Workday engineers rely on every day \- from LLM gateways and MCP server infrastructure to AI\-native agents and compliance tooling. You'll help define how we integrate emerging AI capabilities into our platform, and you'll be a technical anchor on a team that moves fast and takes quality seriously. You'll also work directly with the engineers using these tools \- through office hours, Slack support, and our Champions program \- and your work will be shaped by their feedback. In this role you will: \- Design and build the AI platform layer: LLM gateways, MCP registries, abstraction APIs, and shared infrastructure that teams across Workday build on \- Architect and implement AI agents and automation that improve the developer workflow \- code review, documentation, testing, and beyond \- Drive the evaluation and integration of AI model providers, keeping a strong eye on cost, safety, and performance tradeoffs \- Serve as a scout for emerging AI capabilities \- track new models, tools, and frameworks, and make recommendations to engineering leadership on when to adopt, evaluate, or pass \- Lead technical design on complex, cross\-cutting projects in partnership with Security, DevEx, and infrastructure teams \- Build observability and governance tooling that gives the organization visibility into how AI tools are being used \- Operationalize AI policy and compliance requirements into our platform **About You** Basic Qualifications \- 5\+ years of software engineering experience \- 3\+ years building and operating backend services or platform infrastructure in production \- Strong proficiency in Python and/or TypeScript \- Hands\-on experience building or integrating with LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, etc.) and familiarity with prompt engineering, evaluation pipelines, and model selection tradeoffs \- Robust understanding of AI security principles and responsible AI practices \- including prompt injection, model misuse, data leakage risks, output validation, and operationalizing policy guardrails in production AI systems \- Genuine excitement about being on the leading edge of AI \- you follow new model releases, tooling shifts, and emerging frameworks closely, and you bring that energy into what the team builds Other Qualifications \- Hands\-on experience designing and building AI agents, including fluency with agentic frameworks and patterns such as ReAct \- and practical experience shipping agents that are reliable in production \- Experience building MCP servers, Claude skills, or similar tool\-use integrations that extend AI capabilities to real workflows \- Comfort designing REST APIs and service\-oriented architectures \- Experience with container orchestration (Kubernetes, Docker) and deploying services to cloud environments; experience with workflow orchestration tools and infrastructure\-as\-code is a plus \- Understanding of enterprise security patterns: authentication, - Exposure to observability tooling \- logging, metrics, tracing \- and a habit of building systems that are easy to monitor \- Comfort partnering directly with the engineers who use your tools \- you see user feedback, support channels, and adoption work as part of the job, not a distraction from it \- Strong written and verbal communication skills; able to drive alignment across engineering, security, and product stakeholders **Workday Pay Transparency Statement** The annualized base salary ranges for the primary location and any additional locations are listed below. Workday pay ranges vary based on work location. As a part of the total compensation package, this role may be eligible for the Workday Bonus Plan or a role\-specific commission/bonus, as well as annual refresh stock grants. Recruiters can share more detail during the hiring process. Each candidate’s compensation offer will be based on multiple factors including, but not limited to, geography, experience, skills, job duties, and business need, among other things. For more information regarding Workday’s comprehensive benefits, please click here . Primary Location: USA.GA.Atlanta Primary Location Base Pay Range: $130,400 USD \- $195,600 USD Additional US Location(s) Base Pay Range: $123,900 USD \- $222,000 USD **Our Approach to Flexible Work** With Flex Work, we’re combining the best of both worlds: in\-person time and remote. Our approach enables our teams to deepen connections, maintain a strong community, and do their best work. We know that flexibility can take shape in many ways, so rather than a number of required days in\-office each week, we simply **spend at least half (50%) of our time each quarter in the office or in the field** with our customers, prospects, and partners (depending on role). This means you'll have the freedom to create a flexible schedule that caters to your business, team, and personal needs, while being intentional to make the most of time spent together. Those in our remote "home office" roles also have the opportunity to come together in our offices for important moments that matter. Pursuant to applicable Fair Chance law, Workday will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Workday is an Equal Opportunity Employer including individuals with disabilities and protected veterans. Any employee who retaliates against a candidate or employee for doing so may be subject to disciplinary action, up to and including termination of employment, to the fullest extent allowable under applicable law. If you require a reasonable accommodation, you may email accommodations@workday.com , as far in advance as possible. **Are you being referred to one of our roles? If so, ask your connection at Workday about our Employee Referral process!** At Workday, we value our candidates’ privacy and data security. jobs.title: Staff AI Engineer/AI Architect, Conversation Intelligence Systems
jobs.description: **Who we are** -------------- Xenoss is an AI engineering and integration services company, helping medium to large enterprises run AI transformation end\-to\-end, from situation analysis and goals framing to data discovery and preparation, pipeline building, model development, retraining pipeline design, solution deployment, and support. We build a broad spectrum of AI solutions such as user behaviour prediction, content generation, NLP, audience segmentation, pathfinding solutions, AI assistants, edge computer vision, fraud detection, and others. We work with prominent companies such as Microsoft, Toshiba, AstraZeneca, Activision Blizzard, Verve Group, Voodoo Games, and Telefonica, among others. We’re included in the top 100 software companies on the Inc. 5000 list. **What is the project** ----------------------- We’re hiring a Staff AI Engineer / AI Solution Architect to lead the AI architecture of a long\-term In\-Call Assistant initiative for a world\-leading financial services company. The project focuses on building a real\-time conversational AI system that supports front\-office employees during live customer conversations. The system identifies customer needs, objections, buying signals, and required process steps, and provides concise, context\-aware recommendations. The solution combines low\-latency signal detection, context preparation, specialist recommendation generation, RAG over approved product and policy knowledge, confidence management, and compliance guardrails. You will help define how the AI architecture, models, evaluation framework, and feedback loops are designed and evolved from the initial offline version to live production use **What will you do** -------------------- You’ll lead the applied AI architecture across the In\-Call Assistant lifecycle, from data and taxonomy design to model training, evaluation, and production readiness. **Core work includes:** * Designing the end\-to\-end AI architecture for the In\-Call Assistant * Defining signal and trigger taxonomies for live conversations * Designing training strategies for signal detection and specialist recommendation models * Shaping data preparation, annotation, and SME validation workflows * Evaluating fine\-tuning, post\-training, RAG, and hybrid approaches * Designing low\-latency signal detection, routing, context preparation, and confidence management * Designing evaluation frameworks, golden datasets, and model improvement cycles * Defining grounding, guardrails, abstention, and policy\-compliance behavior * Making trade\-offs between model quality, latency, cost, explainability, and governance * Partnering with AI engineers, data engineering, MLOps, and client SMEs **Technology landscape** ------------------------ You’ll operate across the modern applied AI and ML ecosystem, including: * LLM and smaller\-model training for conversational AI * SFT, DPO / preference optimization, LoRA / QLoRA, and PEFT * PyTorch and Hugging Face ecosystem * Signal extraction and multi\-label classification * RAG and knowledge\-grounded recommendation generation * Embeddings, retrieval, and context preparation * Low\-latency model serving and inference optimization * Golden dataset creation, annotation, and SME validation * Model evaluation, confidence calibration, and error analysis * MLOps, monitoring, feedback loops, and model governance **Scope of ownership and delivery context** ------------------------------------------- At Staff/Architect level, you’ll own the applied AI architecture and evaluation strategy for a complex enterprise AI program. **Core ownership** * Define the AI approach for the conversation intelligence PoC * Establish the event / intent / insight taxonomy * Define the golden dataset strategy and annotation workflow * Establish evaluation frameworks and acceptance criteria * Drive trade\-offs between accuracy, explainability, latency, cost, and governance * Decide which modeling approaches are appropriate for each use case * Act as an escalation point for AI architecture, evaluation, and data strategy decisions **Team and delivery context** * Work within a cross\-functional team spanning AI engineering, data engineering, MLOps, solution architecture, and client stakeholders * Partner with domain SMEs on taxonomy, labeling, and validation * Mentor engineers working on extraction, evaluation, and data pipelines * Translate ambiguous business use cases into testable AI hypotheses and validation plans **What should you bring** ------------------------- **Must have** * Strong hands\-on experience with applied AI / ML systems in production\-oriented environments * Experience with NLP, conversational AI, or transcript\-based intelligence systems * Ability to design evaluation frameworks, not just run experiments * Experience building or validating structured datasets from unstructured text * Strong understanding of LLM\-based extraction, classification, RAG, and fine\-tuning trade\-offs * Practical knowledge of classical ML or predictive modeling * Understanding of probability\-based prediction, calibration, and outcome evaluation * Comfort working with messy enterprise data and incomplete labels * Ability to communicate with both technical teams and business stakeholders * Strong ownership of ambiguity, scope control, and PoC validation strategy **Nice to have** * Financial services domain exposure * Experience with sales, call center, or customer conversation analytics * Speech / ASR pipeline familiarity * Model governance and auditability experience * Experience with real\-time AI systems or low\-latency inference * Experience combining unstructured conversation signals with structured CRM, transaction, or customer profile data * Experience designing golden datasets and SME review workflows **Operating model** ------------------- * Engagement structure: FTE\-equivalent via long\-term B2B contract * Work location: On\-site or closely aligned with the client team in New York * Infrastructure: Client environment only, no external training or data processing environments * Data residency: All work executed within the client perimeter * Delivery mode: PoC\-first, with a path toward production\-grade conversation intelligence and prediction systems
